jobs.title: Database Administrator Enterprise Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Benefits:** * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule **Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer** **Estimated Level of Effort:** 75–80 hours per month **Position Summary** The South Carolina Department of Probation, Parole, and Pardon Services (SCDPPPS) supervises individuals placed on probation, parole, and other community\-release programs. SCDPPPS relies on custom, mission\-critical applications while modernizing its core Offender Management System (OMS). The Database Administrator (DBA) / Enterprise Data Engineer supports the development, integration, security, modernization, and sustainment of these applications and their supporting data environments. The position designs and maintains enterprise data architecture; manages legacy\-data migration and validation; enables reporting, telemetry, and analytics; and administers and optimizes databases supporting OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned systems. **Reporting Relationship** Reports to the Program Manager, Chief Information Officer, Data Architect, or designated technical lead. **Key Responsibilities** **Enterprise Data Architecture and Engineering** * Design, develop, and maintain an enterprise data warehouse, data lake, or comparable data platform supporting structured, semi\-structured, and unstructured data. * Define data models, schemas, metadata, integration patterns, storage approaches, and lifecycle\-management practices. * Establish standards for data ingestion, transformation, storage, access, retention, lineage, cataloging, quality, and security. * Develop and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines for batch, near\-real\-time, and real\-time data processing. * Design secure, reliable interfaces among enterprise applications, reporting platforms, analytics tools, and data repositories. **Legacy Data Migration and Validation** * Plan, execute, document, and support migration of legacy data to the enterprise data environment. * Assess source\-system structures, data quality, business rules, integration dependencies, and technical constraints. * Develop data mappings, transformation rules, migration procedures, reconciliation methods, validation criteria, and rollback plans. * Migrate and validate data associated with OMS, PIC, PAC, IIMS, SSO, and other assigned applications. * Perform data profiling, cleansing, standardization, deduplication, reconciliation, and exception resolution to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity. * Produce validation results, discrepancy logs, remediation recommendations, and migration\-completion documentation. **Business Intelligence, Reporting, and Telemetry** * Develop and maintain Power BI reporting pipelines, semantic models, datasets, dashboards, and reports. * Implement telemetry\-based reporting to support visibility into application activity, system health, performance, and operational metrics. * Develop real\-time and near\-real\-time ingestion workloads for reporting, monitoring, analytics, and decision support. * Optimize reporting data models, refresh processes, queries, and dashboards for performance, security, accuracy, and usability. * Work with stakeholders to define reporting requirements, key performance indicators, data definitions, and dashboard enhancements. **Database Administration and Performance Management** * Perform database design, configuration, administration, maintenance, optimization, and operational support for assigned databases and data platforms. * Monitor database health, availability, capacity, storage, performance, query efficiency, replication, backups, and telemetry. * Resolve performance issues through indexing, query tuning, partitioning, caching, archiving, configuration improvements, and capacity planning. * Execute database\-maintenance activities, including backup and recovery validation, integrity checks, statistics maintenance, patch coordination, and monitoring. * Implement and maintain database security controls, including role\-based access control, least\-privilege access, authentication, authorization, encryption, auditing, and logging. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data engineering, software engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience, education, training, or certifications may be considered. * Experience in database administration, data engineering, data architecture, or a related technical role. * Experience designing or supporting enterprise data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, or comparable platforms. * Experience developing ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, transformations, and system integrations. * Experience with legacy data migration, mapping, profiling, cleansing, reconciliation, validation, and remediation. * Proficiency with SQL, relational database design, normalization, indexing, query optimization, backup and recovery, and performance tuning. * Experience developing Power BI data models, datasets, dashboards, reports, and refresh pipelines. * Knowledge of data quality, governance, metadata, lineage, security, and access\-control principles. * Ability to manage competing priorities and deliver reliable support within an estimated commitment of 75–80 hours per month. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Factory, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or comparable cloud data platforms. * Experience implementing streaming, event\-driven, telemetry, or real\-time data\-ingestion solutions. * Experience with data cataloging, master\-data management, and data\-governance tools. * Experience supporting public\-sector, regulated, criminal\-justice, or security\-sensitive environments. * Familiarity with DevOps, DataOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, and infrastructure\-as\-code practices. * Relevant cloud, database, data\-engineering, or Power BI certifications. **Work Schedule and Requirements** This is a part\-time position requiring an estimated **75–80 hours per month**. Duties may include recurring operational support, planned migrations, reporting releases, and response to database or data\-pipeline issues. Work may be remote, on\-site, or hybrid, subject to program and customer requirements. The incumbent may access sensitive, proprietary, controlled, or government information and must comply with all applicable security, privacy, data\-handling, background\-screening, and customer\-access requirements. Occasional work outside normal business hours may be required for maintenance, releases, migrations, or incident response. Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Lead Software Developer
jobs.description: **PRIMARY PURPOSE OF POSITION** The Lead Software Developer \- Oracle Fusion Applications is the technical leader for development, integration, reporting, extension, deployment, and production\-support activities across the Oracle Fusion Cloud application portfolio. The position remains hands\-on while setting technical direction, promoting common standards across pillars, coordinating complex development work, mentoring developers, and leading resolution of high\-impact production issues. The Lead is accountable for cross\-pillar technical consistency and supportability, not business\-process ownership or unilateral functional solution design. **EXPECTATIONS OF ALL TEAM MEMBERS** * High\-quality, professional work performed with initiative, productivity, collaboration, and accountability. jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Engineer (Forward Deployed) [NYC or SF]
jobs.description: **About Concurrence** ===================== Concurrence (formerly Amigo) is building the platform healthcare organizations use to build their own clinical AI agents. Our mission is to make excellent care accessible to every patient, not rationed by the limits of clinician time. Underneath our platform is the Health World Model, which unifies a health system’s data into a living, event\-level record of every patient’s care. On top of it, agents handle work across the patient journey, from intake and scheduling to medication management and clinical decision support. Our agents have supported more than 10 million patient encounters and are on track to grow tenfold this year. We run natively on Databricks, integrate with every major EHR, and are backed by Madrona, General Catalyst, and Optum Ventures. We’re about 35 people, working in person in New York and San Francisco. **About the role** ------------------ Applied AI is where Concurrence meets the real world. Our core engineering team builds the platform. We take it into health systems and build what each customer actually needs on top of it, as durable software that runs in production. As a Senior Applied AI Engineer, you own an entire customer use case, not a ticket or a slice of one. You take a deployment from brief to production. You make the architecture calls inside it, commit the timeline, and carry the outcome. Success isn't your agent staying up. It's the customer's number moving: more intake handled, fewer denials, faster time to billing close. Your work doesn't stop at one customer. We build custom first, on purpose. When the same shape shows up under two customers, you're the one who sees it, and the pattern you proved becomes part of the platform everyone builds on next. Applied AI runs ahead of the platform, not behind it. Our field work is the R\&D that decides what Concurrence becomes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * **Own a whole use case, end to end.** You run the build from the deployment brief to production and beyond. You set its internal design, commit the timelines, and ship at a bar that doesn't need anyone checking behind you. * **Build agent systems that hold up in clinical settings.** That means hierarchies of agents and skills rather than one monolith, and evals that measure distributions, not vibes. Nothing reaches a patient until it clears our safety floor and eval gate. * **Take on the integration reality.** EHRs, legacy systems, and customer data come in every shape. You find the path from what the customer has to what the platform needs. * **Make it compound.** You turn field\-proven patterns into first\-class platform capabilities. You also push proven work down from agent reasoning into deterministic data lookups, the move where twenty tool calls become one. That's how we grow without turning into a services shop. * **Push back early.** When a spec was never vetted, an integration isn't supported, or scope quietly changed mid\-build, you raise it before the build pays for it. * **Raise the people around you.** Mentor the engineers on your use case and help set how the team builds. Write documentation good enough that a coding agent or a new hire could pick up your work. **You might be a great fit if you** ----------------------------------- * Have shipped and owned complex production systems end to end, with real users depending on them. * Have real experience building with LLMs and agents in production, or the engineering depth to get there fast. * Treat non\-deterministic systems with rigor. You know three runs of an agent is a feeling, not evidence. * Hold the near term and the long term at once: what a decision costs now, and what it makes easier or harder for the team later. * Are comfortable in the room with customers and clinicians. You'd rather understand the workflow than wait for a perfect spec. * Care about craft. Your systems fail loudly to you before they fail to a customer, and they keep working while you're on vacation. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Healthcare experience: EHR integrations (Epic, Oracle Health, athenahealth), HL7, FHIR, or clinical workflows. * Experience with Databricks, voice agents, or forward deployed or customer engineering. * Time at an early\-stage startup. **Why this role** ----------------- * **Stakes.** Your work runs inside health systems and touches patient care. * **Ownership, early.** You own whole use cases from the start. At a 35\-person company, scope arrives fast. * **Leverage.** What you build in the field becomes the platform. Few roles let you shape the product this directly. * **A clear path.** Our Applied AI ladder runs from Senior to Staff or Tech Lead. You move up by the kind of work you can be trusted to own, not by how much you ship. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. Compensation Range: $200K \- $260K

Your impact grows through the decisions and patterns the whole team builds on. * **A week built for deep work.** Collaborative in\-office sprints early in the week, a protected focus day on Thursday, and Friday to consolidate what we learned. **Benefits (available to Full\-Time Employees)** ================================================ **Health \& Wellness** ---------------------- * Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance * Daily catered lunch and dinner * Mental health support and wellness coaching * Flexible wellness stipend for fitness, therapy, or personal growth **Growth \& Development** ------------------------- * Annual learning budget for courses, books, or conferences * Conference attendance budget for professional development * Annual team offsite * Academic collaboration opportunities * Unlimited PTO **Our Core Values** =================== * **Patients Win, We Win** If patients aren't getting better care, we haven't earned the right to scale. Every internal decision gets pressure\-tested: does this make patients' lives better? If we can't draw the line, we question why we're doing it. * **High Standards, High Care** We hold a high bar for the team because patients are counting on us to get this right. But high standards only work with genuine investment in each other. You can take risks, admit mistakes, and challenge ideas. Not despite our standards, but because of them. * **Thoughtful Urgency** We move fast by default, but speed without judgment is recklessness. The discipline is knowing which decisions are reversible vs. not. In healthcare AI, the companies that win will be fast everywhere they can be and careful everywhere they must be. We build the muscle to do both. * **Intensely Measured** We instrument patient outcomes, provider ROI, system performance, and clinical accuracy. But data without action is surveillance. Every metric should have an owner, a threshold, and a response plan. If we're measuring something but never acting on it, we stop measuring it. **Who Builds With Us** ====================== * **Low ego:** Politics and territory don't interest you. The best ideas win, regardless of who has them. * **Direct:** You say the hard thing, challenge ideas openly, and commit fully once decided. * **High agency:** You thrive on trust rather than instruction. When you see something is broken, you fix it. You don’t file tickets and wait for someone else. * **Bar of excellence:** You hold yourself to a bar most people wouldn't, and you want teammates who do the same. * **Skeptical:** You push back on rules that don’t make sense and question assumptions that haven’t earned their place. jobs.title: UI/UX Engineer
jobs.description: **About Faex Health** Faex Health turns stool images into gut\-health insights. Our platform combines proprietary computer\-vision models, color\-density analysis, and Felix, our retrieval\-grounded AI assistant, to help people track changes over time and to support clinicians and researchers. Faex runs on iPhone and Android in 13 languages across multiple regions. Live features include Faex MD for clinicians, women’s health with a period tracker, a GLP\-1 gut\-health journey, and partner APIs connecting to care and research ecosystems. **The Role** We are hiring a UI/UX engineer who can both design and build. You will shape how people capture scans, understand their results, and talk with Felix, then write the production HTML and CSS that delivers that vision in our Django application. Our move to Bootstrap 5 has shipped; your first major project is building the Faex design system on that foundation and using it to redesign the path from sign\-up to first scan. You will work directly with our CTO and developers, and your work will ship to users on iPhone, Android, and the web. **What You Will Do** * **Design ownership.** Own design as we continue the redesign on our new Bootstrap 5 foundation, defining layout, navigation, typography, color, and components. You own design and the front\-end component library; our developers own implementation, connecting your components to application logic and data. * **Design.** Turn research and product goals into user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and high\-fidelity designs. * **Build what you design.** Write clean, responsive, accessible HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in Django templates, using Bootstrap 5 and a shared component library. * **Design system.** Create and maintain a Faex design system with reusable components, tokens, and usage guidelines that developers can apply consistently. * **Mobile\-first experience.** Design for our mobile apps, which wrap the web app, so screens feel native on iPhone and Android, including touch targets, gestures, and photo\-upload flows. * **Health data presentation.** Make complex health information clear and calm: scan results, scores, trends over time, and Felix conversations, without overstating what results mean. * **Products.** Design the clinician\-facing Faex MD dashboard, improve live experiences such as the GLP\-1 gut\-health journey and period tracker, and design new products such as Faex Infant and partner onboarding. * **Accessibility and localization.** Meet WCAG accessibility standards and make every screen work in all 13 languages the app ships in, including right\-to\-left Arabic and Japanese, Chinese, and Hindi scripts. * **Research and iteration.** Run usability tests, review analytics on where users drop off, and improve the path from sign\-up to first scan. * **Collaboration.** Work in our Git workflow with Azure Repos and Azure Boards, review front\-end changes, and partner with developers on implementation. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years designing digital products, with at least 3 years writing production front\-end code. * Expert HTML and CSS, including responsive layouts, Flexbox, Grid, and cross\-browser testing. * Strong Bootstrap experience, ideally Bootstrap 5\. * Working JavaScript skills for interactive components and front\-end behavior. * Proficiency in a modern design and prototyping tool such as Figma. * Experience building or maintaining a design system or component library. * Experience designing and building multilingual interfaces, including right\-to\-left (RTL) layouts and CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) text. * Solid knowledge of accessibility standards (WCAG) and mobile\-first design. * Comfort working with Git and with developers in a shared codebase. * A portfolio showing both your design work and front\-end code you wrote. * Comfortable working day to day with AI coding assistants (e.g., Claude Code, Kiro) and quick to pick up new tools as they change. * Ability to work in the Denver office three days per week. **Preferred Qualifications** * Familiarity with the Faex app or experience designing health, wellness, or medical products. * Experience with Django templates or other server\-rendered web frameworks. * Experience designing data visualizations, dashboards, or clinical interfaces. * Experience with web apps delivered inside native mobile wrappers. * Experience with user research, usability testing, and product analytics. **How We Work** * Small team, high ownership: you will take ideas from sketch to shipped code. * Evidence\-led: test with users and measure results before and after changes. * Clarity and care by default, since users are looking at sensitive health information. Pay: $75,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Greenwood Vlg, CO 80111

real\-time systems. * Multithreaded software. * Computer vision or AI/ML. * Hardware\-software integration. * Automated testing or simulation. * Git/GitHub and modern debugging or profiling tools. * jobs.description: Location: Remote Job Type: Contractor **Job Description** ------------------- Independent Contractor (1099\) Aegis Software is engaging experienced independent contractors to deliver FactoryLogix MES implementations for manufacturing customers, as demand for our software implementations grows. You'll act as the technical consultant on projects you accept: configuring, installing, deploying and integrating Aegis software so it meets the customer's business requirements and runs smoothly in their infrastructure or on a pre\-configured cloud instance. Engagements cover the whole implementation lifecycle, from needs assessment and planning through go\-live and handoff to support. This engagement is for an independent, self\-directed professional. You decide how and when the work gets done, solve complex deployment problems as they arise, and are accountable for results against each project's scope documents and success criteria. #### **Engagement Terms** * **Structure:** Individual independent contractor (1099\). A signed W\-9 is required before work starts. * **Length:** Ongoing, reviewed annually by both parties. * **Hours:** No fixed or minimum hours. Work is offered based on project demand, and you choose which projects to accept. * **Location:** Remote, anywhere in the United States. Customer site visits as projects require. * **Travel:** Up to 50% on accepted projects. Reasonable travel expenses are reimbursable as set out in the contractor agreement. * **Rate:** Paid per billable hour. Rate based on experience. * **Invoicing:** Monthly invoice for hours delivered, supported by the billable hours recorded in Aegis's project system. Payment terms per the contractor agreement. * **Agreement:** All terms are governed by a written Independent Contractor Agreement (ICA). **Scope of Work** ----------------- On each accepted project, deliverables are defined in the project's scope documents. Typical deliverables include: * **Customer requirements:** Work with customer executives and end users to understand their business needs and translate requirements into system configurations. * **Installation and configuration:** Install, configure and tailor the software to the customer's workflows, in line with the project's business goals. * **Integration and readiness:** Integrate the software with the customer's existing systems. Before deployment, provide clear guidance so validation and testing are completed ahead of rollout. * **Issue resolution:** Diagnose and resolve technical issues during and after implementation. When an issue can't be resolved right away, document the work done, collect logs and enter clear ticket notes so it can be driven to resolution. * **End\-user training:** Deliver training built around real\-world scenarios so users retain what they learn and adopt the system. Aegis training materials are available; you may adapt them to the customer's workflows. * **Documentation:** Produce implementation checklists, user guides, quick\-start guides, meeting agendas and similar project materials. Submit activity reports of completed work for customer sign\-off. * **Project coordination:** Coordinate with the Aegis Project Manager assigned to each project on milestones, deliverables and handoff to support. Technical escalations go to Aegis lead implementation engineers. * **Billable time records:** Record billable hours and reimbursable expenses in Aegis's project system so Aegis can invoice its customers. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 5\+ years in software implementation, MES/ERP deployment or related technical consulting, including at least two full\-lifecycle MES implementations * Working knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server (queries, scripts) * Experience deploying to or administering cloud environments (Azure or AWS) * Experience integrating MES with ERP systems and shop\-floor equipment * Strong troubleshooting skills: able to analyze system issues and determine how to resolve them * Excellent written and spoken communication with customers and internal teams * Ability to act as a trusted advisor who translates business needs into technical solutions * Proven ability to deliver independently with minimal oversight * Able to travel up to 50% on accepted projects #### **Preferred Qualifications** * Hands\-on FactoryLogix experience * Background in electronics (SMT/PCBA) or discrete manufacturing * Familiarity with machine connectivity standards * Prior independent contracting or consulting experience

hands\-on model API integration, context and retrieval design, tool use, and evaluation; n8n; MCP. * Python/FastAPI; TypeScript, Next.js, and React; PostgreSQL and SQL Server; Kafka or Redpanda event streaming; Neo4j; Podman or Docker; GitHub Actions; Grafana and Prometheus; LDAP/Active Directory; Azure; Azure DevOps or Jira. * Insurance or financial services systems and enterprise integration experience. **AI FLUENCY** ============== Directing AI agents is the default way you produce work on this team. jobs.description: Job ID 26WD101846 **Job Requisition ID \#** 26WD101846 **Principal Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** **Position Overview** Autodesk Technical Advisory is seeking a highly technical and customer\-focused **Embedded Engineer, AI Solutions** to join our new Embedded Engineering (forward\-deployed engineering) team. You will work directly alongside strategic Autodesk customers to discover high\-value workflows, model the **data** those workflows depend on, and build the **AI systems** for their Design \& Make workflows to enable customer’s measurable business outcomes. You will move fluidly from understanding a customer's workflow and architecture to writing code. You will spend your weeks writing production code to build agents and orchestration, retrieval and graph services, connectors and APIs \- inside customer environments, alongside customer engineers. What you ship is concrete: AI agents, MCP servers and tools, domain and semantic models, knowledge\-graph extensions, retrieval and context\-resolution pipelines, integrations into ERP, PLM, BIM, enterprise data platforms, and eval harnesses to move new capabilities into production. Unlike traditional project delivery, Embedded Engineering works deeply inside customer environments, connecting Autodesk technology and data with the rest of the enterprise. Insights developed through customer work will be translated into reusable agents, connectors, reference architectures, engineering patterns, and direct product feedback that shapes Autodesk's platform roadmap. The successful candidate combines strong software and AI engineering skills with curiosity, customer empathy, business judgment, and the ability to operate independently when the problem is not yet well defined. This role is engagement\-driven with travel **up to 75%** during active engagements, including extended periods working onsite with customers. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed below. **Responsibilities** **Discover Workflows and Own the Outcome** * Partner with customer executives, business leaders, and technical teams to translate transformation objectives, operational KPIs, sustainability commitments, and digital initiatives into measurable, AI\-enabled workflow outcomes. * Lead co\-innovation with customers to find high\-value workflows, decision bottlenecks, data requirements, and integration opportunities, turning ambiguous business challenges into clear technical directions. * Analyze end\-to\-end workflows across Autodesk and non\-Autodesk systems to pinpoint friction, process inefficiency, data gaps, and the places where AI and agents genuinely change the economics. * Own technical execution end\-to\-end \- rapid prototype through architecture, build, integration, testing, governance, production deployment guidance, and adoption \- with accountability for customer impact. * Sequence the work and decide what not to build. Make explicit trade\-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholder **Make Data and Context AI\-Ready** * Assess customer data readiness \- fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints \- required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows. * Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI\-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action. * Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality. **Build and Ship Production AI** * Design and build production\-grade AI\-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments. * Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on \- hybrid search, graph\-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely. * Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent behavior is testable before launch and monitored after it, and so that quality regressions and drift are caught in production rather than reported by users. * Apply strong engineering practices across architecture, code quality, security, permissions, reliability, observability, testing, performance, and maintainability, adapting quickly to complex and constrained customer environments. * Define the operating model for what you build \- runbooks, ownership, escalation, and cost \- and hand it over cleanly to customer tea  and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response. **Ideal Candidate** * **Ships.** Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved. * **Treats evaluation as part of the product.** Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling. * **Is fluent in both worlds.** Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non\-deterministic systems. * **Thinks in reusable patterns.** Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?” * **Moves fast without leaving a mess**. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade\-off deliberately. \#AC\-1 **Learn More** **About Autodesk** Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made. We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world. When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us! **Salary transparency** Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For U.S.\-based roles, we expect a starting base salary between $139,000 and $249,260\. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. Make explicit trade\-offs between scope, speed, and durability, and defend them to both customer and Autodesk stakeholders ### **Make Data and Context AI\-Ready** * Assess customer data readiness \- fragmented sources, ownership, quality, lineage, metadata, governance, permissioning, and integration constraints \- required to support trusted AI and agentic workflows * Structure and connect design intent, project, product, and asset data, along with requirements, supporting evidence, approvals, decisions, and dependencies, into trusted AI\-ready data and context models that enable reasoning, retrieval, and agentic action * Design ontologies, semantic layers, and knowledge graphs that business users recognize and agents can act on, including entity resolution across source systems, schema mapping, and permission models that survive contact with enterprise reality ### **Build and Ship Production AI** * Design and build production\-grade AI\-enabled workflows, agents, applications, and integrations that connect Autodesk products and platform capabilities with customers' broader enterprise technology environments * Build the retrieval and context layer these systems depend on \- hybrid search, graph\-grounded retrieval, tool interfaces, and MCP servers that expose governed enterprise context to agents safely * Make quality measurable. Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets, guardrails, tracing, and observability so that agent beh nd asset management, plus enterprise data platforms (data lakes, warehouses, Lakehouse, analytics platforms) * Constrained enterprise deployment: customer VPCs, private, on\-prem, or air\-gapped environments, data residency and sovereignty requirements, SSO/SCIM, and formal security review processes * AI\-native builder practice: routine use of AI coding agents, harnesses, and automation to multiply individual and team throughput, including spec\-driven development: writing clear specs and executable acceptance criteria for coding agents, keeping changes small and reviewable, and verifying AI\-generated code through automated tests and review Production trust and safety: prompt\-injection defense, permission\-aware retrieval, provenance and audit trails, versioning, staged rollout, monitoring, and incident response * **Ideal Candidate** * **Ships.** Has put things into production and can name the metric that moved * **Treats evaluation as part of the product.** Assumes agents will fail and builds evaluation, observability, and guardrails before scaling * **Is fluent in both worlds.** Understands the customer’s business process and the failure modes of non\-deterministic systems * **Thinks in reusable patterns.** Instinctively asks, “How does this become an asset for the next ten customers?” * **Moves fast without leaving a mess**. Knows when speed matters, when engineering rigor matters, and how to make that trade\-off deliberately **Learn More** **About Autodesk** Welcome to Autodesk! Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Enterprise Patch \& Vulnerability Management, this role leads the technical planning, orchestration, and execution of patch\-related changes and partners with BTS technology teams, Cybersecurity, Service Management, Change Management, Application Support, and Operating Unit Technology organizations to ensure patches, vulnerabilities, hardening items, and posture management findings are remediated in a timely manner aligned with established service level agreements (SLAs). The role is accountable for technical change orchestration and execution, AI\-based vulnerability and patch analysis, exception review, and incident escalation. Success requires deep technical breadth across enterprise platforms, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, operational discipline, and the ability to collaborate with and influence technical teams without direct authority. Key functions include but are not limited to:* **Technical Lead – Change Orchestration \& Execution**: Serve as the technical lead for patch\-related change orchestration and execution across **the enterprise**. Build and sequence automated deployment plans, maintenance windows, dependencies, and rollback procedures; prepare and submit change records; and lead technical execution and bridge coordination during enterprise maintenance events. Coordinate remediation across products onto shared maintenance windows so that systems are touched once rather than repeatedly, reducing end\-user disruption and change collisions. * **AI\-Based Vulnerability \& Patch Analysis**: Leverage AI\-enabled tools, analytics, and automation to analyze vulnerability scan data, threat intelligence, and patch release information; correlate findings to assets and service owners; predict deployment risk and service impact; identify remediation trends, recurring failures, and root causes; and produce data\-driven prioritization recommendations. Ensure AI\-generated outputs are validated and used in alignment with BTS security, data, and responsible AI standards. * **Exception Review \& Risk Validation**: Perform technical review of patch and vulnerability exception requests, validating business justification, compensating controls, residual risk, and remediation timelines. Provide technical recommendations to the Sr. Manager and Cybersecurity, track exceptions to expiration, and ensure exceptions are re\-evaluated and closed in alignment with governance expectations. * **Incident Escalation \& Response**: Act as the escalation point for patch\-related incidents, failed deployments, and service degradation following maintenance activities. Triage issues, engage appropriate resolver groups, coordinate rollback or remediation actions, escalate critical issues to technology leadership, and participate in post\-incident and problem management reviews to prevent recurrence. * **Offshore Execution Pod Technical Direction**: Provide day\-to\-day technical direction to the offshore execution pod, including remediation wave planning and handoffs, automated testing execution, ticket queue prioritization, evidence quality, and off\-hours execution readiness; review pod work for accuracy and completeness. * **Vu rtner with product owners to influence, prioritize, and drive code changes required to remediate vulnerabilities. Champion and leverage AI\-based tools to facilitate code analysis, development of remediation recommendations, and validation of proposed fixes, working with product owners to drive implementation within established remediation SLAs. * **Service Validation and Post\-Patch Checkout**: Lead tiered service health validation following remediation — from enterprise up/downs to basic and comprehensive automated validation — partnering with product owners and stakeholder teams who define what healthy looks like. Confirm operational readiness, capture remediation evidence, and implement new tests when disruption reveals gaps in coverage. * **Automation and Tooling**: Partner with SRE and DevOps team, Platform Engineering, and product owners to design, build, and enhance automated checkout and validation, remediation orchestration, deployment pipelines, and evidence collection using enterprise tools and scripting. * **Reporting and Compliance Support**: Review and analyze reporting prepared by the offshore execution pod on patch compliance, vulnerability aging, SLA adherence, deployment success rates, exception status, and incident trends, providing technical insight to support management and executive reporting. * **Documentation and Continuous Improvement**: Develop and maintain technical runbooks, standard operating procedures, and knowledge articles; identify opportunities to improve patching reliability, reduce deployment risk, and increase automation coverage. Qualifications: * Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline. * Equivalent experience and/or alternative qualifications will be considered. * 5\+ years of technical experience * 3\+ years of hands\-on experience in enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, systems engineering, or infrastructure operations * Experience leading technical execution of enterprise change and maintenance activities across multiple platforms * Hands\-on experience with patch and vulnerability tooling * Experience applying AI, analytics, or automation tools to operational or security data * Working knowledge of public cloud platforms and modern data, integration, platform engineering, DevOps, SRE, and cybersecurity practices. **Core Skills/Competencies:*** Patch Management Engineering (P) \- plans, sequences, and executes enterprise patch deployments safely and consistently. * Vulnerability Management (P) \- analyzes findings, prioritizes remediation, and drives SLA compliance. * Change Orchestration \& Execution (P) \- leads technical change planning, implementation, validation, and rollback across platforms. * AI and Data Analysis (P) \- applies AI\-based tools and analytics to vulnerability, patch, and operational data to inform prioritization and decisions. * Risk and Exception Analysis (P) \- evaluates exposure, compensating controls, and residual risk to support exception decisions. * Incident Management (P) \- triages, escalates, and coordinates resolution of patch\-related incidents. * Automation and Scripting (N) \- improves deployment reliability, reporting, and evidence collection. Additional Company Details: We do not accept unsolicited resumes from third party recruiting agencies or firms. The company offers a competitive compensation plan and robust benefits package for full time regular employees which for this role include: • Base Salary Range: $90,000 \- $127,600 • Benefits: Health, Dental, Vision, Life, Disability, Wellness, Paid Time Off, 401(k) and Profit\-Sharing plans. The actual salary for this position will be determined by a number of factors, including the scope, complexity and location of the role; the skills, education, training, credentials and experience of the candidate; and other conditions of employment. Sponsorship Details: Sponsorship not Offered for this Role

Collaborate with blue teams, purple teams, and broader security groups to stress\-test systems, validate detection mechanisms, and improve enterprise readiness. 10\. Plan, coordinate, and execute full\-lifecycle red team operations, including reconnaissance, command and control setup, lateral movement, and adversary emulation to simulate real\-world attacks and test organizational defenses. **Minimum Qualifications:** Education: BS Preferred Licensure, Certification \& Registration: Preferred to have certificates: * Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), OSCP, OSEP, or similar offensive security certifications * AI/ML security certifications Experience: • 3 – 5 \+ years of experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or red teaming * 1 – 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with AI/ML systems and frameworks Skills, Knowledge \& Abilities: • Expertise with red teaming tools (Kali Linux, Metasploit, Wireshark, Burp Suite, etc.) Preferred Qualifications \& Skills: * Understanding of machine learning fundamentals and model architectures * Experience with AI model interpretability \& automation tools * Traditional penetration testing and red team methodologies **Pay Range:** $125,000\.00 USD – $160,000\.00 USD The pay range listed for this position is the annual base salary range the organization reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this position at this time. jobs.title: Senior Backend & DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: **The role, at a glance:** The Senior Backend Engineer is a 3\-month contract position that develops cloud services, APIs, and infrastructure for Biamp’s audiovisual conferencing solutions used worldwide. This role centers on identity and access control, including the permission model, APIs, and workflows that determine what users can do across the platform. The initial priority is to use SpiceDB to replace fixed, organization\-wide roles with permission sets, groups, and grants that reflect customers’ organizational structures. **How you'll contribute:** * Design, build, and maintain backend microservices and APIs (REST, GraphQL, and gRPC), primarily in Go * Design and implement fine\-grained authorization (role\-, resource\-, and relationship\-based) using SpiceDB * Plan and carry out zero\-downtime, verifiably equivalent migrations of existing customer access to the new permission model * Build event\-driven services using messaging systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Design and maintain SQL database schemas, queries, and data migrations * Troubleshoot and improve the reliability, security, and performance of production services * Work with the Web, Embedded Software, Product Verification (QA), and Product Management teams to deliver features and resolve issues * Participate in code reviews and document designs and processes in Confluence * Other duties as assigned by Supervisor **A successful candidate should have:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience with AI agentic coding tools (such as Claude Code) as a core part of daily development, including directing agents through multi\-step tasks, reviewing and validating AI\-generated code, and building reusable skills and tool integrations (MCP) * 6\+ years of commercial software development, including backend services and cloud infrastructure * Proficiency in Go (Golang) and experience building microservices * Experience designing and building APIs, with GraphQL preferred. Exposure to REST or gRPC is also valuable * Experience with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or other Zanzibar\-style permission systems * Experience designing relationship\-based, hierarchical authorization models (ReBAC), including inherited and delegated access * Experience with SQL and relational databases * Experience working in Linux environments, including administration and shell scripting * Experience with agile development practices * Strong written and verbal communication skills, and the ability to work independently and in a team **Some nice\-to\-haves:** * Experience with Kubernetes, Docker * Experience with Zitadel, Auth0, or similar OIDC providers * Experience with SCIM provisioning and SSO identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID) * Experience with message systems such as NATS, Kafka, or RabbitMQ * Experience with Terraform for building and managing infrastructure * CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Bitbucket * Experience with Microsoft Azure **Tools \& Collaboration** Bitbucket, Jenkins, Docker, Azure Kubernetes Services, Terraform, Jira, and Confluence. **Work Environment:** This is a 3\-month, on\-site contract position. Biamp does not have a remote or hybrid work policy for this role. **Who is Biamp?** We make the world’s most extraordinary audio and video solutions. For over 50 years, Biamp has created and innovated professional audiovisual solutions that enable great communication. From the smallest of rooms to the largest of venues, we empower true human connection in every space. As we grow to meet our customers’ needs and evolve to address the challenges of tomorrow, one guiding principle remains the same: Biamp connects people through extraordinary audiovisual experiences. **About our company:** At Biamp, we believe the employment relationship should be reciprocal. We want you to love your job, and we want your expertise and knowledge to help drive our business forward. We champion a supportive and dynamic environment filled with passionate people who choose continuous improvement over perfection. We insist on clear, explicit decision making, believe in taking calculated risks, and celebrate tough decisions even when they don’t succeed. We look for people who desire the best from themselves and encourage the same from their coworkers. Our commitment to one another and to the common goal is the most consistent reliable path to recurring success for all of us.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Engineer (AI-Native)
jobs.description: Today we are a large health insurance agency selling coverage nationwide. We have grown through multiple market shifts, from Medicare Advantage to ACA plans, and built a team with many people who have been here for years. That's not an accident, and it's the thing we're most quietly proud of. We're not here to save the world. Health insurance is a complicated, often frustrating product to sell and service, and we don't pretend otherwise. We care about building something worth showing up to: a company where the work is real, people are treated well, and the clients we serve actually get helped. We also run a direct\-to\-consumer subscription e\-commerce business in a regulated category. Both businesses have outgrown off\-the\-shelf tools. As our first full\-time engineer, you'll work directly with the founder to build platforms that replace them and turn them into SaaS products we sell to other businesses. ### ### **What you will build** * A subscription commerce platform: product catalog, recurring billing with retries and dunning, order routing to fulfillment partners, shipment tracking, a customer self\-service portal, and the admin screens our team works in every day. * A multi\-tenant commission dashboard for insurance agencies, sold as a product: carrier commission statements in, clean numbers out for each agency, agent, and downline, covering revenue, chargebacks, persistency, payouts, and forecasts. * An AI sales assistant that works leads over SMS and turns them into customers: it qualifies, answers questions, handles objections, sends checkout links, and hands off to a human when needed. It plugs into both platforms and is also sold on its own. An early version exists; you will finish it or rebuild it. * The shared foundation under all three: auth and roles, tenant isolation, background jobs, webhooks, audit logs, and a design system. ### **What you bring** * 7\+ years building production web products, with at least 3 years of senior work before 2023\. * SaaS or e\-commerce products you built and shipped: checkout, subscriptions and recurring billing, orders and fulfillment, customer accounts. * Deep TypeScript, React, and Next.js; Postgres data modeling; typed APIs (tRPC or similar) with schema validation. * Multi\-tenant B2B SaaS: organizations, roles, data isolation enforced on the server, and subscription billing for your own customers. * Back\-end workflow experience: state machines, job queues, retries, webhooks that are safe to receive twice. * LLM features in production: prompt and tool design, testing conversations before they ship, guardrails, and keeping model costs under control. * Messaging and CRM integrations: SMS providers, CRMs such as GoHighLevel or HubSpot, and consent and opt\-out rules (TCPA, 10DLC). * Real third\-party integrations shipped, including messy data such as CSV or PDF files from partners. * Money and reporting you trust: you reconcile totals against the source system before you show a number. * A high bar for UI and UX. You design and build polished, original interfaces yourself: clear hierarchy, considered typography and spacing, every state handled (loading, empty, error), accessible, and fast. You can tell generic AI\-generated UI (default gradients, cards on everything, template layouts) from real design, and you do not ship it. Show us a portfolio of interfaces you designed. * Creative problem solving. When the obvious path is blocked (no API, messy data, a partner that won't cooperate, a budget that doesn't fit), you find a clever, practical way through instead of waiting for perfect conditions. * Daily, fluent use of AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar). You plan before you prompt, split work across agents by module, keep specs and handoff notes current, review every diff, and verify the running product before you call anything done. * Comfort with regulated data. You will shape the data model, workflows, and AI capabilities that help teams manage leasing, maintenance, payments, and accounting. ### **What You'll Do** * Build the data model and workflows for a property management operating system. * Develop AI systems that use property context to complete work, identify missing information, and escalate issues to people when needed. * Make practical engineering decisions in high\-stakes areas, including payments, financial records, and resident communications. * Ship software to users, learn from its limitations, and improve it based on feedback. ### **What We're Looking For** * Senior\-level, broad\-based software engineering experience spanning deployment, development, operations, and user adoption. * Experience at a startup or hypergrowth startup, with a track record of taking projects from problem definition through launch and iteration. * Experience building and shipping production software end to end, in a backend or full\-stack capacity. * Familiarity with TypeScript, Python, and PostgreSQL, or the ability to learn them quickly. * Experience with AI or LLM systems, payments, accounting, or property management software is relevant. * Ability to take ownership, learn quickly, and work effectively amid ambiguity. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $150,000 to $300,000 annually. You will work with research, operations, and external partners to turn complex needs into useful tools for creating, evaluating, and improving training data. ### **What You'll Do** * Develop tools for browsing environments, inspecting trajectories, reviewing task quality, and understanding model behavior. * Build partner workflows for creating, submitting, testing, and iterating on reinforcement learning environments and training data. * Create dashboards and observability tools for environment quality, evaluation results, data collection progress, and pipeline health. * Design backend services and APIs that connect task authoring, data collection, evaluation, quality review, and training systems. * Collaborate across research, operations, and go\-to\-market teams to ship and improve products. ### **What We're Looking For** * At least 3 years of full\-stack software engineering experience building and shipping production systems, with a technical field of study or equivalent technical foundation. * Proficiency in Python and a modern web stack such as React, TypeScript, or Next.js. * Hands\-on experience with AI, machine learning, or reinforcement learning, and experience owning products end\-to\-end from design through deployment. * Experience building backend services, APIs, and databases, along with cloud infrastructure, Docker, CI/CD, and production debugging. * Experience creating dashboards, monitoring or observability interfaces, and tools for data inspection, review, or quality assessment. * Experience with data collection, annotation, or evaluation platforms, or with AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or Grafana, is valuable. ### **Compensation \& Benefits** Base salary is $130,000 to $225,000 USD annually. Visa sponsorship and relocation support are available for eligible full\-time candidates moving to the United States or Singapore. ### **Location** On\-site in San Francisco, California. Remote candidates may be considered if they can maintain 70% to 80% time zone overlap with San Francisco or Singapore.

jobs.title: Assistant or Associate Professor, Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics
jobs.description: **Engineering a world of possibilities** Tenure\-Track Faculty Position in Power Electronics Assistant or Associate Professor Department of Electrical Engineering Colorado School of Mines The **Department of Electrical Engineering** at **Colorado School of Mines** invites applications for a tenure\-track faculty position at the Assistant or Associate Professor level in **Power Electronics**. The Department seeks candidates with a strong research and teaching record, or demonstrated potential for excellence, in power electronics and power conversion systems. Areas of particular interest include, but are not limited to: * Advanced power conversion and converter topologies; * Power electronics for renewable and distributed energy systems; * Grid\-connected and grid\-forming converters; * Energy storage interfaces and control; * Electrified transportation and electric\-vehicle power conversion; * Wide\-bandgap semiconductor\-based power conversion, including SiC and GaN technologies; * High\-power and high\-efficiency conversion systems; * Power electronics for microgrids, resilient grids, AI/data centers, aerospace, and industrial applications; * Modeling, simulation, control, and optimization of power\-electronic systems; and * AI/ML\-enabled design, optimization, diagnostics, and control of power\-electronic systems. Power electronics is a critical enabling technology for the modern electric grid and has important applications in renewable\-energy integration, energy storage, transportation electrification, microgrids, resilient infrastructure, data centers, and high\-efficiency industrial systems. The position will strengthen the interface between the Department's established expertise in power and energy systems and converter\-level technologies and will support Mines' strategic priorities in Energy and Sustainability, research excellence, workforce development, and industry engagement. **Responsibilities** The successful candidate will be expected to: * Establish and sustain a nationally and internationally recognized, externally funded research program in power electronics; * Develop interdisciplinary collaborations with faculty within Electrical Engineering and across Mines, as well as with national laboratories, industry, and external academic partners; * Teach undergraduate and graduate courses in areas such as power electronics, electric drives, renewable and distributed energy systems, electric circuits, and related Power and Energy Systems topics; * Develop and modernize undergraduate and graduate courses and laboratory experiences in power\-electronic converter design, modeling, simulation, control, hardware implementation, and testing; * Advise and mentor undergraduate researchers, Capstone Design teams, M.S. students, and Ph.D. students; * Cultivate and promote a collaborative and welcoming Mines community through recruiting, mentoring, and service; and * Contribute to professional, departmental, and university service appropriate to rank. **Minimum Qualifications** * A Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field by the anticipated start date; * Demonstrated expertise in power electronics or a closely related area; * Evidence of, or strong potential for, high\-quality research and scholarly impact; * Evidence of, or strong potential for, obtaining external research funding; * A commitment to excellence in undergraduate and graduate teaching and student mentoring; and * Strong communication and collaboration skills including the ability to engage, collaborate, and communicate effectively with students, faculty, staff, and external partners. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with experimental power\-electronics hardware and laboratory\-based research; * Expertise in advanced converter design, wide\-bandgap devices, high\-power conversion, transportation electrification, renewable\-energy interfaces, or grid\-forming technologies; * Experience applying AI/ML, optimization, digital twins, or data\-driven methods to power\-electronic systems; * A record of collaboration with federal agencies, national laboratories, or industry; * Experience developing new courses or laboratory experiences in power electronics; * Experience mentoring undergraduate and graduate researchers; and * For appointment at the Associate Professor level, an established record of externally funded research, scholarly impact, graduate advising, and academic leadership. * Demonstrated effective teaching ability at the university level and ability to teach courses in the Mines core curriculum. **About Mines \& The Department of Electrical Engineering** Colorado School of Mines, Colorado's oldest public university, produces talent, knowledge and solutions that serve industry and benefit society—all to create a more prosperous future. Mines enrollment includes 6400 undergraduate students and 1900 graduate students in a broad range of applied science and engineering disciplines. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About This Role** ------------------- As a Principal Software Engineer for Infrastructure, you will partner with teams across the company to help shape the technical direction of the compute, storage, and networking platforms that power Crusoe’s AI\-first cloud. This is a high\-leverage leadership role that spans the full infrastructure stack: you will work alongside engineers and stakeholders on the systems that help massive GPU clusters run AI and HPC workloads at extreme throughput, low latency, and high reliability. Your work spans the Linux kernel, hypervisors and virtualization, distributed storage, network fabrics, and the control planes that tie them together. You will be a trusted technical partner across the infrastructure stack, helping guide architecture decisions and mentoring engineers to raise our collective technical bar. You will look at the whole system alongside the teams who own each layer: how a storage tier, a scheduler, and a network fabric interact under a multi\-node training job, and where the real bottleneck sits. You will collaborate closely with Product, Hardware, and Infrastructure teams to build a reliable, scalable platform together that aligns with Crusoe’s mission to innovate sustainably. This is a full\-time position. **What You’ll Be Working On** ----------------------------- * **Infrastructure Strategy:** Partner with engineering, product, and leadership to help shape the long\-term direction for compute, storage, and networking, and to turn that direction into practical plans and milestones. * **Architecture \& Design:** Collaborate with teams on architecture reviews, design documents, and code reviews for critical infrastructure components and services across all three domains. * **Compute \& Virtualization:** Work with compute teams on the virtualization and orchestration layers that deliver bare\-metal\-class performance to GPU workloads, including hypervisor tuning, SR\-IOV, vDPA, virtio, device passthrough, and NUMA\- and topology\-aware scheduling. * **Storage Systems:** Work with storage teams on high\-throughput, low\-latency storage for training and inference pipelines, including distributed block, file, and object storage, NVMe and NVMe\-oF, RDMA\-based data paths, and checkpointing and data\-loading performance. * **Networking \& Fabric:** Partner with networking teams on architectures for GPU\-to\-GPU fabrics, high\-speed Ethernet, and specialized AI clusters, using technologies such as XDP, eBPF, DPDK, OVS/OVN, BGP, EVPN, and VXLAN. * **Kernel \& Driver Work:** Contribute to Linux kernel modules and high\-performance drivers across the network, storage, and device stack. * **Hardware Integration:** Work with Hardware teams on accelerators and offload devices, including GPUs, SmartNICs, DPUs, IPUs, and NVMe, from qualification through bring\-up of new platforms. * **Cross\-Stack Performance \& Reliability:** Team up with on\-call, SRE, and domain engineers to troubleshoot complex production issues that cross compute, jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, CAPE
jobs.description: Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster. We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI. We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services. If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe. **About the Role** We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to architect, design, and develop Cloud Infrastructure management systems and platforms. You'll deliver end\-to\-end use cases and workflows for a vertically integrated AI\-first Crusoe Cloud and play a crucial role in building systems that efficiently plan, monitor, deploy, and operate our infrastructure — directly contributing to key business revenue metrics. You'll be hands\-on implementing and building platforms, tools, and frameworks with a focus on reliability, scalability, operational efficiency, and ease of use. Your expertise will help streamline infrastructure planning and management processes as we scale Crusoe Cloud by 10X and beyond. **What You'll Be Working On** * Collaborate extensively across teams to design and implement physical infrastructure management software systems, availability platforms, and frameworks that meet the end\-to\-end needs of customers hosted on our AI infrastructure. * Contribute to the reliability, scalability, and security of our systems and platforms. * Develop workflows that drive efficiency and meet key business objectives and metrics. * Design and implement high\-performing, highly available cloud architectures optimized for both performance and cost\-effectiveness. * Streamline cloud deployment, configuration management, and operations by developing and maintaining effective platforms, interfaces, and automation tooling. * Actively contribute to the evolution of our platform by collaborating closely with cross\-functional development teams to ensure smooth integration and deployment. * Mentor junior engineers and contribute to team growth in collaboration with engineering managers. **What You'll Bring to the Team** * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering and 5\+ years of relevant industry experience. * 5\+ years of experience building and operating distributed systems at scale. * Proven experience with building reliable, scalable, efficient, and secure cloud platforms and systems and effectively running them in production environments. * Fluency in one or more programming languages such as Go, Rust, Java, or C\+\+. * A collaborative mindset when working with development and operations teams to build, maintain, and drive adoption of a robust platform. * A solid understanding of cloud security best practices and the ability to implement secure configurations. * Excellent troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills to tackle complex infrastructure challenges. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * A commitment to Crusoe's company values. **Bonus Points** * Hands\-on experience deploying, managing, and troubleshooting Kubernetes clusters. * Experience working in a fast\-paced startup environment. * A passion for building energy\-efficient, scalable AI infrastructure. * Enthusiasm for sustainability and clean energy innovation. **Benefits** * Industry competitive pay * Restricted Stock Units in a fast growing, well\-funded technology company * Health insurance package options that include HDHP and PPO, vision, and dental for you and your dependents * Employer contributions to HSA accounts * Paid Parental Leave * Paid life insurance, short\-term and long\-term disability * Teladoc * 401(k) with a 100% match up to 4% of salary * Generous paid time off and holiday schedule * Cell phone reimbursement * Tuition reimbursement * Subscription to the Calm app * MetLife Legal * Company paid commuter benefit; $300 per month **Compensation** Compensation will be paid in the range of $170,000 \- $205,000\. Restricted Stock Units are included in all offers. Compensation to be determined by the applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. jobs.description: We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time. **Position Summary** As a **Senior Software Development Engineer** at Aetna, you will play a critical leadership role in the design, development, and continuous enhancement of enterprise\-scale Provider Applications. You will drive technical solutions for complex business problems, ensure application stability, and lead cross\-functional initiatives as a Project Owner. This role requires a balance of hands\-on engineering expertise, technical leadership, and delivery ownership, including overseeing vendor/contractor teams, ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture, and delivering high\-impact solutions that improve provider data systems and operational efficiency. **Required Qualifications** * 5\+ years of hands\-on application development experience with Appian Development, java, Python and GCP * 2\+ years of experience leading or contributing to large\-scale application development initiatives **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience working in Agile/SCRUM environments * Proven experience in project/program management, including planning, execution tracking, and delivery management * Strong organizational, leadership, and planning skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities * Experience working with distributed teams and cross\-functional stakeholders * Prior exposure to provider data systems, healthcare platforms, or payer environments * Demonstrated expertise in cloud\-native architectures, integration patterns, and messaging systems * Strong analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and automation **Education** * Bachelor’s degree or, equivalent experience (HS diploma \+ 4 years relevant experience) **Anticipated Weekly Hours** 40**Time Type** Full time**Pay Range** The typical pay range for this role is: $83,430\.00 \- $166,860\.00 This pay range represents the base hourly rate or base annual full\-time salary for all positions in the job grade within which this position falls. jobs.description: Senior Director, AI Engineering \-Agentic AI Platform(Remote Eligible) At Capital One, we are creating responsible and reliable AI systems, changing banking for good. For years, Capital One has been an industry leader in using machine learning to create real\-time, personalized customer experiences. Our investments in technology infrastructure and world\-class talent — along with our deep experience in machine learning — position us to be at the forefront of enterprises leveraging AI. From informing customers about unusual charges to answering their questions in real time, our applications of AI \& ML are bringing humanity and simplicity to banking. We are committed to continuing to build world\-class applied science and engineering teams to deliver our industry leading capabilities with breakthrough product experiences and scalable, high\-performance AI infrastructure. At Capital One, you will help bring the transformative power of emerging AI capabilities to reimagine how we serve our customers and businesses who have come to love the products and services we build. **Team Description:** The Intelligent Foundations and Experiences (IFX) team is at the center of bringing our vision for AI at Capital One to life. We work hand\-in\-hand with our partners across the company to advance the state of the art in science and AI engineering, and we build and deploy proprietary solutions that are central to our business and deliver value to millions of customers. Our AI models and platforms empower teams across Capital One to enhance their products with the transformative power of AI, in responsible and scalable ways for the highest leverage impact. **What You’ll Do:** * Partner with a cross\-functional team of engineers, research scientists, technical program managers, and product managers to deliver AI\-powered products that change how our associates work and how our customers interact with Capital One. * Oversee the design, development, testing, deployment, and support AI software components including foundation model training, large language model inference, similarity search, guardrails, model evaluation, experimentation, governance, and observability, etc. * Make high judgment build\-vs\-buy decisions across a broad stack of Open Source and SaaS AI technologies such as AWS Ultraclusters, Huggingface, VectorDBs, PyTorch, and more. * Invent and introduce state\-of\-the\-art foundation model optimization techniques to improve the performance — scalability, cost, latency, throughput — of large scale production AI systems. * Contribute to the technical vision and the long term roadmap of foundational AI systems at Capital One. * Attract and retain top talent in the AI industry and nurture personal and professional development for your team. Foster a culture of learning and staying abreast of the state\-of\-the\-art in AI. * Define and drive enterprise\-wide AI strategy, aligning product, research, risk, and data organizations around shared technical and ethical principles * Establish a multi\-year roadmap for scalable, reliable, and compliant AI systems that serve as shared infrastructure across the enterprise * Champion Responsible\-AI, ensuring ethical, transparent and explainable model practices are embedded in all lines of business * Oversee the scaling of AI operations \- including model lifecycle management, observability, and cost efficiency \- across hundreds of production use cases **The Ideal Candidate:** * You love to build systems, take pride in the quality of your work, and also share our passion to do the right thing.
