jobs.title: Consulting Data & AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Consulting Data \& AI Engineer **Department:** Professional Services\- Systems **Reports To:** Director of Professional Services Systems **Job Summary:** The Consulting Data \& AI Engineer is a key position on our Professional Services team that designs, develops, implements, and maintains data and artificial intelligence (AI) solutions for clients. While working in fast\-paced environments, the position’s primary focus is to deliver data engineering, integration, analytics, and AI\-enabled application projects, and interface with clients to help them address business needs through practical, secure, and maintainable technology solutions. **Essential Functions:** * Implement best\-in\-class data and AI technology projects that address client business needs. * Consult with clients to understand business objectives, existing data environments, and technical requirements; translate those needs into effective solution designs. * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines, integrations, data models, and ETL/ELT processes that make client data reliable, accessible, and useful. * Develop and optimize SQL queries, database structures, and data solutions that support reporting, analytics, and AI\-enabled applications. * Connect AI capabilities to client data sources, APIs, applications, and business systems while considering security, privacy, and access controls. * Evaluate AI use cases, build prototypes or proofs of concept, and test solutions for accuracy, reliability, performance, and business value. * Communicate both big\-picture business drivers and technical details throughout projects. * Estimate project effort, identify risks and dependencies, communicate project status, and help ensure solutions are delivered within agreed scope and timelines. * Provide client assistance by troubleshooting technical issues and collaborating with internal and vendor technical resources until a solution is reached. * Document solution designs, data flows, configurations, and implementation procedures to support ongoing maintenance and knowledge transfer. * Attend vendor training, conferences, webinars, and continuing education to maintain current knowledge of relevant technology and research industry best practices. * Gain and maintain certifications in areas of expertise. * Advocate positive culture and collaborate with team members to share knowledge, reusable tools, and best practices. * Provide feedback to executive and technical teams to participate in functionality roadmap planning and the continued development of CAIT’s data and AI services. * Benchmark, analyze, report on, and make recommendations for the improvement and growth of professional and managed services technology offerings. * Identify opportunities to improve client outcomes and support revenue growth through additional data, analytics, automation, and AI solutions. * Meet established project delivery, client service, and billable\-hour expectations. * Perform other tasks as needed or requested. **Education and Experience:** * 7\+ years of related experience in data engineering, software engineering, analytics engineering, business intelligence, or a related technology discipline required. * Demonstrated experience designing, developing, and supporting data pipelines, data integrations, data models, or data\-intensive applications. * Strong SQL skills and experience with relational databases, data warehousing, and ETL/ELT processes. * Experience developing and deploying technical solutions in cloud or enterprise environments. * Programming experience in one or more languages used for data engineering such as Python, SQL, Rust, or similar. * Experience with Microsoft cloud and data technologies, such as Azure, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, Databricks, or related services, preferred. * Experience with large language models (LLMs), generative AI, AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), embeddings, or vector search preferred. * Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred; equivalent practical experience may be considered. * Certifications are highly encouraged, especially in data, cloud, software development, and AI technologies. **Desired Qualifications/Skills:** * Client\-facing communication and soft skills to work with management, client technology teams, end users, and technical vendors on technical issues as they relate to projects or client needs. * Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and business implications to technical and nontechnical audiences. * The ability to create lasting relationships with client technology teams. * An entrepreneurial mindset with an understanding of revenue growth as a business driver. * Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, troubleshooting, and attention\-to\-detail skills. * High level of self\-motivation and accountability. * Ability to manage multiple priorities and add value under the pressure of time constraints in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. * Ability to learn new technologies, research industry best practices, and recommend practical solutions. * Ability to travel in various capacities, including but not limited to client sites, training seminars, trade shows, and corporate events. * Ability to work in an environment that may require sitting for extended periods of time and dexterity of hands and fingers to operate a computer keyboard and mouse. **Benefits \& Perks:** We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our team members both personally and professionally, including: * 401(k) retirement plan with employer match * Opportunities for quarterly bonuses (variable pay) * Paid time off and volunteer time off * Medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees and eligible dependents * 100% company\-paid life insurance and short\-term and long\-term disability insurance * Flexible spending accounts and health savings accounts * Career development and advancement opportunities * Professional development and training opportunities * Company\-paid vendor certifications and training * Mentorship and opportunities to work on diverse projects * Hybrid and flexible work arrangements, depending on the position and business needs * Wellness and financial resources * A culture\-rich organization with a family\-valued atmosphere. A full summary of available benefits is provided during the interview and onboarding process.

jobs.title: Engineering Director
jobs.description: **Engineering Director** **College Board –** Technology **Location:** This is a remote role. All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes. **Role Type**: Full\-time position **About the Team** Team Observatory is a high\-performing, self\-organizing group of technologists focused on building and operating mission\-critical score reporting systems and insights platforms that serve College Board’s Student community for CRA/AP Programs and the Bluebook platform. The work demands operational excellence, accuracy, and resilience at scale, while also requiring the team to continuously adapt to evolving business needs, technologies, and platforms. As College Board advances its 2027 strategy, this team is at the center of a multi\-year transformation toward a consolidated, authentic Bluebook platform. The team balances the delivery of today’s critical capabilities with the exploration and adoption of new technologies, modern architectures, and AI\-enabled solutions that will shape the future of score reporting. **About the Opportunity** As an Engineering Director, you will lead a high\-impact team responsible for delivering and operating systems that are foundational to College Board’s mission. This is an opportunity to lead in a dynamic, evolving environment where reliability, scale, and innovation must coexist. You will guide your team through a changing technology and business landscape—balancing the demands of mission\-critical score reporting with the opportunity to modernize platforms, adopt emerging technologies, and contribute to College Board’s long\-term Bluebook strategy. You will be expected to deliver results today while helping position the organization for what comes next. In this role, you are a catalyst and force multiplier: setting direction, removing obstacles, and enabling engineers to do their best work. You will bring clarity to ambiguity, translate strategy into execution, and build strong partnerships across product, architecture, data, and business teams. Your leadership will directly influence how College Board evolves its student score reporting capabilities into a scalable, secure, and unified platform. This role offers meaningful growth—for you and for the team. As College Board continues its journey toward a consolidated Bluebook platform, team scope, responsibilities, and technical challenges will evolve. You will play a key role in shaping that evolution while fostering a culture of learning, experimentation, and continuous improvement. In this role, you will: **Lead and Manage the team (40%)** * Lead a team of approximately eight engineers, responsible for building and operating student score reporting systems. * Set a clear vision and priorities for the team, track progress against goals, and provide coaching and feedback to support high performance and growth. * Foster an inclusive, high\-achieving culture where team members are engaged, supported, and able to do their best work. * Build effective team structures and plan for evolving skill and capacity needs as product scope and platform strategy grow. * Develop and leverage the strengths of individual team members to deliver high\-quality, scalable solutions using cloud and AI\-enabled technologies. * Support diversity and inclusion across perspectives, skills, and experiences. * Consistently model College Board’s Operating Principles and Manager Expectations in daily leadership practices. **Strategic Partnership \& Technical Communication (30%)** * Partner with business and technology stakeholders to clarify score reporting needs, constraints, and opportunities across student audiences. * Build trusted relationships with product, data, and engineering leaders to align priorities across complex, interdependent systems. * Communicate technical concepts clearly to diverse audiences, enabling informed decision\-making and shared understanding. * Act as a technology partner in advancing AI\-enabled capabilities that enhance score reporting, insights, and operational efficiency. * Drive engineering excellence through design reviews, shared standards, and constructive technical debate. * Balance scope, impact, and effort to deliver meaningful value while recognizing diminishing returns. Collaborate closely with Solutions Architects, Senior and Lead Engineers, and Data Leads to evaluate features, estimate effort, and plan delivery. * **Discovery, Definition \& Delivery (30%)** * Develop a deep understanding of the business problems your team supports and translate them into clear technical direction. * Lead Agile (and post\-Agile) delivery practices, ensuring clarity of priorities, disciplined execution, and sustained delivery momentum. * Guide technical decision\-making by evaluating solution options, balancing tradeoffs, and acting as an arbiter when needed. * Partner w taining reliable services throughout their lifecycle. * Lead the identification, triage, and resolution of production issues to maintain system stability and reliability. * Continue to learn and keep abreast of developments in Generative AI software, sharing that knowledge within the team to support best practices **About You** * 10\+ years of experience in software engineering, including building and operating secure, data\-intensive, cloud\-based systems. * Demonstrated success leading engineering teams to deliver complex products, services, or platform capabilities at scale. * Hands\-on experience managing or owning web applications, ideally a user\-facing portal, with a working knowledge of the security and infrastructure considerations that come with them, such as authentication, access controls, web application firewalls, and hosting environments. * Strong people\-management experience, including coaching, performance management, and career development. * Proven ability to plan, prioritize, and execute in fast\-paced, evolving environments. * Solid technical judgment with experience reviewing designs, guiding architectural decisions, and partnering with senior engineers. * Experience with modern cloud architectures; familiarity with AI integrations is a plus. * Ability to influence engineering strategy and decision\-making across teams and leadership levels. * Calm, thoughtful leadership under pressure, with a focus on outcomes and continuous improvement. * Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to translate between business and technical contexts. **All roles at College Board require:** * A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission\-driven work * Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI\-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively. * Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal * A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input. * A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data\-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking. * A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success * Authorization to work in the United States **About Our Process** * Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days. * While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, a performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership, and reference checks. **What We Offer** At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck — we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We're a self\-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market. **A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation** * The hiring range for this role is $140,000 – $175,000\. * Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board. * We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data. * We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live. You'll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it's like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more. \#LI\-EA \#LI\-Remote

pipelines, and work or a portfolio you can demonstrate * Ability to read AI research and white papers with high comprehension * Experience with retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) or graph RAG Dependency management best practices (e.g., npm or pnpm, uv or pip, Cargo; lockfiles, pinned versions and regular updates) * Strong skills in Python, Node.js (TypeScript) and Rust, with REST API design experience (e.g., FastAPI) * Working experience with PostgreSQL and SQLite, including schema migrations (e.g., SQLAlchemy, Alembic) * Docker or Podman basics * Test\-first development (e.g., pytest, Vitest) * Data hygiene, including safe handling of secrets and data * Ability to work across frontend and backend within the same feature and to communicate trade\-offs clearly * Ability to take UX/UI designs and implement them faithfully * Experience working in an Agile team Professional Competencies:* Apply excellent analytical and problem\-solving skillsCommunicate technical concepts inaccuracies, and communicate AI\-driven insights clearly and responsibly to peers and managers. * Workplace Standards * Strictly adhere to safety requirements * Maintain regular and punctual jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **APPLY** --------- **Senior AI Engineer** \[Onsite] **No Visa Sponsorship is available for this position.** **This position is 100%** **on\-site** **and located on the Cornell University Campus in Ithaca, New York.** **About Information Technology at Cornell** Information Technology (IT) is a strategic enabler for many functions at Cornell University, with staff located across colleges, administrative units, and campuses throughout the institution. While comprised of many organizations, IT operates as one partnering closely with faculty, staff, and students to support teaching, research, and business operations. By being embedded where the Cornell community is, IT is well positioned to provide support ranging from day‑to‑day needs to large, complex initiatives that advance major academic, research, and operational objectives across the university. Check out this link to find out more about IT@Cornell **What will you do:** The **Senior AI Engineer** serves as the technical lead for the AI Engineering team, providing expert‑level guidance, architectural leadership, and hands‑on development in support of Cornell’s enterprise AI services. This role is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining complex production‑grade AI applications and systems, ensuring they meet the highest standards of security, scalability, and reliability. The Senior AI Engineer mentors developers and technical leads, establishes engineering best practices, and ensures AI projects remain on the correct technical trajectory throughout the development lifecycle. This position directs and evaluates advanced AI solutions, leads the development and enhancement of enterprise AI systems, and formulates standards and methodologies that shape how AI applications are built across the university. The Senior AI Engineer collaborates closely with the Principal Solutions Architect for the AI Platform to define patterns and reference architectures that ensure all AI Innovation Lab applications are production‑ready and aligned with Cornell’s secure AI infrastructure. The role applies deep technical expertise across Generative AI technologies, API development, authentication and identity protocols, and cloud‑native architectures. It also integrates AI Innovation Lab services with Cornell enterprise systems using standards such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML, JWT, LDAP, and Microsoft identity services. Additionally, the Senior AI Engineer develops or refines procedures to address the most complex challenges related to system capacity, operational constraints, and distributed AI system performance. As a senior leader within the AI Innovation Lab, the Senior AI Engineer provides technical direction to project teams—including project managers, business analysts, subject‑matter experts, developers, and quality‑assurance specialists—ensuring that solutions are well‑designed, well‑implemented, and aligned with institutional strategy. While position responsibilities vary, every member of our community is expected to foster a culture of belonging and a healthy work environment by communicating across differences; being cooperative, collaborative, open, and welcoming; showing respect, compassion, and empathy; engaging and supporting others regardless of background or perspective; speaking up when others are being excluded or treated inappropriately; and supporting work/life integration of oneself and others. **What We Need** * A **resume** is required for further consideration for this position. We also recognize a lawful preference in employment practices for Native Americans living on or near Indian reservations in accordance with applicable law. 2026\-11\-05 ### **About Us** Cornell University is an innovative Ivy League university and a great place to work. jobs.title: Senior Manager of Applied AI Engineering
jobs.description: OVERVIEW: The Senior Manager, Applied AI Engineering will play a key leadership role in establishing and growing the Firm's Applied AI Engineering function. This position offers an opportunity to help shape how Cravath develops and deploys innovative AI solutions that enhance legal workflows, improve business operations, and create meaningful value across the Firm. The Senior Manager will lead a team responsible for designing, developing, and delivering AI\-powered applications, intelligent workflows, automations, and integrations. Combining hands\-on technical expertise with strong leadership and product thinking, this individual will help translate emerging AI capabilities into practical, secure, and scalable solutions. RESPONSIBILITIES: **Key Responsibilities** * Builds and leads the Applied AI Engineering function, helping establish its technical direction, engineering standards, development practices, and long\-term capabilities; * Manages, mentors, and develops a growing team of engineers and technical specialists; * Partners with the Firm’s PMO, Innovation, legal practices, business stakeholders, and other IT teams to identify and evaluate AI opportunities, assess technical feasibility, develop solution concepts, and contribute to the Firm's AI roadmap and project prioritization; * Leads the architecture, design, development, and deployment of AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, automations, and integrations supporting the Firm's legal and business operations; * Maintains a hands\-on role in technical discovery, prototyping, architecture, code review, and solving complex engineering challenges while providing leadership and direction to the team; * Develops reusable AI services, integration capabilities, evaluation frameworks, and engineering patterns that accelerate development and support solutions across the Firm; * Evaluates emerging AI technologies, models, platforms, and development approaches, recommending opportunities to build, integrate, or extend capabilities based on business value, technical feasibility, and risk; * Collaborates closely with Information Security, Enterprise Applications, Data Engineering, Infrastructure, and other technology teams to ensure solutions integrate effectively with the Firm's environment and meet its standards for security, confidentiality, reliability, and maintainability; * Establishes practices for AI solution quality, testing, monitoring, performance, cost management, and responsible use, including appropriate human oversight and safeguards; * Guides the technical lifecycle of AI solutions, from initial development through production deployment, ongoing enhancement, and support, working with business and IT stakeholders to establish appropriate long\-term ownership and operational arrangements; * Fosters a culture of innovation, collaboration, experimentation, and continuous improvement while maintaining the engineering discipline required in a sophisticated legal environment; and * Performs additional duties and special projects, as assigned. QUALIFICATIONS: **Qualifications** * Minimum of 7\-10 years of hands\-on experience in software engineering, solution architecture, or related technology disciplines in large enterprise environments, including 3\+ years managing software engineers and demonstrated leadership of complex technical initiatives; * At least 1\-2 years’ experience building and deploying production AI\-enabled applications, including generative AI solutions, retrieval\-augmented generation, AI agents, and related technologies; * Strong hands\-on engineering background, including Python or comparable programming languages, APIs, cloud platforms, databases, enterprise integrations, and modern software development practices; * Demonstrated ability to lead and mentor technical professionals, manage competing priorities, and deliver complex solutions in collaboration with multidisciplinary teams; * Strong product\-oriented thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to translate business needs into practical technical solutions; * Understanding of enterprise security, data privacy, AI governance, and the challenges of deploying AI in environments with sensitive information; * Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior leaders, technical teams, and nontechnical stakeholders; * Experience in a law firm, professional\-services organization, or other complex enterprise environment is preferred but not required; * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; and * Availability to work additional hours, as needed. This position is located in our New York office, and currently has a hybrid work schedule, but that is subject to change. The estimated salary range for this position is $190,000 to $230,000\. The actual salary offered will be based on a wide range of factors, including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and where applicable, licensure or certification obtained. Market and Firm factors are also considered. In addition to base salary and discretionary bonus(es), we offer a generous employee benefits package including, but not limited to, paid time off, medical, dental, vision care, 401(k) and substantial health club discounts.

jobs.title: SENIOR ENGINEER WATER RESOURCES
jobs.description: Job Posting: Senior Engineer Project Management (Specialist) Department of Water Resources JC\-536699* Senior Engineer Project Management (Specialist) SENIOR ENGINEER WATER RESOURCES $11,437\.00 \- $14,315\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **12/21/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** **Why Choose Us:** This position offers an exciting opportunity to participate in the development and execution of the Department of Water Resources’ (DWR) public works construction contracts for all the right reasons. These contracts are essential to DWR’s managing of California’s water resources, systems, and infrastructure, including the State Water Project, in a responsible and sustainable way. You’ll be at the frontline leading complex, high\-visibility infrastructure projects that shape California’s water future. DWR received new authorities to execute these contracts using Collaborative Delivery Methods such as Design\-Build and Construction Manager / General Contractor (CM/GC) and this position will play a key role in implementing these new processes. In addition to taking an exciting and rewarding career path, by joining DWR you will contribute to future generations in a workplace environment that embraces diversity and one that takes its environmental stewardship seriously. And, you will become part of the DWR Team, which is a world class safety organization. At DWR you will have the advantage of numerous resources to support your work and your professional growth—including training, organizational memberships, and knowledgeable and professional colleagues all of which collaborate for project success. You’ll enjoy flexible scheduling and a balanced workload with a permanent\-intermittent schedule. We hope you’ll check out the Duties and Desirable Qualifications below and apply for this great career opportunity to join our State Water Project team and help deliver water to over 27 million Californians as well as contribute to protecting our environment and species conservation efforts. Join a team of highly motivated professionals that are doing exciting engineering work! State Water Project Aerial Tour 2021: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=7A1jHyfqp8E **This is a Permanent\-Intermittent position with a maximum of 1,500 hours of work per calendar year.** Enjoy a flexible schedule that supports work\-life balance, with opportunities to structure your time to allow extended weekends and personal flexibility. **What You’ll Gain:*** Hands\-on leadership experience delivering major water infrastructure projects. * Deep knowledge of collaborative delivery methods and public works contracting. * Opportunities to mentor and collaborate with engineers statewide. * A balanced schedule and supportive team culture. **Duties:** Under general direction of the Section Manager, the incumbent serves as a non\-supervisory specialist performing project management duties on a wide variety of civil engineering related design and construction projects, studies, purchase contracts for State Water Project (SWP) facilities, Delta flood\-control facilities, and other facilities and locations as required. The incumbent will also oversee consultants supporting the Project Management and Coordination Section. You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**. ### **Position Details** **Job Code \#:** JC\-536699 **Position \#(s):** 843\-320\-3261\-900 **Working Title:** **Senior Engineer Project Management (Specialist)** **Classification:** SENIOR ENGINEER WATER RESOURCES $11,437\.00 \- $14,315\.00 A New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **\# of Positions:** 1 **Work Location:** Sacramento County **Telework:** Hybrid **Job Type:** Permanent Intermittent \- 1500 Hours ### **Department Information** **Division of Engineering, Program \& Project Delivery, Project Management Branch, Project Management Coordination Section, Sacramento** Department of Water Resources (DWR) was established in 1956 by the California State Legislature. We manage California’s water resources, systems, and infrastructure, including the State Water Project, in a responsible sustainable way. At DWR, we are embedding climate change response into every project we undertake. We have set standards to help evaluate how each project incorporates climate resilience principles and ensure consistency across the Department. Our mission is to sustainably manage the water resources of California, in cooperation with other agencies, to benefit the state’s people and protect, restore, and enhance the natural and human environments. DWR also strives to create a trusting and welcoming workplace where employees embrace diverse viewpoints  ect management duties, which will require the incumbent to work cooperatively with others, maintain regular and consistent attendance, and exercise good judgment. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required. The scope of responsibilities of this position involves a broad working knowledge of civil engineering; design of hydraulic structures and pipelines; soil mechanics and foundations; applicable design and building codes; environmental permitting and statutes, and civil design computer applications. ### **Benefits** Click here to read about some of the benefits available to eligible employees. **Personal Leave Program 2025:** Effective July 1, 2025, state employees are subject to temporary wage reductions in exchange for Personal Leave Program (PLP) accruals. jobs.title: QA Automation Engineer
jobs.description: DRB (A Vontier Company) is the leading provider of technology\-enabled devices and software solutions to the North American car wash industry. WHY WE DO IT: To fuel our client’s growth with connected, data\-led technology, driven by our spirit of innovation and commitment to excellence. JOB PURPOSE: The Quality Assurance Automation Engineer I is a key contributor to ensuring overall hardware and software quality through proven test automation practices. The role includes working closely with QA analysts, business partners, product owners and development teams to test and evaluate hardware and software to ensure compliance with requirements. Creates automated tests to ensure hardware and software meets user needs. Creates and logs software defects found while testing. Applies an analytical approach to job duties and has a willingness to be coached and mentored in higher level QA concepts. ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS \& RESPONSIBILITIES To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each of these essential functions at a satisfactorily level. Other essential and non\-essential functions may be assigned. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. * Apply defined QA processes to plan, design, implement, execute, evaluate, and report results of automated software and hardware testing. * Collaborates on story writing, establishing acceptance criteria and associated automated test scripts. * Works closely with developers/business analysts on the team to create test cases that ensure comprehensive coverage of positive and negative test cases against requirements. * Creates, executes, analyzes test results for accuracy and compliance for automated test suites, plans, and cases under guidance of senior team members. * Identifies or creates test data input based on specifications; determines output based on business rules. * Logs issues and system bugs in test management tool with appropriate detail and severity level. * Participates in team or project meetings providing input based on QA best practice and procedure. * Ability to adapt to changing projects and changing priorities. * Ability to meet stated milestone dates and deadlines. * Assist in set\-up and maintenance of automated test lab and environments. * Review and approves product documentation, test plans, etc. for technical accuracy. * Performs all other duties as assigned by Management. MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: EDUCATION PREFERRED: Bachelor’s degree, associate degree or trade school program graduate focusing on Computer Science, Data, Engineering or Management Information Systems. EXPERIENCE PREFERRED: 0 to 2 years in a quality assurance testing role or internship experience with a focus on technology systems. CERTIFICATIONS PREFERRED: Foundational level testing certification from ISTQB or similar organization. Skill Sets: * Knowledge of the application(s) and/or data being tested. * Basic hardware and software testing knowledge. * Must be able to learn practical and theoretical automated testing techniques. * Basic to intermediate proficiency in programming languages, test automation tools and frameworks. * Asks questions and collaborates with others for change. * Able to work under deadlines in a changing environment. * Strong communication and troubleshooting skills. jobs.title: AI PC Performance Engineer
jobs.description: **AI PC Performance Engineer** Dell's Client Product Group (CPG) is seeking an AI Performance Engineer to join the PC Systems Performance team. In this role, you will build foundational expertise in system\-level performance engineering by using AI and working alongside senior engineers to optimize the design of next\-generation PC platforms. You'll tackle performance characterization, power efficiency, thermal optimization, and acoustic tuning across mobile and desktop systems. Our team thrives on creativity and enjoys significant design freedom to bring the latest technologies into Dell's award\-winning consumer and commercial products. **What you’ll achieve:** As an AI PC Performance Engineer, you will work at the forefront of technology, driven by a team that has a passion for innovation, harnessing each other's strengths, \& radiates a strong sense of camaraderie. Join us to do the best work of your career and make a profound social impact as an **AI** **PC Performance Engineer** on our **PC Systems Performance** team in **Austin, Texas**. **You will:** * Contribute to developing autonomous tools for the execution of performance benchmarks, lab automation, and system characterization tests on PC platforms. * Develop/apply AI\-assisted tools to analyze performance data to identify optimization opportunities and present findings with clear visualizations and recommendations * Collaborate with performance architects, firmware teams, and product managers to drive performance strategy and deliver competitive solutions * Learn performance engineering fundamentals including benchmarking methodologies, power efficiency, thermals, and competitive analysis * Perform hands\-on technical work including test system setup, hardware configuration, and basic troubleshooting **Take the first step towards your dream career** Every Dell Technologies team member brings something unique to the table. Here’s what we are looking for with this role: **Essential Requirements** * Proficiency with Windows operating systems, system configuration, and BIOS interfaces * Understanding of PC hardware (CPUs, GPUs, memory, storage, thermals) and how components impact system performance * Detail\-oriented, self\-motivated, and organized—able to manage test runs independently and maintain accurate records * Comfortable with data tools (AI Harnesses, Excel, Vibe code, Python, SQL) and hands\-on technical work (hardware assembly, configuration, troubleshooting) * Strong communication and collaboration skills; ability to present technical findings and work effectively across teams **Desirable Requirements** * BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Physics, or related engineering field * Experience with performance benchmarking (Cinebench, 3DMark, PCMark) or PC building, gaming, or overclocking * Familiarity with performance tools (Windows Performance Toolkit, ETW, BIOS tuning) or scripting languages (Python, PowerShell, SQL) * Experience with data visualization or analysis tools (Power BI, Tableau, Python, SQL) * Familiarity with measurement equipment (power analyzers, multimeters, thermal cameras) or AI\-assisted productivity tools **Compensation** Dell is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this position is $112,200 \- $145,200\.

jobs.title: Accounting & Finance Data, Reporting, and Automation Engineer - State, Local, and Higher Education
jobs.description: **Position summary** Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading\-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance. **Work You'll Do** As a Senior Consultant for General Business Finance Data Analytics \& Insights team, you will be responsible for the design, build, and maintain automations that streamline accounting and finance processes for state, local, and higher education clients. You will work closely with client finance teams and our consultants to turn manual, error\-prone work into reliable, auditable, and scalable workflows. You will also build the data pipelines, reporting tools, and control checks that help clients close faster, reconcile with confidence, and stay ready for audit. * Design and build automations for recurring finance and accounting processes, such as bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable matching, journal entry preparation, accrual calculations, and month\-end and year\-end close checklists. * Develop process automation and workflow solutions using tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or similar platforms, with appropriate exception handling and human review points. * Build and maintain data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines that pull data from ERP and other information systems, including Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, into reporting environments. * Write SQL queries and scripts to validate data, identify anomalies, and support general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and chart of accounts clean\-up. * Design and maintain dashboards and recurring financial reports for controllers, treasurers, budget offices, and boards, including fund\-level, grant\-level, and capital asset reporting. * Build automated control testing and monitoring routines aligned to the COSO framework, producing evidence that supports internal audit, external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200\). * Document automations thoroughly, including process maps, logic, data lineage, access controls, and runbooks, so that clients can maintain and audit them independently. * Establish version control, testing, and change management practices for automations, and ensure they comply with client IT security and data governance policies. * Train client staff on how to operate, monitor, and modify automations, and transition ownership to permanent teams at the end of an engagement. * Evaluate client processes to identify automation opportunities, estimate return on investment, and recommend a prioritized roadmap. * Support backfill and interim engagements where automations reduce workload for embedded consultants, and ensure those automations are documented for the returning staff member. A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The Team** Deloitte's Government \& Public Services (GPS) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise. The General Business Finance Data Analytics \& Insights team helps finance organizations turn financial and operational data into reliable reporting and actionable insights. The team combines data engineering, analytics, visualization, and finance process knowledge to support decisions across planning, performance management, and business operations. Professionals collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and access to information. **Qualifications** Required**:** * Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 3\+ years of experience in one or more of the following: * + Building finance or accounting automations using RPA, AI, or other workflow tools; + Developing query\-based reporting output, data validation, or ETL processes; + Scripting in various languages for financial data analysis; or + Implementing ERP, reporting, or data integration solutions for finance teams. * Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, including general ledger structures, reconciliations, journal entries, and the chart of accounts. Familiarity with fund accounting and GASB or FASB standards is preferred. * Hands\-on experience with automation and intelligence platforms or a business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar). * Understanding of internal controls, COSO principles, and audit requirements, with the ability to design automations that produce audit\-ready evidence. * Familiarity with data governance, information security, and access controls in regulated environments. * Ability to obtain/maintain and security clearances needed for the client and/or project. * Ability to work independently across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future Preferred: * Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization, with experience working against relational databases. * Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred. * Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or higher education clients * Experience with data warehousing or lakehouse architecture * Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) orchestration tools * Experience working in Agile delivery environments * Experience using Git\-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines * Master's degree in Computer Science, Accounting Information systems, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics * Strong documentation skills and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non\-technical finance stakeholders. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800\. jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **About Sutton** Sutton is an AI native operating system for growing companies. Manufacturers, distributors and other operations heavy businesses run inventory, production, sales orders, purchasing and warehousing on Sutton, and many also run custom apps we build with them in days, not months. Those apps are the reason customers love us. Sutton Studio is where anyone can build on top of the platform. You describe an app, dashboard or workflow in plain English, and it is built on live operational data, with Sutton's security and permissions underneath. We have raised $6\.3M from leading venture investors, and our customers run real operations on Sutton at scale, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company with more than 18,000 apartments, a top US research university and precision machine shops. The work you ship here has an impact you can see. We are a small team with big ownership, and we move fast: the distance between a customer's problem and something live in their hands is measured in days. **The role** We are hiring a full stack engineer who can build and run almost anything. You will work directly with our Founding Engineer and our founders. There are no separate front end, back end or lead roles here. We are a flat group of strong generalists, and everyone owns what they build, from the first line of code to production. The work spans our core product, the apps we build with customers, and the platform that keeps all of it fast and safe. **What you will do** You will pick up whatever matters most that week, and the mix will change. Our stack is Node.js, GraphQL and Postgres with a React front end, and we use Claude Code and Cursor every day. Typical work: * Ship features end to end across a Node.js and GraphQL API, Postgres and a React front end, with AI assisted coding as a daily habit * Build the platform behind Studio and customer built apps: scoped per customer tokens, a permissions model where each app declares what it touches, server side validation and audit logging tagged by app * Own reliability for a multi tenant production system: monitoring, alerting, backups and restores, incident response and safe rollbacks * Build resilient integrations with accounting and commerce systems such as QuickBooks, NetSuite and Shopify, with retries, idempotency and an alert when a sync stops * Extend our API and MCP server so AI assistants and apps can safely read and write operational data like inventory, production and orders * Work on real world features: barcode scanning, label printing and streams of machine sensor data * Turn customer feedback into product improvements, shipped in days instead of months **Who we are looking for** We are looking for driven builders who understand the business problem behind the code. You think in systems, move quickly, and use AI to multiply your own output. You do not need to be an expert in every layer or fit a single profile. What matters is that you are strong across the stack and committed to creating a customer outcome, with an open mind about how to get there. * You can design a GraphQL schema, fix a slow Postgres query and debug a React state issue in the same afternoon * You have built multi tenant SaaS and care about tenant isolation, safe migrations and per customer configuration * You have run production systems largely on your own, and you know how to monitor, back up, roll back and recover them * You have solid security fundamentals: authentication and authorization, scoped tokens, secrets handling and audit trails * You are comfortable reading vendor API docs and building integrations that hold up: OAuth, webhooks, rate limits, retries and idempotency * You work AI native every day with Claude Code or similar, and have opinions on the tests, CI checks and review that make AI written code safe to ship * You own outcomes: you talk to the people who use what you build, act without being asked, do what it takes to figure things out, and explain tradeoffs clearly to non engineers Bonus points for experience with ERP, inventory or accounting systems, Cloudflare Workers, SOC 2, or hardware like scanners and sensors. **How we work** Speed and trust are not a tradeoff here, and everyone is expected to ship. * **Speed is a feature.** We ship small, ship often and learn from customers. * **Build fast, run safe.** We build on a platform that makes the safe way the easy way. * **Everyone ships.** Every role puts something real in front of a customer or teammate every week. * **Small team, big ownership.** You own outcomes, not tasks. * **Candor with care.** We say the hard thing early, directly and kindly. **Why Sutton** You will shape an AI native ERP that customers run real operations on every day, from national cookie chains to a public real estate company and a top research university. * Help define the product and its architecture, not inherit a pile of tickets * Direct access to the founders and to real customers * A small team where your work visibly changes what customers experience * Location: US based and flexible for the right person, with a bonus for being near our founders in Atlanta or Southern California * Base salary of $165,000 to $210,000 per year, plus meaningful equity * Unlimited PTO, 401(k), medical, dental and vision, and team onsites **How we hire** The process is short and practical: a short intro call with our Founding Engineer, a coding challenge, a follow up conversation to talk through it, and a meeting with the founders. You will get a real Sutton style app to harden and extend using the AI tools you already use. We look at your speed, your judgment and how you explain your decisions. Pay: $165,000\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Unlimited paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: Ellipsis Health builds AI products that take on healthcare's staffing shortages and administrative burden, pairing conversational AI with our patented voice biomarker technology to help deliver better healthcare for everyone. Our voice agents talk with patients every day: booking and rescheduling appointments, answering billing questions, handling medication refills, and checking in after a hospital visit. This role sits on our provider engineering team, building the platform that connects our agents to the EHRs, scheduling systems, and phone systems inside health systems, provider groups, and FQHCs. You'll work across the provider teams within Ellipsis, partnering with AI engineering, product, deployment, and customer teams to make every new health system go\-live faster and more reliable than the last. We're seeking a Senior Full Stack Engineer to build the backbone our AI agents rely on. An agent is only as good as the systems it can act on, and in this role you'll design the APIs, integrations, data model, and durable workflows that connect our agents to EHRs, scheduling systems, and phone systems inside some of the largest health systems in the country. The role leans backend and API, but it's full stack and AI is part of the job: you'll design the tools LLM agents call, ship UI when a feature needs it, and work side by side with our AI engineers. In your first three months, you'll ship at least one major EHR or health system integration from spec to go\-live, own a core platform service in production, and build reusable integration tooling that makes each new go\-live faster than the last. You'll work directly with our SVP of Engineering and engineering leads on a small team where your decisions shape the platform for years. The ideal candidate is a hands\-on builder who takes ownership in ambiguous situations, holds a high bar for reliability and observability, and is motivated by making healthcare work better for patients. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, build, and operate backend services and APIs (TypeScript/Node.js and Python) that power our AI agents and the applications around them. * Build integrations with EHR and health system platforms using FHIR, HL7, and vendor APIs, so messy systems look simple to the rest of the platform. * Build the agent tools: the APIs and functions LLM agents call to look up patients, book appointments, and process refills, with the reliability, idempotency, and observability that requires. * Build and scale durable workflows and job pipelines (e.g., Temporal, queues) for outbound campaigns, scheduling, and reconciliation. * Evolve and scale our application architecture, data model, and persistence layer as we onboard more health systems. * Ship complete features across the stack, including React/TypeScript UI when needed. * Own production, including CI/CD, monitoring, alerting, incident response, runbooks, and HIPAA\-grade security and audit logging. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of experience building production backend systems in TypeScript/Node.js and/or Python. * Strong API design skills (REST, webhooks, async processing), along with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and distributed systems fundamentals. * Experience integrating third\-party systems and handling rate limits, retries, and partial failures gracefully. * Experience with cloud and containers (GCP preferred; Docker; Cloud Run or Kubernetes). * Comfort shipping frontend work when a feature calls for it. * Curiosity about LLMs and agents. Experience building with them is a plus, and you'll get plenty of it here. **Preferred** ------------- * Healthcare interoperability experience, including FHIR, HL7v2, and EHR vendor APIs. * Experience with Temporal or similar workflow orchestration. * Telephony or CPaaS experience (Twilio, SIP). * Experience building tools or MCP servers for LLM agents. * Security and compliance experience (HIPAA, SOC 2\). **Salary and Benefits** ----------------------- We offer a competitive salary and meaningful equity, along with comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, and \[learning budget / conferences / additional benefits]. The typical salary range for this role is $160,000 to $210,000 USD, depending on skills, qualifications, and relevant experience. **Background Checks** --------------------- As a healthcare technology company, Ellipsis Health may conduct background checks on candidates who receive an offer, in accordance with applicable law. We evaluate every candidate holistically and comply with all applicable "ban the box" regulations. **Assistance** -------------- If you have a disability or need an accommodation during the application or recruitment process, please contact careers@ellipsishealth.com. Compensation Range: $160K \- $210K

changes. * Build internal tools to observe, monitor, and analyze agent behavior at scale to identify common failure modes and patterns. * Track what's new in models and tooling, and bring the useful jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Future Evolves Here** Evolent partners with health plans and providers to achieve better outcomes for people with most complex and costly health conditions. Working across specialties and primary care, we seek to connect the pieces of fragmented health care system and ensure people get the same level of care and compassion we would want for our loved ones. Evolent employees enjoy work/life balance, the flexibility to suit their work to their lives, and autonomy they need to get things done. We believe that people do their best work when they're supported to live their best lives, and when they feel welcome to bring their whole selves to work. That's one reason why diversity and inclusion are core to our business. Join Evolent for the mission. Stay for the culture. **What You’ll Be Doing:** **Position Summary:** The Software Engineer designs, develops, tests, and maintains software applications using modern programming languages and frameworks. Working in an Agile, globally distributed team, this role partners with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical specifications and deliver clean, maintainable, and reliable code. This individual works with minimal supervision on assigned features, actively learning and adopting the development methods, frameworks, and patterns defined for the role and by the team, and contributes to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. The role is expected to use approved AI\-assisted tools to accelerate delivery and improve quality while remaining fully accountable for every delivered result. **AI\-Assisted Engineering Expectations:** Evolent engineers are expected to effectively leverage approved AI\-assisted development and productivity tools (e.g., code assistants, copilots, automation agents, knowledge assistants, and analytics tools) to improve quality, efficiency, and innovation while maintaining accountability for all delivered work. These expectations span the full engineering lifecycle, not only code generation, including iterating with AI on solution design, evaluating alternatives, and producing design artifacts. Engineers remain responsible for validating outputs, ensuring solution quality, protecting sensitive information, and complying with security, privacy, regulatory, and Responsible AI standards. **Key Responsibilities:** **Design and Development** * Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications for assigned features using modern programming languages and frameworks. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to understand requirements and translate them into technical specifications. * Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code, following the team’s established best practices, patterns, and coding standards. * Write unit, integration, and end\-to\-end tests to ensure code quality and reliability. * Contribute to the design and implementation of enhancements to the team’s systems. **Quality and Continuous Improvement** * Participate in code reviews to ensure code quality, functionality, and maintainability, and seek feedback to continuously improve skills. * Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve technical issues and bugs in a timely manner. * Optimize applications for performance, scalability, and reliability. * Follow and help reinforce the team’s development processes and standards, helping peers understand the benefits and risks of exceptions. * Contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes, tools, and methodologies, and stay current with emerging technologies and industry trends. **AI\-Enabled Delivery** * Utilize approved AI\-assisted engineering tools to accelerate software development, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and analysis activities. * Apply AI\-assisted development techniques throughout the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation. * Evaluate and validate AI\-generated outputs for correctness, security, maintainability, compliance, and business appropriateness before use. * Learn and adopt the prompts, skills, agents, and AI\-assisted development patterns defined by the team, and share improvements that benefit the team. * Identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity and quality through AI\-enabled workflows and automation. **Governance and Compliance** * Follow enterprise policies governing AI usage, intellectual property protection, security, privacy, PHI handling, and Responsible AI practices. * Ensure no confidential, regulated, or protected information is used with unapproved AI services or tooling. * Participate in peer reviews and validation processes for AI\-assisted solutions. **Required Qualifications:** * 2\+ years of professional software development experience, with a proven track record of delivering complex, scalable applications. * Proficiency in C\# or Python and familiarity with their ecosystems. * Working knowledge of relational database development, preferably using SQL Server. * Strong understanding of software design principles, algorithms, and data structures. * Familiarity with Git\-based version control (e.g., GitHub, Azure Git) and collaborative coding workflows, including pull requests. * Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., Azure, AWS, Google Cloud) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes). * Excellent problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a globally distributed team. * Strong communication skills, openness to feedback, and the ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience related to HL7 FHIR. Understanding resource\-first FHIR patterns. Comfortable reading FHIR implementation guides. * Experience in healthcare data domains such as providers, members, prior authorizations, and claims. * Exposure to AI\-assisted development platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools. * Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI\-assisted testing, and AI\-enabled software delivery practices. * Experience with additional back\-end technologies (e.g., Node.js, Django, Spring). * Familiarity with microservices architecture. * Experience working with NoSQL data stores (e.g., Elasticsearch). * Healthcare domain experience. **Education:** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. To ensure a secure hiring process we have implemented several identity verification steps, including submission of a government issued photo ID. We conduct identity verification during interviews, and final interviews may require onsite attendance. All candidates must complete a comprehensive background check, in\-person I\-9 verification, and may be subject to drug screening prior to employment. The use of artificial intelligence tools during interviews is prohibited and monitored. Misrepresentation will result in immediate disqualification from consideration. **Technical Requirements:** We require that all employees have the following technical capability at their home: High speed internet over 10 Mbps and, specifically for all call center employees, the ability to plug in directly to the home internet router. **Evolent is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.** **If you need reasonable accommodation to access the information provided on this website, please contact** **recruitingteam@evolent.com** **for further assistance.** The expected base salary/wage range for this position is $109,000\-$123,000\. As part of our total compensation package, Evolent is proud to offer comprehensive benefits (including health insurance benefits) to qualifying employees. All compensation determinations are based on the skills and experience required for the position and commensurate with experience of selected individuals, which may vary above and below the stated amounts.

jobs.title: AI & ML Ops Engineer
jobs.description: Responsibilities/Job Description: The **AI \& ML Operations Engineer** designs, builds, and maintains the engineering processes and platform capabilities needed to deploy, monitor, govern, and maintain deployed AI/ML solutions at scale. The role converts validated analytical work into reliable production solutions and manages the operational lifecycle of models and related services while meeting enterprise privacy, security, and support standards. The engineer partners with data scientists, data engineers, central cloud and infrastructure teams, API and Interoperability teams, Cybersecurity, service owners, and relevant engineering teams to deliver maintainable solutions. The role remains hands\-on in engineering, testing, deployment, and troubleshooting while using enterprise\-managed capabilities for production data movement, integration, and infrastructure. Scientific method validation remains with the Data Scientist and designated reviewers; this position implements the operational controls for deployed solutions. This role is part of a new AI \& Automation engineering team and will directly design, build, deploy, and support production AI applications and services. Work may include agents, retrieval\-augmented generation, orchestration, APIs and integrations, automated evaluation and testing frameworks, observability, monitoring, release and rollback processes, and model/application lifecycle management. **Responsibilities** **Model deployment and orchestration.** Deploy batch and real\-time models and related AI services using approved CI/CD, containers, APIs, and workflow patterns. Build and maintain assigned model deployment and runtime components and coordinate dependencies with enterprise platform owners. **Release management.** Automate packaging, versioning, testing, promotion, rollback, and recovery for models and services. Implement retraining or recalibration workflows using criteria defined with data scientists and the required validation and release approvals. **ML platform capabilities.** Implement, integrate, configure, and operate approved feature stores, model registries, experiment tracking, and related ML lifecycle capabilities with enterprise platform owners. Partner with Cloud \& AI Deployment Engineering and central cloud teams on compute, storage, networking, and deployment. **Deployed\-model governance.** Implement approved lifecycle controls, access restrictions, lineage, audit trails, change records, and release approvals for deployed models. Maintain traceability across data, code, model, and configuration versions. **Monitoring and reliability.** Implement logging, alerts, and monitoring for model performance, drift, data quality, latency, availability, and errors. Work with data scientists, service owners, and relevant engineering teams on measures, thresholds, incident response, and service objectives. **Data and API integration.** Work with central data\-engineering teams on managed data pipelines and with enterprise API and Interoperability teams on real\-time and application integrations, including MuleSoft or other approved API capabilities. Coordinate monitoring, recovery checkpoints, restart procedures, security, and support ownership. **Enterprise support and maintainability.** Ensure production solutions have documented dependencies, operational procedures, escalation paths, and ongoing ownership before release. Arrange support with the responsible enterprise teams, including 24/7 coverage where required for critical services, rather than relying on an individual project owner. **AI application operations.** Operate assigned LLM, retrieval\-based, and agent applications using automated quality checks, model/tool tracing, prompt and configuration versioning, and usage/cost monitoring within the common production lifecycle. **Security and engineering standards.** Apply enterprise privacy, security, encryption, role\-based access, and sensitive\-data controls. Follow common infrastructure\-as\-code, pull\-request, and deployment practices with the responsible teams; bring needed tooling or design exceptions through established review processes. **Collaboration and improvement.** Help scientists and partner teams move prototypes into supported production solutions. Review code, tests, and documentation, resolve incidents across dependencies, provide constructive technical feedback, and improve reliability, reproducibility, performance, and efficiency. **Required Qualifications*** B.S./B.A. in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience. * At least three years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or MLOps, including work with production systems. * Proficiency in Python or another modern programming language, such as Java or Go, sufficient to build, test, troubleshoot, and maintain production components. * Hands\-on experience deploying and operating batch and/or real\-time machine\-learning models in production. * Experience with CI/CD tools such as GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or Azure DevOps; source control, code review, automated testing, and controlled releases. * Hands\-on experience with containerization and orchestration technologies using enterprise\-approved platforms and tools. * Experience in cloud and/or hybrid environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP. * Working knowledge of SQL and experience with large datasets and data\-workflow orchestration; ability to integrate model services with enterprise\-managed pipelines and APIs. * Experience implementing logging, metrics, monitoring, alerts, and operational diagnostics and investigating failures across model, application, data, and infrastructure dependencies. * Understanding of security best practices, role\-based access control, secrets management, and handling sensitive data. * Ability to independently deliver assigned engineering work, communicate technical tradeoffs, and collaborate with data scientists, clinicians, data/API teams, cloud/DevOps, security, and support functions. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in healthcare, health technology, or another regulated industry handling PHI/PII. * Familiarity with EHR/EMR integration and healthcare data standards such as HL7/FHIR, ICD, CPT, LOINC, or SNOMED. * Experience with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, SageMaker, Vertex AI, or Azure ML, including model registries, feature stores, and experiment tracking. * Experience with ETL/ELT, data warehouse or lakehouse platforms, enterprise API platforms, infrastructure as code, and formal production\-support practices. * Experience monitoring model drift, fairness, and explainability and implementing healthcare AI governance controls. * Experience operating LLM, retrieval\-based, or agent applications, including quality evaluation, tracing, prompt/configuration management, and cost monitoring. jobs.title: Cloud & AI Deployment Engineer

The role combines hands\-on cloud engineering with collaboration across DevOps, Security, and AI/ML teams to deliver reliable, secure environments that can be supported and maintained long term.
