jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Balance and Ledger - Core
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. We ignite the passions of global sports fans and maximize the presence and reach for our hundreds of sports partners globally by offering products and services across Fanatics Commerce, Fanatics Collectibles, and Fanatics Betting \& Gaming, allowing sports fans to Buy, Collect, and Bet. Through the Fanatics platform, sports fans can buy licensed fan gear, jerseys, lifestyle and streetwear products, headwear, and hardgoods; collect physical and digital trading cards, sports memorabilia, and other digital assets; and bet as the company builds its Sportsbook and iGaming platform. Fanatics has an established database of over 100 million global sports fans; a global partner network with approximately 900 sports properties, including major national and international professional sports leagues, players associations, teams, colleges, college conferences and retail partners, 2,500 athletes and celebrities, and 200 exclusive athletes; and over 2,000 retail locations, including its Lids retail stores. Our more than 22,000 employees are committed to relentlessly enhancing the fan experience and delighting sports fans globally.**Overview** ------------ Fanatics Betting \& Gaming (FBG) is the online and retail sports betting subsidiary of Fanatics Holdings, Inc. As a **Staff Engineer** on the **Balance and Ledger** team, you will be the technical owner of the ledger and balance services that hold customer funds across Fanatics. Balance and Ledger will be a shared ledger and a customer\-level balance that can be used across Sportsbook and Casino, Markets, and other LOBs. You will design the systems that make this possible: a ledger that is correct and auditable, a balance model that enforces which funds can be used where, and a migration path that moves existing wallets onto the shared platform without disrupting customers. This role combines deep backend expertise with architectural leadership. You will set the technical direction for the balance platform, work closely with Payments, Fraud, Responsible Gaming, Finance, Legal, and Compliance partners, and guide engineers across several teams as new businesses adopt the shared ledger. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * **Own the architecture** of the ledger and balance services, including the data model, consistency guarantees, and the interfaces other businesses use to read balances and authorize spend. * **Design and build** distributed services in Java and Spring Boot that handle high transaction volume with strict correctness, idempotency, and auditability requirements. * **Model funds by type and eligibility**, so that each portion of a customer's balance is usable only where client, product, customer location, and transaction type allow, and so that a regulator\-driven restriction can be applied quickly and safely. * **Lead the migration** of existing business wallets onto the shared ledger in phases, including dual\-running, reconciliation, cutover, and rollback plans that avoid customer\-visible downtime. * **Architect event\-driven integration** using java and architectural patterns so that balance changes are published reliably and downstream consumers can depend on ordering and delivery. * **Carry responsible gaming protections with the balance**, working with the Responsible Gaming and Fraud teams so that limits, self\-exclusion, and other customer protections remain enforced as funds are used across businesses. * **Work with Finance, Legal, and Compliance** on how funds are attributed between businesses, how settlement and chargebacks are handled, and what data may be shared across Fanatics entities. * **Build for reconciliation and audit**, including complete transaction histories, financial reporting feeds, and tooling that lets Operations and Finance verify balances independently. * **Lead technical initiatives** that span multiple teams, and run architectural reviews, design sessions, and incident postmortems. * **Mentor engineers** and raise the standard for security, observability, reliability, and testing across the platform. * **Partner with product, frontend, and mobile teams** so that balance behavior is clear and consistent in every customer\-facing experience. * Be open to occasional travel to Fanatics offices or industry events for planning, collaboration, and team development. **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot. * Experience designing and operating a ledger, wallet, balance service, or another financial system of record where correctness and auditability are requirements. * Strong command of transactional consistency, idempotency, concurrency control, and relational data modeling in systems that cannot lose or double\-count a transaction. * Experience building event\-driven systems and working with message streaming platforms such as Kafka. * Demonstrated success setting technical direction and driving alignment across multiple teams. * Experience migrating live, high\-traffic systems with minimal customer impact. * Ability to explain complex technical tradeoffs clearly to engineering, product, finance, and leadership audiences. * Comfort working in a fast\-paced, regulated environment with changing priorities. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Experience in online gaming, sports betting, fintech, banking, or payments. * Experience with a shared platform used by several business units, including managing adoption, versioning, and ownership boundaries. * Experience with financial reconciliation, settlement, or accounting\-oriented data models. * Familiarity with data privacy and consent requirements when customer data moves between legal entities. * Experience with AWS, Kubernetes, and observability tooling such as Datadog, Grafana, or CloudWatch. * Interest in developer experience, clean API design, and systems that remain maintainable as more teams depend on them. Depending on the role, your interview and onboarding experience may include in\-person components, such as onsite interviews or Launching into Better: LIVE—a multi\-day cultural immersion in New York City for full\-time, non\-seasonal hires. These sessions are designed to build connection and bring our culture to life, though specific travel and participation requirements will be confirmed based on your role and location. Your recruiter will provide clear guidance at each stage of the process. For information about our benefits, please visit https://benefitsatfanatics.com/ \#LI\-VG1 By submitting your application, you agree to our terms of service and acknowledge you have read our Candidate Privacy Policy. *Fanatics will never ask candidates for money, banking information, or other sensitive personal information as part of the interview process. If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Fanatics recruiting, please do not respond and report it* *here**.*

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Stablecoin Payments
jobs.description: Flex is building **AI\-native financial services for business owners**. We’re re\-architecting the entire financial system for entrepreneurs—from the first dollar a business earns to how that value compounds, moves, and is ultimately spent in real life. Banking, credit, payments, personal finance, and financial operations—rebuilt from the ground up as a single, intelligent system. **Flex is the full financial home for ambitious owners.** Since launching publicly in **September 2023**, Flex has scaled from **zero to nine\-figure annualized revenue**, with a clear path to **profitability by late 2026**. We move fast, ship relentlessly, and operate with extreme ownership. Our customers are **affluent business owners ($3–$200M in revenue)**—the backbone of the economy and one of the most underserved segments in finance. They’re stuck with outdated banks and fragmented tools. We’re replacing all of it. The opportunity is massive: a **\~$1T\+ revenue market** hiding in plain sight. Our ambition is to build a **$100B\+ company** by delivering a product that is fundamentally better—not incrementally improved. Flex has raised $100M\+ in equity and $300M\+ in debt. * **Mission\-critical problems**: We build software that directly controls how money moves at scale. * **High bar, low ego**: Small teams, exceptional people, real ownership. * **Speed over comfort**: We prioritize execution, quality, clarity, and results. * **Enduring impact**: What we’re building will define how a generation of owners runs their businesses. **Team \& Locations** We hire exceptional people who want to build hard things and see their work matter immediately. Roles are available in: San Francisco, Miami, New York, and fully remote. **Flex Fuels Ambition.** ### **About the Role** Flex is building stablecoin products for business owners, and we need engineers who can ship them. The team is small and moving fast, and you’ll be one of the first engineers to join. You’ll build the services that move customer money on\-chain and connect them to the banking systems Flex already runs. That means real ownership, direct access to the engineering lead and product, and work that customers use. Crypto experience helps, but it isn’t required. Much of the work is strong fintech engineering: payments, onboarding, compliance, and reliability. If you’ve built that kind of system and want to learn the crypto side, we want to talk. ### **What You'll Do** * Design, build, and run backend services for stablecoin payments, including deposits, withdrawals, and on and off ramps * Integrate with partners for wallets, virtual accounts, and stablecoin orchestration * Build business onboarding (KYB) and compliance flows that stand up to banking audits * Connect new stablecoin products to Flex’s existing banking, ledger, and payments systems * Own your work from design through launch and production support * Work closely with product, design, compliance, and business development * Help set technical direction of the team’s roadmap * Onboard and mentor new teammates ### **Requirements** * 5\+ years of backend software engineering experience * Experience building and running production services in fintech, payments, or banking * Experience with compliance\-driven systems such as KYB, KYC, AML, or audit requirements, and comfort working with compliance stakeholders * Strong system design skills, especially for money movement: accuracy, reliability, and handling failures safely * Proficiency in a modern backend language * Comfortable owning problems end to end in a small, fast\-moving team * Clear communicator with technical and non\-technical partners ### **Nice to Haves** * Hands\-on crypto experience: stablecoins, wallets, custody, on\-chain transactions, etc. * Experience with on and off ramps, virtual accounts, or stablecoin orchestration * Smart contract development or auditing experience * Prior experience at a startup or high\-growth company Final compensation within this range will be based on experience, qualifications, and interview performance. This position is also eligible for equity compensation. Flex offers medical, dental and vision insurance, paid time off, and a 401(k) plan. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.**Why Join Us** **Build something generational** — Capture the full lifecycle of money for ambitious business owners. **Work on real money, real risk** — Payments, credit, and banking at serious scale. **Solve hard problems** — AI, underwriting, compliance, and global finance from first principles. **True ownership** — Small teams, high trust, real accountability. **Founder\-level exposure** — Direct access to leadership, customers, and investors. **High bar, high taste** — Move fast without cutting corners. **Elite peers** — People here are builders, not tourists. **Real upside** — Meaningful equity if you help build something big. Flexbase Technologies Inc.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (AI Agents)
jobs.description: Fluent is building the next generation advertising network: Partner Monetize and Advertiser Acquisition. Our vision is to build an ML/AI first network of advertisers and publishers working toward a common objective, elevating relevancy in e\-commerce for everyday shoppers. Fluent is hiring its first dedicated AI Engineer. Over the past year, AI at Fluent has moved from pilots to production: a service desk agent that closes tickets without a human touch, a pipeline that cut modeled audience delivery from days to hours, and an agent that audits cross\-system attribution and identifies revenue reconciliation opportunities. All of it was built by people doing it alongside their day jobs. Your job is to make it your day job. You will sit in Core Engineering and work every day with Data Engineering, Data Science, and Solution Architecture. You will build the agents and automated workflows our business teams have asked for, and you will build them on the Databricks lakehouse that is Fluent's data hub, because the hard part of most of these workflows is not the model. It is getting trusted data and reliable actions in front of it. You are a builder who ships. You are strong in Python and SQL, you have put at least one LLM\-powered application in front of real users, and you know the difference between a demo and a production system: evaluation, monitoring, cost, and a clear owner. You have worked in Databricks or a comparable lakehouse, or you have the data engineering depth to get productive there quickly. You are comfortable sitting with a support lead or an account manager, understanding how they actually work, and turning that into something that runs every day. This role is fully remote in the United States, with occasional travel to our New York headquarters. ### **What you'll do** * Ship production agents and automated workflows from a prioritized, business\-validated backlog. Own each one from scoping with the business owner through build, deployment, monitoring, documentation, and handoff. * Build the data foundation those workflows depend on in Databricks: Unity Catalog tables and views, Lakeflow pipelines, Lakeflow Connect ingestion from systems like HubSpot, and Genie spaces that let business teams ask questions in plain language. Bring data from our ad\-serving and partner platforms, CRM, support desk, and finance systems into one place people can trust. * Work with Data Science to make agent quality measurable: evaluation sets, accuracy and drift tracking, cost and latency instrumentation, and the audit fields and failure alerts every production workflow carries. * Integrate with Fluent's systems through APIs, webhooks, MCP servers, and orchestration (Databricks Workflows, n8n, GitHub Actions), and replace brittle point\-to\-point automations with maintained, observable ones. * Partner with Core Engineering to expose platform data and actions as APIs, so agents and business teams can use them directly instead of routing requests through engineers. * Build reusable pieces, not one\-offs: Claude skills, MCP connectors, prompt and evaluation libraries, and playbooks that other builders across Fluent can pick up. * Handle consumer data in line with Fluent's privacy and compliance standards, use only approved AI tools, and work with IT \& Security on credentials and access. * Demo weekly, write things down in Confluence, and share what you learn in brown bags and tech talks. * Use AI\-assisted development (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot review) as a normal part of how you work. ### **What success looks like** In your first 90 days you will have shipped one workflow end to end, with a named business owner and numbers Finance can validate. By six months you will have several in production, at least one reusable component another builder has picked up, and a clear view of what next quarter's backlog should be. **Requirements** * 3\+ years of professional software or data engineering experience, with strong Python and SQL. * You have built and shipped at least one LLM\-powered application or agent that real users depend on, using tool calling, retrieval, structured outputs, and evaluation. * Hands\-on experience with Databricks (Spark, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Workflows) or a comparable lakehouse, or deep enough data engineering experience to ramp quickly. * Experience integrating SaaS and internal systems through REST APIs, webhooks, and OAuth. * You test your work, instrument it, and care about cost. You know when a workflow is ready to be owned by someone else. * You communicate clearly with people who do not write code, and you are comfortable running a working session with a business team. * Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) as part of a modern engineering workflow. * Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Nice to have** * Databricks Mosaic AI (Agent Framework, Model Serving, Vector Search), Genie, Lakeflow Declarative Pipelines, Lakebase, or Databricks Apps. * Building MCP servers, or working with the Claude Developer Platform or Agent SDK. * Workflow orchestration tools such as n8n. * Integrations with HubSpot, Zendesk, NetSuite, or Jira. * Experience in ad tech, performance marketing, or another environment that handles regulated consumer data. **Benefits** At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight\-knit crew of go\-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered breakfast and lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity\-filled events. When we are not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in recreational sports leagues, networking with She Runs It, and bonding with across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and pizza\-making classes. And we have all the practical benefits, too… * Competitive compensation * Ample career and professional growth opportunities * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Pre\-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs * 401K with competitive employer match * Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year * Educational and social events * The amazing opportunity to work for a high\-flying performance marketing company! Salary Range: $130,000 to $155,000 plus competitive bonus \- The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Fluent salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance. jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ At Ford, you’ll work on ideas that matter, alongside passionate people who want to make a global impact. Together, we’re shaping the next era of transportation—grounded in purpose, driven by progress. Make your move. * Job Type: Full time * Work Type: Hybrid **Position Overview** The Global Chassis Architecture Manager (Leadership Level 4\) leads the global department that defines early underbody architecture, with enhanced focus on suspension, steering, brakes, and wheels/tires. This executive position is central to Underbody Systems’ modularity strategy: establishing the architectural path that manages complexity, enables efficient design, and lets programs move quickly without compromising quality. You will lead chassis architecture from program start through the early UNVx milestones of GPDS, integrating all chassis commodities with frames/subframes, body structure, driveline, and propulsion across every global vehicle platform. **Strategic Accountabilities** * **Modularity and architecture strategy:** Own the multi\-year underbody architecture roadmap, including common interfaces, scalable building blocks, and design rules that reduce variation and complexity across global platforms. * **Strategic planning:** Translate vehicle strategy, cycle plans, and technology vectors into architecture decisions, investment priorities, and resource plans, ensuring a 5–10 year view shapes near\-term program choices. * **Executive influence:** Partner with Vehicle Architecture, Vehicle Engineering, Program Leadership, and Underbody Systems leadership. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About Foresight** Foresight's mission is to bring the world's critical infrastructure into service faster by better enabling teams to deliver complex capital projects. The AI buildout runs on physical things: data centers, power, and the supply chains behind them. A single hyperscale campus involves an owner, a general contractor, dozens of trades, long\-lead equipment suppliers, lenders and commissioning teams. Each works from its own schedule and its own spreadsheets. When a project slips, the people who could fix it usually find out last. For an AI data center, a month late can mean tens of millions in lost revenue. Foresight is the control tower for these projects. We connect schedules, field progress and execution data across every party, forecast where delivery is heading, and help teams act before a delay becomes a missed date. On one 15\-project portfolio, Foresight found a project 245 days behind, cut reporting overhead by 90%, and helped prevent more than $100M in lost revenue. We work with top data\-center owners, developers and general contractors across the world, including Crusoe, Applied Digital, and NTT. We raised a $25M Series A led by Macquarie Capital and are headquartered in New York. **The role** We're looking for an **Applied AI Engineer** to help build the core ML engine of the Foresight platform. You will build the systems that enhance the ability for efficient delivery of large scale construction projects. You will architect, train and deploy the models that perform Foresight's risk predictions and AI recommendations, to be used in interfaces that make 100k\-activity projects understandable at a glance. This is a hands\-on role on a new team, for someone who owns models and backend features from training to deployment and monitoring to build systems that are accurate, scalable and observable. At Foresight, machine learning is an integral part of the platform. You will be using complex, multimodal high stakes data to make predictions that will be used by teams to deliver major projects on time. This could translate to work on: * Risk prediction: Build, train and deploy models that predict if a project will be at risk and by how much. * Criticality prediction: Build models that use project plans to identify which of the tasks are the most critical to complete the project on time before the project even starts. * Project planning: Build models that accept blueprints and 3D Replit models to create project timelines and scaffolding as the starting point for human planners to make project planning a breeze. * Progress trackers: Build models that take in multi\-model data from static cameras or videos from humans/drones on\-site, voice notes, etc about a task to predict what percent of the task is complete. * Risk mitigation: Build, train and deploy models that can predict the best path forward for risk mitigation or timeline amelioration for major projects. * Continuous improvement: Evaluate models repeatedly and prototype methods and new models to improve the accuracy of current features, inspired by latest research publications. **What you'll do** * Own features from technical design through release and beyond: measure adoption, learn and keep improving. * Work alongside Full Stack engineers to help them turn new models into production features customers rely on. * Partner with product, design and customers to find the problems most worth solving. * Tune performance across the modelling stack, from accuracy to latency and reliability. * Raise the bar on architecture, testing, observability and how the team ships. * Help shape the product and technical roadmap. **Requirements** **You might be a fit if you** * Have 3\+ years of experience building and shipping Machine Learning models in production, with real ownership of the backend. * Have 1\+ years of experience building and shipping VLM/LLM based features to production. * Are strong in Python on the backend (FastAPI, Django or similar). * Are solid at relational data modelling in Postgres: schema design, indexes, query plans, migrations, and an ORM such as SQLAlchemy. * Have shipped agentic workflows, RAG systems and high\-volume data pipelines. * Have experience with async work: queues, background jobs, retries, idempotency, and what happens when a worker dies halfway. * Are hands\-on with AWS (S3, RDS, a managed queue or event service, containers or serverless). * Write tests and debug production issues from logs, metrics and traces, not guesses. * Are clear in written communication and comfortable making pragmatic trade\-offs in a small team that moves fast. **Bonus points** * Experience with workflow orchestration for multi\-step jobs (Temporal, Step Functions, Airflow or similar). * You've worked on a legacy\-to\-modern migration, or on products for regulated enterprise or public\-sector customers (SOC 2, data residency). * Early\-stage or founding\-team experience. None of these are required. If the core of this role excites you, apply. **Benefits** **Why join now** * **Real stakes, real customers**. Real stakes, real customers. You won't be building for a hypothetical buyer. Owners and contractors are building now, on deadlines measured in revenue per day. * **Blank canvas, solid ground**. You get first\-engineer level scope on a product that already has paying customers, real data and proven outcomes to tell. * **Defining a category**.Agentic software for physical infrastructure is a new category. What you build will become the standard. * **Small, senior team**. Flat, direct, low on process. We debate openly, decide quickly and ship. **Compensation and location** * **Total Comp**: $180,000\-230,000, based on experience, level, and location. * **Benefits**: Health, Dental, Vision, 401(k), PTO . * **Location**: New York, San Francisco, and Montreal are preferred. Occasional travel to may be required. Foresight is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and do not discriminate on any protected basis.

jobs.title: Senior Robotics Software Engineer – AI-Enabled Manipulation & Industrial Automation
jobs.description: **Job Description** The Senior Robotics Software Engineer – AI\-Enabled Manipulation \& Industrial Automation designs, develops, integrates, validates, and deploys AI\-enabled robotic applications for industrial and factory automation. The role spans robotic manipulation, perception, motion planning, computer vision, simulation, controls, and AI—including vision\-language\-action (VLA) models and learned manipulation policies. The engineer develops end\-to\-end, closed\-loop solutions that combine classical robotics and modern AI for tasks such as perception\-guided manipulation, multimodal task understanding, sensor\-driven feedback, and autonomous execution. This role bridges robotics software, artificial intelligence, and manufacturing automation, with a focus on turning advanced prototypes into robust, scalable, production\-relevant systems. **Key responsibilities** * Design and deploy robotic applications for industrial automation, including pick\-and\-place, material handling, part transfer, machine tending, inspection support, and vision\-guided manipulation. * Build collision\-aware, dynamically feasible manipulation pipelines integrating object detection and pose estimation, grasp generation, inverse kinematics, motion and trajectory planning, collision avoidance, reliable execution, and gripper control using frameworks such as MoveIt, Lula, RMPflow, OMPL, or related technologies. * Develop computer\-vision and AI perception systems for detection, semantic and instance segmentation, 6D pose estimation, RGB\-D and point\-cloud processing, scene understanding, and grasp\-point generation. * Integrate AI/ML models into real\-time or near\-real\-time robotic workflows to improve perception, generalization, manipulation, task\-level decision\-making, and runtime reliability. * Develop closed\-loop robotic systems that use sensor feedback to monitor task execution, detect failures, update robot actions, and improve runtime reliability. * Develop and evaluate VLA models and learned policies for multimodal task understanding, natural\-language instruction following, action generation, imitation learning, and autonomous manipulation. * Use NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, Omniverse, Replicator, and related tools to build digital environments, generate synthetic data, validate behavior, and develop simulation\-to\-real workflows before physical deployment. * Own robotic software architecture across perception, planning, control, simulation, AI inference, data flow, system interfaces, hardware integration, and deployment; develop modular, maintainable software using Python, C\+\+, ROS 2, Linux, Git, Docker, and reproducible development environments. * Integrate and calibrate manipulators, grippers, RGB/RGB\-D and depth cameras, force/torque sensors, and other automation hardware, including camera intrinsics/extrinsics, hand\-eye calibration, and robot\-to\-cell registration; make calibration robust and repeatable in the field. * Implement force and compliant control—such as impedance, admittance, and guarded moves—for contact\-rich tasks including insertion and assembly. * Build data\-collection workflows for learned policies, including teleoperation, demonstration capture, dataset curation, and experiment tracking. * Debug and validate systems across software, AI models, perception, simulation, motion planning, controls, networking, and hardware. jobs.title: AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: GiveCampus is the world's leading fundraising platform for non\-profit educational institutions. Trusted by millions of donors and 1,300\+ colleges, universities, and K\-12 schools, our mission is to help advance the quality, the affordability, and the accessibility of education. At our current pace, we will facilitate $100 billion in charitable giving over the next decade–enough money to send more than 1 million students to college, tuition\-free. GiveCampus is backed by leading investors including Y Combinator, but we're also practitioners of Sustainable Growth: we've made the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest\-growing private companies each of the last five years and we've been profitable nine of the last 10\. In 2025, we celebrated a $140 million growth investment that included a major liquidity event for GiveCampus employees–the second in less than three years. Our purpose\-driven team of 130\+ is located in 30\+ states across the US: team members work from anywhere they choose. We have a beautiful 12,000sf office in Washington, DC that is available for people to use whenever they want, and we regularly organize team meet\-ups, visit partner institutions, and host retreats in various locations. While we operate at meaningful scale, we're still small relative to the commercial and social good opportunities in front of us. Every GiveCampus employee plays a meaningful role in shaping what comes next, and we're growing the team in support of our ambitious plans–including a $100 million investment in AI product development. If you believe in the transformative power of education and want to join a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company, you'll fit right in. **Location:** This is a remote\-first role based in the U.S. While we embrace flexible, distributed work, we also value in\-person connection. Team members are expected to attend multiple company\-wide and team\-specific onsites throughout the year. **The role** ------------ GiveCampus has spent the last 18 months getting good at using AI. People use it every day, and we've shipped agents and apps that changed how work gets done: a codebase agent that answers questions no doc can, an RFP agent, a support knowledge bot, a feature request agent, and a data integrations assistant for our Partners. Now, we are ready to take it to the next level. You'll design, build, and operate the next generation of AI Infrastructure at GiveCampus, including sources of company and Partner context, a clear model for who and what can access which data, a registry of what's already been built, memory that carries across agents, and the guardrails that let us move fast without losing track of what our agents are doing. This is a platform role. You'll work alongside a product partner and co\-builder (the AI Transformation Lead) who owns prioritization, stakeholder management, and adoption, so you can spend your time on architecture and engineering. **What we're driving** ---------------------- The AI Transformation team exists to change how GiveCampus operates, so that every team runs on connected workflows and agents by default, and output grows without headcount growing alongside it. Over the next year, that means: * Field teams spend most of their time with customers instead of on meeting prep, research, CRM updates, and follow ups * Every customer interaction is backed by context (school data, usage, relationship history, and peer benchmarks) delivered before the conversation starts * Managers act on AI generated briefings and alerts instead of assembling reports by hand * Finance, People, and Ops teams manage agents that run their recurring processes, stepping in only on exceptions and approvals * The enablement infrastructure and operating model that make the change last: standard toolkits, a governed agent lifecycle, and measurement of impact by department You'll contribute directly to every one of these outcomes by owning the platform that makes them possible. The agents doing this work are only as good as the context, access, and controls underneath them, and that's what you'll build. **What you'll own** ------------------- You'll start by building the foundation that makes the outcomes above possible. After that, the role grows with the company and with AI itself, so treat the later stages as direction, not a fixed scope. ### **First 6 months: build the foundation** * **Shared context and memory**: one source of company and Partner knowledge that every agent reads from, so a change is made once and reaches every tool * **Identity and access**: auditable permissions for agents, one view of credentials and MCP connections, and a registry of what's already built * **Governance**: an evaluation gate before production, an audit trail, monitoring, and protection against prompt injection and data leaks, with build versus buy calls made alongside Infrastructure * **A paved road for builders**: templates and guardrails for Taskforce builders, plus measurement of impact by de ring** ------------------ ### **Must have** * Six or more years of software engineering experience, including meaningful time owning platform, infrastructure, or backend systems in production * Hands on experience shipping LLM systems with real users: retrieval, tool use, evaluations, and MCP or similar integration patterns * Strong Python, plus experience with cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), authentication, and observability * A security mindset: you think about access, data boundaries, and failure modes before something ships * A record of building internal platforms or shared services that other people adopted * Experience growing a system from an early version into something a whole company depends on * Appetite to grow into the technical lead for AI across the company * Real excitement about AI and a drive to keep learning: you follow what's new, try things early, and stay current. You don't need to know everything yet, but AI moves fast enough that this role only works if you're engaged with it * You judge your work by business results (hours given back to teams, faster cycle times, tools people use every day), not by what shipped * Comfort working from requirements set with a product partner, and the judgment to push back when the technical answer is different * Clear written communication with technical and non technical teammates ### **Nice to have** * Experience with agent orchestration, multi agent systems, or agent governance tooling * Familiarity with Snowflake, dbt, or a semantic layer * Experience with Salesforce data and APIs * Time at a startup or small team where you were the first person to own a system **How we work** --------------- You'll report to the AI Transformation Lead. Together you form a small pod: they act as product lead and build for adoption, and you own the platform. You'll partner closely with Engineering and Product through AI Plumbers, our cross team working group for AI architecture, agent orchestration, data access, and governance. You'll also work with our AI Taskforce, the builders in each department who will use what you build. GiveCampus has a strong written culture built on Notion, Slack, and async work. We move quickly, document what we do, and give people real autonomy and direct access to leadership. We're remote first, and this role can be based anywhere in the US. **Why this role** ----------------- * **The groundwork is done.** People already use AI every day and we have working agents in production. You're building the layer that makes them work together. * **Clear ownership.** You own the platform, with a product partner who owns prioritization and adoption. * **Room to grow.** You'll start with the foundation and grow into the technical lead for AI at GiveCampus as the work and the field change. * **Leadership investment.** AI is a company priority, with executive sponsorship behind this work. * **A mission that matters.** GiveCampus helps schools raise money to advance education. **Ready to apply?** ------------------- Be sure to keep an eye on your spam and promotions boxes in case our emails end up there! *At GiveCampus, we value diversity and we pledge to foster an environment of support, inclusivity, and learning, both on the job and throughout the application process. In this spirit, we encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.* *GiveCampus is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Applicants and employees are not discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any protected category prohibited by local, state or federal laws.* *If you feel like you don't meet all of the requirements for this role, please apply anyways. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome often get in the way of connecting with incredible people, and we don't want them to prevent us from meeting you.*

and firmware domains. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ Design, develop, test, and deploy robust software architectures for robotic and electromechanical systems using C\+\+ and Python software for integrating commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) robots, mobile platforms, and custom robotic manipulators via proprietary APIs and SDKs. * Build containerized applications using Docker and establish CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, build verification, and deployment to remote robot fleets. * Support hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) testing, software debugging, and joint software\-hardware validation during prototype bring\-up. * Perform root cause analysis of system bugs, software regressions, and performance bottlenecks across software, firmware, and hardware boundaries. * Collaborate with mechanical and electrical engineers to define API specs, sensor/actuator interface requirements, and power/communication data flows. * Support secondary hardware tasks as needed, including basic prototype assembly, sensor wiring verification, and hardware interface debugging using multimeters and oscilloscopes. * Produce clean, well\-documented code, unit tests, technical reporting, and system architecture documentation. **Skill Requirements** ---------------------- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Software Engineering, Mechatronics. * Strong proficiency in C\+\+ and Python programming. * Extensive hands\-on experience with ROS / ROS 2 (Robot Operating System). * Deep familiarity with Linux environments, and modern CI/CD deployment pipelines for remote robot fleets. * Experience with robot motion control, kinematics, state estimation, sensor fusion, and teleoperation interfaces. * Experience integrating commercial off\-the\-shelf (COTS) robots and hardware sensors using proprietary APIs, SDKs, serial/CAN protocols, and network interfaces. * Working knowledge of electromechanical systems (motors, actuators, sensors, PCB interactions) to effectively collaborate with hardware teams and assist in bring\-up. * Experience with basic hardware troubleshooting tools (multimeters, oscilloscopes) and prototype assembly. * Strong written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation, design reviews, and cross\-functional collaboration. **Must Have Skill** ------------------- jobs.title: Data Warehouse Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview: Hamilton Company is a worldwide leader in the design and manufacture of manual, semi\-automated and robotic products for precision fluid measuring. We specialize in the development, manufacturing and customization of precision measurement devices, automated liquid handling stations, and sample management systems. For more than 60 years, Hamilton has been satisfying customer needs by combining quality materials with skilled workmanship, ensuring the highest level of performance of every precision fluid measuring device we manufacture. Responsibilities: Hamilton Company is seeking a motivated, hands\-on builder to help develop the data pipelines, integrations, and business systems that connect information and support better business decisions. This role combines data engineering, analytics, and technical business analysis, with opportunities to turn business requirements into working solutions. Using a variety of skills and methods including SQL, Python, and Machine Learning you will build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, connect existing databases and applications, and contribute to new systems that capture, organize, and analyze business information. This position is suited to someone with strong SQL and Python skills who enjoys solving practical problems, learning new techniques, and building tools that people use. Responsibilities: * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines that extract, transform, and integrate data from existing databases, business applications, and newly developed systems. * Contribute to data warehouse development by implementing and maintaining tables, data models, and analytical datasets with architectural guidance. * Work with business stakeholders and the technical manager to understand workflows, clarify requirements, and translate needs into defined technical tasks. * Develop integrations, automation, and business system components that improve how information is captured, connected, and used. * Help implement record\-linkage and entity\-resolution solutions using rules\-based, probabilistic, and machine learning approaches; investigate uncertain matches and validate results. * Prepare datasets and help develop, test, and evaluate forecasting and classification models. * Integrate approved model outputs into data pipelines, business systems, dashboards, and reporting workflows. * Implement data validation and reconciliation checks; investigate discrepancies and troubleshoot pipeline and integration issues. * Collaborate with the technical manager and DevOps engineer to test, deploy, and monitor solutions using established engineering practices. * Document data flows, business rules, integration logic, and changes so solutions are understandable and maintainable. * Take ownership of assigned deliverables, communicate progress and blockers, and incorporate feedback from technical reviews. This position is located onsite in Reno, Nevada. Qualifications: * Strong SQL skills for querying, transforming, validating, and troubleshooting relational data. * Strong Python skills for data processing, analysis, and automation. * Foundational understanding of data warehousing, relational data modeling, and ETL/ELT concepts. * Foundational understanding of machine learning concepts and an interest in applying them to record linkage, forecasting, and classification. * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to work independently on assigned tasks while seeking guidance when needed. * Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with technical and business colleagues. Education/Experience: * Bachelor’s degree. * 2 \+ years of relevant experience in data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, analytics, or technical business analysis. **Preferred Skills** * Experience with Power BI, DAX. * Exposure to record matching, deduplication, forecasting, or classification through work, coursework, or personal projects. * Experience connecting applications or databases through APIs. * Familiarity with version control, automated testing, and deployment workflows. About Hamilton: * Diverse portfolio of exciting and innovative design projects. * Tremendous opportunities for professional growth. * Commitment to sustainable design. * Competitive compensation. * Excellent benefit package includes medical, dental, vision insurance, paid vacation time, paid sick time, disability insurance, 401k, tuition reimbursement and more. * Solid stable company. * Must pass drug and background screens. * May be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (provided by employer). EEO \- It is the policy of this organization to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants without regard to race, creed, color, national origin, sex, age 40 and over, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, citizenship status, religious preference, or veteran status in all phases of the employment process and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws and regulations.

jobs.title: Controls Engineer 2
jobs.description: Company Overview: Hamilton Medical was founded in 1983 with a clear mission: to enhance the lives of patients on respirators and support the caregivers who serve them. Our focus is on developing ventilation technologies that prioritize safety, effectiveness, and lung protection. We are dedicated to easing the burden on healthcare professionals who work tirelessly every day, helping critically ill patients recover and regain their health. We are committed to helping medical teams deliver the best respiratory care ‑ to anyone, anywhere. Responsibilities: Hamilton Medical, Inc. (HMI) is seeking a Controls Engineer 2 who will take technical ownership of the control systems for all automated equipment at HMI. This role maintains and improves PLC, HMI, and robot programs to increase equipment reliability, process yield, and production efficiency. The Controls Engineer 2 works with Manufacturing Engineering to optimize automation, supports Maintenance in troubleshooting equipment errors, and coordinates technical activities with external automation vendors. The role independently executes assigned controls work with occasional guidance on complex issues. A strong candidate solves problems efficiently, creates practical solutions, documents changes, shares knowledge, and supports safe, consistent production. **Essential Job Functions:** * Takes technical ownership of control systems for all automated equipment at HMI, maintaining reliable operation and serving as the primary internal controls resource. * Develops, modifies, tests, and maintains PLC and HMI programs, including machine sequences, alarms, diagnostics, recipes, and process settings. * Programs, debugs, and optimizes robots, including motion paths, tooling interfaces, equipment handshakes, and fault recovery sequences. * Integrates and troubleshoots sensors, actuators, servo drives, machine vision, and other peripheral devices through PLC interfaces and industrial communication networks. * Partners with manufacturing engineers to analyze cycle time, downtime, faults, and yield, and implements controls improvements that increase automation performance and process consistency to attain target OEE KPIs. * Supports Maintenance in troubleshooting control system errors and restoring equipment operation, and investigates recurring failures and implements corrective actions with Engineering and Quality. * Coordinates external automation vendors for troubleshooting, modifications, and upgrades, reviews technical deliverables and obtains current source programs, backups, and documentation for HMI support. * Translates manufacturing needs into controls requirements and functional specifications, reviews proposed hardware, software, and vendor designs for maintainability and compatibility with HMI equipment. * Coordinates controls startup, debugging, and commissioning for new and modified equipment, supports factory acceptance testing, site acceptance testing, and production handoff. * Applies and improves programming standards, reusable code, and documentation practices, maintains controlled program versions, verified backups, change histories, and recovery instructions. * Develops and executes controls test plans, including affected functions and fault recovery, supports equipment qualification and validation with Manufacturing Engineering and Quality. * Assesses controls changes for effects on machine safety, product quality, and validated processes, follows HMI change control, testing, and release requirements. * Maintains electrical schematics, I/O lists, network layouts, program comments, and troubleshooting guides, supports equipment data collection for diagnostics and performance analysis. * Trains Maintenance, Manufacturing Engineering, and production personnel on controls, diagnostics, and recovery procedures appropriate to their roles. * Plans assigned controls projects and upgrades, including obsolete The Development Platform team operates the infrastructure that makes this possible: the environments where AI agents run, the integrations that connect them to our systems, and the safety and security controls that keep them reliable and auditable. We are seeking a Software Engineer based in Chicago to build the software behind IMC’s AI\-powered engineering workflows. Your work will span agent harnesses, developer workspaces, context delivery, and tooling that connects AI agents to internal services. This is a highly collaborative role with substantial ownership. You will engage directly with engineers to understand their needs, connect those needs to the team’s broader priorities, and turn open\-ended problems into practical solutions. You will help define what we build and carry it through design, implementation, delivery, and ongoing improvement. You will bring strong software engineering fundamentals and an eagerness to learn. Python or Java preferred. * Experience building developer\-facing tools, APIs, or production systems. * Understanding of security principles and best practices, including authentication and authorization patterns and secrets management. * Familiarity with containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes. * Curiosity and eagerness to learn about AI/LLM application patterns, even if you haven’t worked closely with them yet; exposure to agentic AI tools and workflows, such as coding agents or MCP servers, is a plus. * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with stakeholders to understand their needs and connect them to broader team priorities. * Ability to take ownership of open\-ended problems, shape solutions, and carry them through delivery in a fast, collaborative environment. **About Us** *IMC is a research\-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real\-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.* The Base Salary range for the role is included below. jobs.title: Data Scientist - Materials R&D - Remote-Travel
jobs.description: Join the IPG Team! Are you ready to elevate your career? At IPG, we are more than just a global leader in packaging and protective solutions—we are a community that values safety, people, passion, integrity, performance, and teamwork. Principle Accountabilities * Partner with polymer scientists, chemists, and engineers to support bio polymer research and development using data\-driven methods * Analyze and model experimental, formulation, and process data to identify structure–property–process relationships * Develop predictive models to support: * Material performance and property optimization * Formulation design and screening * Scale up and process optimization * Design and analyze experiments (DOE) to maximize learning efficiency and reduce development timelines * Build and maintain reproducible data workflows for R\&D data ingestion, cleaning, and analysis * Apply machine learning techniques (e.g., regression, classification, clustering, time\-series modeling) to complex scientific datasets * Collaborate with data engineering and IT teams to enable scalable data infrastructure for R\&D * Communicate insights, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to technical and non\-technical stakeholders * Understanding of data visualization best practices * Experience working with batch or streaming data processes a plus * Contribute to data dictionaries and process flow diagrams for complex data solutions * Mentor junior data scientists or technical staff and contribute to data science best practices within R\&D * Stay current with advances in materials informatics, polymer modeling, and applied AI in scientific research Essential Skills and Experience * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, or a related field; Master’s or PhD preferred * 10\+ years of professional experience in data science, applied analytics, or scientific computing; experience working with materials science, polymer science or chemical R\&D data, preferred * Strong proficiency in Python and/or R for data analysis and modeling * Solid experience with SQL and working with structured and semi\-structured datasets * Strong foundation in statistics, experimental design, and multivariate analysis * Demonstrated experience applying machine learning to real\-world, noisy scientific or experimental data * Ability to work effectively in a cross\-functional R\&D environment * Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex analyses into actionable insights * Familiarity with bio polymers, sustainable materials, or polymer processing, preferred * Experience with DOE software, laboratory data management systems (LIMS), or scientific databases, preferred * Experience deploying models to support R\&D decision\-making or manufacturing scale\-up, preferred * Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure) and data science lifecycle tools, preferred * Prior experience mentoring or leading technical projects, preferred Why Choose IPG? We pride ourselves on a culture built around strong relationships, where every team member plays a crucial role in our growth. Whether it is through cross\-department collaboration, continuous training, or sustainability\-driven initiatives, we create an environment where you can thrive. With over 40 years of industry expertise and a proven track record of growth and innovation, IPG offers a stable, secure environment where you can flourish! We offer competitive pay, extensive benefits that support you and your family, and exciting career development opportunities. Whether you are looking to enhance your skills or advance your career, we offer ongoing training and the support you need to succeed. Think big, dream bigger, and make an impact with IPG. You belong here. Join us today!

jobs.title: Principal Engineer, Populus.ai and Elevate Platform
jobs.description: **About IPS Group. Populus.ai and Elevate IPS** IPS Group, Inc. is a San Diego\-based parking technology company, Level 1 PCl DSS and SOC 2 Type II compliant, whose smart meters, software and mobile products serve cities across North America, the UK and Ireland. IPS Group offers one mobility data platform under two brands: Populus.ai, a stand\-alone product for the micromobility market, and Elevate, the same application branded for IPS Group customers. It gives cities one place to manage parking, the curb and shared mobility: parking revenue, occupancy, enforcement, parking sessions, pricing and geographies. The platform runs on Google Cloud and is built in Python on PostgreSQWPostGIS. **Job Description:** The Principal Engineer is the technical owner of the platform behind Populus.ai and Elevate, combining two roles in one: the platform's architect and its lead hands\-on developer. You will set the architecture, write production code every week, and lead a small distributed team of offshore engineers and external development partners. Expect roughly 60—70% hands\-on development and 30—400/0 architecture and technical leadership. This is a senior individual contributor role, not a people\-management role: you lead through design, code review and example. As the team grows, this role is expected to evolve into engineering leadership for the Populus.ai and Elevate platform. This is a "do it all" position. On any given day you might build a new ETL pipeline and the product around it, design an API for a data product, trace why a metric looks wrong, fix a broken integration, or update infrastructure as code as the GCP environment evolves. **Essential Duties and Responsibilities:** **Architecture** Own the end\-to\-end architecture of the platform, across both the Populus.ai and Elevate brands: FastAPl services, the PostgreSQL/PostGlS data model, Airflow data pipelines and GCP infrastructure. Make and document key technical decisions. Set engineering standards for code quality, code review, testing, security' and data quality. Own the design and enforcement of secure, region\-scoped data access so customers only ever see their own data. Review and approve work from external development partners at defined checkpoints, including AI and LLM features built into the platform. Partner with Product Management on feasibility, scoping, estimates and metric definitions for the roadmap. Own GCP reliability, security posture and cloud cost. Hands\-on development Build new data products end to end: ETL pipelines, backend APIs and supporting front\-end changes. Investigate and resolve data questions ("why does this number look like this?") by tracing metrics through SQL, pipelines and code. Build new third\-party data integrations and troubleshoot breakages in existing ones. Maintain infrastructure as code and keep Python dependencies and libraries current. Serve as the senior escalation point for production incidents. **Technical leadership** Lead the offshore engineering team: work planning, design oversight, code review and mentoring. Keep platform documentation, runbooks and architecture records current. Represent Populus.ai and Elevate engineering with IPS engineering leadership and, when needed, with customers. Help grow the team, both onshore and offshore: define roles and skill needs, interview and assess candidates, and onboard new engineers onto the platform **Qualifications and Skills:** 10\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3\+ years in a principal, staff or lead role owning system architecture. Still hands\-on: writing production code as a core part of your job within the last 2—3 years. Expert Python, including FastAPI (routers, middleware, dependency injection), SQLAlchemy and Pandas. Strong PostgreSQL and analytical SQL; working experience with PostGlS and geospatial data. Production front\-end experience with TypeScript and React, including map\-based interfaces (Mapbox GL JS or similar). Production experience on Google Cloud Platform: Cloud SQL, IAM and service accounts, Secret Manager, Cloud Storage, monitoring and logging. Infrastructure as code with Terraform. Building and operating ETL pipelines with Apache Airflow Or a similar orchestrator. Docker and CVCD with GitHub. jobs.description: **Our Mission** --------------- As the world’s number 1 job site\*, our mission is to help people get jobs. We strive to cultivate an inclusive and accessible workplace where all people feel comfortable being themselves. We're looking to grow our teams with more people who share our enthusiasm for innovation and creating the best experience for job seekers. (\*Comscore, Total Visits, March 2026\)**Day to Day** -------------- As a Staff Machine Learning Engineer in our Staffing Technology Marketplace group, you'll own the source data, the models and the business impact behind Indeed's AI\-first staffing platform, which agencies, employers and the MSPs that coordinate them use every day to take orders, book workers and manage shifts. Through Indeed and our own Indeed Flex agency, we see labor\-market activity at a scale no single agency can: workers looking for work, employers creating demand, shifts being worked. You'll set the technical direction for turning that into models that predict whether a booked worker will turn up, whether and how fully an order will fill, and which orders are at risk early enough for someone to act. You'll then turn those predictions into decisions customers act on and increasingly trust the platform to make for them: how many backups to book, which agencies an MSP should release an order to and in what sequence within contracted volume splits, and what pay rate will achieve the fill and quality a client asked for without overspending. On a typical day you'll work with customers and our business, product and engineering teams to define, build and evaluate production models per market in the US and UK. You'll keep them healthy and catch a model degrading for a single customer before they notice. You'll design ranking and reliability scoring that balances today's fill against the long\-term health of the worker pool, so the same few workers aren't overused while everyone else drifts away. Every recommendation needs to be explainable to the person acting on it and configurable to each agency's risk appetite. Supporting client sales conversations and proposal preparation * Optimizing and maintaining existing AI systems for enhanced performance and adherence to ethical standards. * Participating in the full AI development lifecycle, including data preparation, design, coding, testing, deployment, and support. * Contributing to the development of internal guidelines, best practices for responsible AI development and technical training. * Staying updated with current AI trends, ethical considerations, and technological advancements. * Assisting in the identification and correction of biases in datasets and AI models. * Documenting AI development processes and maintaining a transparent record of decisions and methodologies used. Travel may be required for this role. Django, Flask, or FastAPI) + Fundamental version control practices and proficiency in version control platforms (e.g. GitHub, Bitbucket, etc) + Experience with database management and data processing. + Understanding and working knowledge of cloud services and platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud) related to AI. + Demonstrated ability to work with complex datasets and perform data preprocessing and analysis. **Professional Skills Requirement** * Strong problem\ tion process. Intuit is a 35 year old startup and constantly disrupts itself by identifying major new technology and design trends that are needed to deliver our mission to power prosperity around the world. Our group is a fun, diverse team focused on delivering cutting edge capabilities. You will be working in developing the QuickBooks Online web application which is used by more than 4 million users worldwide. **Responsibilities** * Architecting and developing web, software, mobile apps, prototypes, or proofs of concepts (POC’s) * Leading the gathering of functional requirements, developing technical specifications, and project \& test planning * Roughly 50\-60% hands\-on coding * Acting as the technical subject matter expert: Mentoring fellow engineers, demonstrating technical expertise, and leading a small team solving challenging programming and design problems * Generate technical documentation to communicate architectural and design options, and educate development teams and business users * Demonstrate a passion for developing well architected, elegant, web and/or mobile apps * Experience Agile Development, SCRUM, and/or Extreme Programming methodologies **Qualifications** * BS/MS in computer science or equivalent work experience * 8\+ years experience developing web, software, or mobile applications * Strong leadership experience: Leading meetings, presenting, technical go to person, and cross\-functional leader. * Solid grasp of software engineering fundamentals and their practical application * Solid grasp of JavaScript fundamentals such as closures, prototype, callbacks, promises, error handling * Experience with Object Oriented Languages such as: Java/J2EE, C\#, Python, C\+\+ * Understand and preferably have experience with web services * Understand unit testing and Test Driven Development * Helpful, can\-do attitude and a willingness to take ownership of problems * Excellent communication skills: Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Commitment to team success and positive team dynamics Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $202,500 \- $274,000

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Nova Intelligence
jobs.description: Iterable is the AI customer engagement platform, built for enterprise scale, loved by teams, and trusted by global brands like Redfin, SeatGeek, Priceline, Calm, and Box. Our platform empowers organizations to activate customer data from any source, design seamless cross\-channel experiences, and optimize engagement with Nova Intelligence, the AI layer of our platform, all with enterprise\-grade security and compliance. Today, nearly 1,200 brands across 50\+ countries rely on Iterable to drive growth, deepen customer relationships, and deliver joyful customer experiences. Our success is powered by extraordinary people who bring our core values to life every day: Be an Owner, Growth Mindset, Run as One, and Transparency. And the market has noticed: G2 recognizes Iterable as a Leader globally, spanning the Americas, EMEA, APAC, ANZ, and Latin America, with category leadership in Personalization, Marketing Automation, Push Notifications, and Mobile Marketing, and a 4\.5/5\-star rating from hundreds of users. Gartner named Iterable a Challenger in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Multichannel Marketing in both 2024 and 2025\. We’ve also earned TrustRadius Top Rated honors in 2024 and 2025, were named a TrustRadius Buyer’s Choice for 2026, and were featured in Snowflake’s Modern Marketing Data Stack 2026\. With a global presence that includes offices in San Francisco, Denver, London, Sydney, and Lisbon, plus remote employees worldwide, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply. Learn more about our story and mission on our Culture and About Us pages. Let’s shape the future of customer engagement together! **Location:** US As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer at Iterable, you will design and build the end\-to\-end machine learning systems that power intelligence across our product. As a high\-tech marketing platform, we work with thousands of large\-scale and diverse enterprise customers. The scale and diversity of these workloads — supporting personalization with deep customizability — present unique and exciting challenges for machine learning at production scale. You will have real autonomy: from research and experimentation through to models running reliably in production, you'll own the systems and models behind our ML products and help shape the direction of AI at Iterable. One of our core values is a growth mindset, and Iterable is a company where everyone can grow. If this role excites you, please apply — we value applicants for the skills they bring beyond a job description. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and ship core product ML capabilities, including send\-time/frequency optimization, recommendation engines, and campaign personalization. * Own the full model lifecycle end\-to\-end: EDA, feature engineering, distributed training, production deployment, latency monitoring, and online experimentation (e.g., multi\-armed bandits, ensemble models). * Build and scale our data pipelines and serving architectures using Databricks, Spark, AWS, Ray, and Kubernetes. * Partner with Backend and Platform teams to elevate feature serving, improve overall data architecture, and establish engineering standards across the team. * Mentor engineers on the team and help set the technical direction for ML at Iterable. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * **5\+ years of hands\-on MLE experience** putting complex models into production at scale. * **Databricks \& Spark mastery:** Real experience building, optimizing, and scaling production data pipelines using Databricks. * **Production\-level Model Engineering:** Proven track record of taking deep learning and ensemble architectures from training through optimization to production deployment. * **Production Code:** Strong Python and/or Scala skills with an emphasis on readable, modular, and maintainable systems code. * **Systems \& Infra Experience:** Hands\-on work with microservice backends, distributed compute (Ray/Spark), and containers (Kubernetes). * **Pragmatism:** You care more about serving latency, reliability, and measurable customer impact than novel theoretical architectures. **Bonus points:** ----------------- * Prior work on large\-scale recommendation systems. * Experience setting up feature stores or model observability tools. * Exposure to Infrastructure\-as\-Code (Terraform, Pulumi). **You Might Work On** --------------------- * Building, evaluating, and integrating new models that add intelligence into our core product. * Enhancing models that optimize send time and frequency of outgoing message campaigns. * Designing data pipelines that make it easy to implement and test new models. * Working with platform engineers to enhance our feature\- and model\-serving architecture. * Benchmarking and improving our multi\-armed bandit implementation. * Building tools to visualize and debug features and models.
