jobs.title: Senior AI Product Engineer
jobs.description: Just Right Reader is a forward\-thinking curriculum provider committed to advancing literacy for students from Birth through 12th Grade. Our comprehensive resources are designed to support all learners, including upper\-grade students requiring additional intervention to develop foundational skills. Grounded in the Science of Reading, our high\-quality materials and tools equip educators with the support they need to accelerate achievement and foster lifelong readers. **Position Overview:** Just Right Reader works with school districts and state education agencies to get kids books at the right reading level. Our platform is TypeScript, Next.js and Postgres, and it connects to the CRM, ERP and internal systems that run the business. We're adding AI to the product. We have a list of projects we want to build and we haven't started on any of them, so we're hiring an engineer to do that work. **Key Responsibilities:** **The projects are already scoped, so you wouldn't be coming in to figure out what we should build. You'd be building it, and making the technical decisions along the way: how we call models, what happens when the output comes back wrong, what we do about cost and latency, and how we test any of it.** **That last part matters more than it might sound. Right now we'd have no way to tell whether a change to a prompt or a model made things worse, and we'd want that in place early rather than after something goes out badly.** **Because we work with K\-12 students, privacy and data handling come up in every design conversation instead of at the end of one. Recommendations also have to be defensible, and one that's wrong but sounds confident causes us more trouble than not making one.** **You'd also do regular product work. We're a small team, so there's Next.js, schema design and integration work alongside the AI projects.** **Qualifications:** You've built an AI product from scratch and shipped it to real users. We're specifically after someone who made the architecture decisions rather than building features on top of a system another team maintained, since that's the situation here. If every AI project you've worked on already had a gateway, an eval setup and a cost dashboard in place when you arrived, this will be a harder jump than it looks. We'd want to hear about at least one thing you built that people depended on, and we'll ask a lot of questions about it. Engineering * Senior\-level experience as a full\-stack or product engineer on systems that were genuinely in production, with real users and real consequences when something broke. * Strong TypeScript. Nearly everything you'd write here is TypeScript, across both the application and the services around it. * Next.js in production rather than familiarity with it. You should be comfortable with the App Router, server components, API routes, and the places where Next.js makes things harder than they need to be. * Strong backend skills: API design, server\-side business logic, and the kind of debugging where the bug turns out to be three systems away from where the error showed up. * Strong PostgreSQL. Query design and optimization, schema and data modeling, and enough experience to know when the ORM is helping and when you should write the SQL yourself. A fair amount of the work here is SQL\-heavy. * Third\-party API integration where the interesting part was the failure cases. Retries, idempotency, rate limits, partial failures, and vendors behaving differently in production than their docs suggested. * AWS at the application level \- S3, SQS, Secrets Manager, ECS/Fargate, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB. We care more about whether you've debugged something running on them than whether you can list the services. AI specifically * You know the ways LLMs fail in production: malformed structured output, schema drift, latency spikes, cost surprises, refusals, and answers that are wrong but sound certain. More to the point, you know what to build so that users don't have to deal with any of it. * You've had to evaluate quality somehow. Golden sets, scored runs, human review, regression checks before a deploy \- whatever form it took, you've answered the question of whether a change made things better or worse with something other than a feeling. * Judgment about when a model is the wrong tool. A fair amount of what looks like an AI problem turns out to be a rules or SQL problem with a better interface, and we'd rather ship the boring version when that's the right answer. * Some sense of what running this costs and what to do about it. Working here * We're small, so you'd be talking directly with the people in operations, customer success and fulfillment who use what we build. Being able to have those conversations well matters about as much as the code does. * Comfort treating internal tooling as a normal part of the job rather than a distraction from the interesting work. Useful but not required: * Retrieval systems in production, eval tooling you've built or used seriously, Prisma, Terraform or general infrastructure literacy, Python, previous K\-12 or FERPA work, and experience with systems like NetSuite, HubSpot, Shopify or Slack. We're not doing model training, fine\-tuning or research, so this isn't the right role if that's what you're after. **Why Join Us:** At Just Right Reader, we're transforming how children learn to read. You'll be part of a passionate, growing team committed to educational equity, literacy innovation, and joyful learning. * Mission\-driven company focused on improving literacy and education outcomes. * Collaborative and innovative work environment with opportunities for growth and development. * Competitive salary and benefits package.

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Systems Engineer
jobs.description: To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology. **Group/Division** The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high\-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The e\-Beam division plays a critical role in KLA’s inspection ecosystem, with tools that deliver high\-resolution, timely insights into defects and critical locations on the wafer. Used alongside KLA’s patterned and bare wafer inspectors, e\-Beam systems help our customers quickly identify and understand yield\-impacting issues—enabling faster, more effective actions to correct the manufacturing process. **What You'll Do** In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high\-impact work across your area of expertise. Take on the kind of engineering problems that define the next generation of semiconductor technology, with the technical ownership and influence to shape how some of the world’s most advanced e\-beam systems are designed, built, and brought to market. As a senior technical leader, you will own complex mechanical systems and major subsystems from concept through production, making critical system\-level decisions and influencing future platform architectures. You will work across mechanical, electrical, controls, systems, manufacturing, service, suppliers, and customers to turn demanding requirements into innovative, reliable solutions. This is an opportunity for an experienced engineer who wants to expand their technical influence without giving up hands\-on engineering. You will solve challenging problems involving precision mechanics, vacuum, thermal management, vibration, high voltage, system integration, and manufacturability while helping shape the technical direction of future platforms. **Why This Opportunity Stands Out** * **Shape next\-generation technology:** Influence architecture and technical decisions for advanced multi\-beam e\-beam inspection and review systems. * **Own meaningful engineering problems:** Take major subsystems from requirements and feasibility through design, integration, validation, and release. * **Expand your technical impact:** Move beyond an individual component or discipline and influence decisions at the system and platform level. * **Stay close to the engineering:** Combine technical leadership with hands\-on design, analysis, prototyping, troubleshooting, and system integration. * **Work across boundaries:** Collaborate with customers, suppliers, manufacturing, service, and multidisciplinary engineering teams to solve problems that cannot be addressed within a single discipline. **Job Duties, but not limited to:** * Lead the development of complex mechanical subsystems and contribute to overall platform architecture. * Translate customer, product, and system needs into clear engineering requirements and technical solutions. * Drive technical decisions with a high degree of independence, including feasibility studies, trade\-off analysis, risk retirement, and requirements definition. * Own solutions throughout the full development lifecycle, from concept and detailed design through prototype, integration, validation, release, and production. * Develop mechanical designs and engineering drawings using 3D CAD tools. * Lead or perform engineering analysis including thermal, fluid, vibration, structural, tolerance, and finite element analysis. * Drive prototype builds, material procurement, subsystem integration, system\-level testing, and performance validation. * Lead design reviews and technical discussions across multidisciplinary and cross\-division teams. * Partner with manufacturing and suppliers to improve manufacturability, scalability, quality, and technical readiness. * Develop assembly, integration, test, troubleshooting, and service procedures to support production and field teams. * Lead resolution of complex system integration, manufacturing, and field issues. * Capture and communicate best\-known methods to strengthen organizational capability. * Mentor engineers and provide technical guidance across multiple experience levels. * Influence technology roadmaps and the architecture of future product platforms.  required * High voltage related design experience is desired * Demonstrated experience owning hardware or subsystem development from concept through integration and validation. * Strong knowledge of precision machine design, including GD\&T, tolerance analysis, materials, machine elements, and fabrication methods. * Experience with mechanical analysis and simulation, such as structural, thermal, vibration, fluid, or FEA. * Proficiency with 3D CAD tools; Creo/ProE experience is beneficial. * Experience integrating mechanical hardware into complex multidisciplinary systems. * Ability to lead technical decisions, communicate trade\-offs, and drive resolution of complex engineering problems. * Strong cross\-functional leadership and communication skills. **Minimum Qualifications** Doctorate (Academic) Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 6 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 8 years **About KLA** We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us. **Total Rewards** Base Pay Range: $141,300\.00 \- $240,200\.00 Annually\&\#xa;Primary Location: USA\-CA\-Milpitas\-KLA KLA’s total rewards package for employees may also include participation in performance incentive programs and eligibility for additional benefits including but not limited to: medical, dental, vision, life, and other voluntary benefits, 401(K) including company matching, employee stock purchase program (ESPP), student debt assistance, tuition reimbursement program, development and career growth opportunities and programs, financial planning benefits, wellness benefits including an employee assistance program (EAP), paid time off and paid company holidays, and family care and bonding leave. Interns are eligible for some of the benefits listed. Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. The range displayed reflects the pay for this position in the primary location identified in this posting. Actual pay depends on several factors, including state minimum pay wage rates, location, job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education level or training. We are committed to complying with all applicable federal and state minimum wage requirements where applicable. If applicable, your recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for your preferred location during the hiring process. **Use of AI Statement** At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem\-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset. **Equal Opportunity Statement** KLA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us at talent.acquisition@kla.com or at \+1\-408\-352\-2808 to request accommodation. For additional information, view the US Know Your Rights poster on the U.S. Equal Employment Opportunity Commission website.

jobs.title: Senior Web & GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **We Breathe Life Into Data** At Komodo Health, our mission is to reduce the global burden of disease. And we believe that smarter use of data is essential to this mission. That's why we built the Healthcare Map — the industry's largest, most complete, precise view of the U.S. healthcare system — by combining de\-identified, real\-world patient data with innovative algorithms and decades of clinical experience. The Healthcare Map serves as our foundation for a powerful suite of software applications, helping us answer healthcare's most complex questions for our partners. Across the healthcare ecosystem, we're helping our clients unlock critical insights to track detailed patient behaviors and treatment patterns, identify gaps in care, address unmet patient needs, and reduce the global burden of disease. As we pursue these goals, it remains essential to us that we stay grounded in our values: be awesome, seek growth, deliver "wow," and enjoy the ride. At Komodo, you will be joining a team of ambitious, supportive Dragons with diverse backgrounds but a shared passion to deliver on our mission to reduce the burden of disease — and enjoy the journey along the way. **The Opportunity at Komodo Health** Komodo Health turns complex healthcare data into insights for the Life Sciences industry. The Revenue Marketing team generates and progresses pipeline for each business segment, with specialists in campaigns, events, lifecycle automation, paid media, website, and analytics. This role joins the website and development group and adds the engineering depth the team needs to build faster. This role exists to run komodohealth.com as a high\-performing pipeline channel and to write the code behind our agentic marketing workflows. You will drive website strategy and execute it. You will split your time about evenly between WordPress development and engineering agents for the marketing team to drive results and efficiencies. **Looking back on your first 12 months at Komodo Health, you will have…** * Brought komodohealth.com to passing Core Web Vitals on the highest\-traffic templates, with a staging, QA, and rollback process the whole team follows. * Launched a library of reusable WordPress blocks and page templates so marketers can build standard campaign and landing pages without developer help. * Moved the website content agent workflows (messaging alignment and search opportunity) into production, with the agents reading from and drafting for WordPress through its API and a person approving every publish. * Built and shipped agents for at least two more workflows impacting pipeline. * Set engineering standards for all code\-based marketing workflows: version control, secrets handling, testing, and documentation. **You will accomplish these outcomes through the following responsibilities…** * Build and maintain komodohealth.com in WordPress, including custom themes, blocks, templates, and plugins, plus campaign, event, and landing pages. * Design, code, and deploy agentic workflows in Python or JavaScript using LLM APIs, covering orchestration, tool use, prompts, structured outputs, error handling, and evaluation. * Connect the site and agents to the revenue stack through APIs and webhooks, including HubSpot, Salesforce, 6sense, Qualified, Google Search Console, Semrush, Slack, and Google Workspace. * Own site performance, security, accessibility, and technical SEO: Core Web Vitals, caching, core and plugin updates, backups, schema markup, and WCAG. * Implement and QA tracking and consent, including Google Tag Manager, GA4, form and UTM capture, and OneTrust, so web activity reaches HubSpot and Salesforce accurately. * Monitor agents in production with logging, alerts, cost and quality checks, and human review steps, and fix issues quickly. + Turn requests from the Website Manager, Lifecycle, Paid Media, Campaigns, and Analytics into scoped technical work, and keep a prioritized backlog with clear documentation. **What you bring to Komodo Health (required):** * **Experience:** 4\+ years in web development, marketing engineering, or GTM engineering, including a B2B marketing site built and run on WordPress. UX and Content strategies to optimize results on the website. * **WordPress depth:** custom themes and blocks, PHP, JavaScript, ACF, the REST API, child themes, and performance tuning. * **Programming:** Python or JavaScript/Node, Git, REST APIs, and webhooks, written as clean code that others can maintain. * **Agent engineering:** hands\-on work with LLM APIs such as Claude or OpenAI and agent patterns like tool use, MCP, CLI, structured outputs, and evals, with the judgment to know where an LLM does not belong. * **GTM systems:** working knowledge of HubSpot and Salesforce data models and how web forms, tracking, and agents write to them. * **Communication:** explains technical tradeoffs to marketers, scopes work clearly, and documents what they build. * **Using GenAI in this role:** use AI coding assistants to build and test faster, and build agents that draft content, route signals, and report on pipeline. **Additional skills and experience we'd prioritize (nice to have)…** * Life Sciences or healthcare B2B marketing experience. * Headless WordPress, SQL or BigQuery, and experience with 6sense or Qualified. \#LI\-Remote **Komodo's AI Standard** At Komodo, we're not just witnessing the AI revolution – we're leading it. This is a pivotal moment in time, where being first to market with AI transforms industries and sets the bar. We've already established industry leadership in leveraging AI to revolutionize healthcare, and we expect every team member to contribute. AI here isn't optional; it's foundational. We expect you to integrate AI into your daily work – from summarizing documents to automating workflows and uncovering insights. This isn't just about efficiency; it's about making every moment more meaningful, building on trust in AI, and driving our collective success. ***Join us in shaping the future of healthcare intelligence.*** **Where You'll Work** Komodo Health has a hybrid work model with hubs in San Francisco, New York City, and Chicago. Roles vary — some can be performed from anywhere in the country, others are scoped to a specific region, and some are based near one of our hubs. For hub\-based Dragons, we're building intentional in\-office rhythms alongside the flexibility that's core to how we work. Whatever your setup, expectations will always be clear before you join. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Komodo Health provides equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type with regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. By submitting your application, you acknowledge that you have read and understand Komodo Health's Privacy Notice for Employees and Contractors. *This notice explains how we collect, use, and retain applicant data.*

capacity planning * **Risk \& Issue Management:** Proactively identify risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, track resolution, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards **What You'll Bring:** ---------------------- * You have 5\+ years of engagement or project management experience, preferably with technical or software engagements * You've managed multiple concurrent engagements technical teams — engineers, architects, product — and managed resource allocation * You're experienced with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana, or similar * You've handled scope change management and complex stakeholder dynamics * You have start\-up DNA: you thrive in fast\-paced, ambiguous environments and don't wait to be told what to do * You're a natural communicator — Partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams, you will help define the architecture and technical direction of wearable media systems. ### **Software Engineer, Video SWE Responsibilities:** * Architect, implement, and troubleshoot video codec and media capture pipelines for wearable devices, from camera capture through encoding and media output * Develop, configure, and tune video encoders, including rate control and compression algorithms, to improve encoding efficiency and visual quality * Optimize codec performance within device power, thermal, latency, and memory constraints, using profiling and measurement to evaluate trade\-offs * Integrate hardware\-accelerated video codecs with mobile and embedded media stacks, working across application processor frameworks, firmware, and kernel drivers * Develop and improve media container handling, timestamp management, and audio/video synchronization across the capture and encoding pipeline * Diagnose and resolve video artifacts, synchronization issues, and performance regressions through codec\-level and end\-to\-end system debugging * Lead technical design and execution for complex media projects, partnering with camera, hardware, and silicon teams to define interfaces, resolve integration challenges, and guide technical roadmaps * Build and improve automated tests and regression infrastructure for code correctness, visual quality, performance, and power consumption ### **Minimum Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or relevant technical field * 7\+ years software development experience in industry settings or PhD with 4\+ years of experience * 3\+ years relevant video software engineering experience in industry settings with understanding of multimedia stack, codecs, containers * Experience in C/C\+\+ multithreaded programming * Experience in C/C\+\+ multithreaded programming * Experience leading large or complex projects, defined goals and delivered milestones by leading teams ### **Preferred Qualifications:** * Experience with image compression and formats such as JPEG, HEIC/HEIF, or raw/Bayer compression * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience developing automated media regression tests or working with codec tools and libraries such as FFmpeg, libavcodec, x264/x265 * Experience integrating hardware\-accelerated video encoding on mobile or low\-power systems\-on\-chip, using media interfaces such as Android MediaCodec, Codec2, OpenMAX, or V4L2 * Knowledge of codec internals, including rate control, motion estimation, intra/inter prediction, rate\-distortion optimization, and bitstream analysis * Experience with media\-path firmware or kernel drivers, camera capture jobs.title: VDC AI Engineer
jobs.description: #### **POSITION SUMMARY** Metcon, Inc., one of the nation's leading Native American\-owned commercial general contractors, is seeking an innovative and technically skilled VDC AI Engineer – Agentic Modeling and Coordination to help advance our Virtual Design and Construction capabilities through the integration of artificial intelligence, automation, and constructible building information modeling. This is a unique opportunity for a construction professional who understands how buildings are actually constructed and possesses the technical expertise to develop intelligent workflows that improve project coordination, model accuracy, and field execution. The ideal candidate will combine hands\-on trade knowledge, advanced BIM/VDC capabilities, and practical experience developing AI\-assisted automation solutions. This individual will work directly with project teams, trade partners, and construction leadership to identify coordination challenges, develop solutions, and implement AI\-driven processes that improve efficiency while maintaining the highest standards of constructability and quality. This is a construction\-first position. We are not seeking a traditional software developer with limited construction exposure or someone whose AI experience is limited to writing prompts. We are looking for a professional who can recognize complex trade coordination challenges, develop controlled technical solutions, and validate that the resulting models and recommendations are accurate, practical, and field\-ready. #### **ESSENTIAL DUTIES and RESPONSIBILITIES** Virtual Design and Construction / BIM Coordination * Develop, manage, and coordinate accurate, constructible, tradespecific 3D models for complex commercial construction projects. * Utilize Autodesk Revit, Navisworks Manage, and Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) to facilitate multidisciplinary coordination. * Perform detailed clash detection, issue tracking, and model quality assurance to identify conflicts before construction. * Evaluate mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, structural, and architectural systems for spatial coordination and constructability. * Lead or support BIM/VDC coordination meetings with project teams, designers, engineers, and specialty subcontractors. * Translate model coordination findings into practical solutions that support fabrication, installation, and field execution. * Support construction sequencing, prefabrication planning, and installation logistics through coordinated digital models. * Maintain model accuracy and alignment with project specifications, design intent, and approved construction documentation. Artificial Intelligence and Agentic Workflow Development * Design, develop, and implement AIassisted workflows using tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and approved AI platforms. * Develop intelligent automation solutions for model QA/QC, clash analysis, document review, issue prioritization, and coordination reporting. * Build agentic workflows capable of interacting with BIM software, structured project data, and construction documentation through approved integrations. * Utilize Model Context Protocol (MCP), application programming interfaces (APIs), and automation tools to connect AI capabilities with existing construction technology platforms. * Develop repeatable workflows that improve coordination efficiency, reduce manual processing, and enhance the quality of project information. * Automate repetitive VDC activities such as issue classification, coordination summaries, model checks, and document comparisons. * Collaborate with internal technology and operations teams to evaluate emerging AI applications and identify practical construction use cases. * Document workflows, establish repeatable procedures, and support adoption across Metcon project teams. Model Validation, Quality Control and Risk Management * Independently validate AIgenerated recommendations, model modifications, and coordination outputs before implementation. * Maintain appropriate human review and approval requirements for all production model changes. * Establish quality control procedures to identify inaccurate, incomplete, or potentially unsafe AIgenerated results. * Ensure automated processes do not compromise design intent, contractual requirements, constructability, or project quality. * Coordinate with design professionals and project leadership regarding changes requiring formal design review or approval. * Maintain traceability of AIassisted model reviews, coordination decisions, and approved modifications. * Protect confidential project information and ensure AI workflows comply with companyapproved data security practices. Project Team and Trade Partner Collaboration * Work closely with Project Executives, Project Managers, Superintendents, Preconstruction teams, and trade partners to support project delivery. * Engage directly with specialty subcontractors to understand installation requirements, fabrication constraints, a assisted workflows involving construction software, structured data, project documentation, or automated processes. * Working knowledge of Python, Dynamo, C\#, or comparable automation and scripting technologies. * Understanding of construction documents, specifications, installation sequencing, and field coordination. * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problemsolving abilities. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to collaborate with construction professionals across multiple disciplines. * Ability to independently evaluate technical outputs and verify constructability before implementation. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** In the 1980s, Microsoft Office transformed knowledge work by moving paper\-based documents and ledgers into digital documents, spreadsheets, and presentations. Today, Office and the broader Microsoft ecosystem connect how organizations work \- their knowledge, decisions, business processes, and institutional expertise. The next transformation is creating AI\-native work experiences across Copilot in Office and the Copilot SuperApp, including Copilot Cowork, where intelligent agents understand domain\-specific work, reason across organizational context, and complete complex workflows. As a **Senior AI Engineer** on the Microsoft Office AI team, you will bring these experiences to hundreds of millions of people. Achieving this vision starts with understanding the work itself, directly from the people doing it. Every professional domain has its own workflows, terminology, constraints, business rules, and standards for what constitutes a good outcome, much of which remains buried in long\-tail domain knowledge. You will work closely with customers, users, and domain experts to discover how work happens in practice, identify high\-value opportunities for AI, and rapidly validate ideas against real customer needs. From there, you will translate ambiguous problems into practical product and technical decisions: which domain\-specific workflows agents should handle, what knowledge and tools they need, how much autonomy they should have, and where human judgment remains essential. Success requires moving fluidly between customer conversations and hands\-on engineering, turning real\-world insights into measurable improvements in how people work. As a **Senior AI Engineer**, you will turn those insights into systems that work in real customer environments. You will prototype, build, evaluate, deploy, debug, and continuously improve production\-grade domain agents across Copilot in Office and Copilot Cowork, working hands\-on across grounding, orchestration, tool use, enterprise permissions, reliability, observability, and evaluation. You will collaborate directly with customers to validate solutions against real enterprise data, existing applications, security boundaries, and operational constraints, using production feedback to diagnose failures and iterate quickly. As common patterns emerge across customers and domain\-specific workflows, you will turn repeated solutions into reusable Office AI platform capabilities for agent development, knowledge access, orchestration, evaluation, and debugging. If you share our passion for turning domain expertise into production\-grade agents across Copilot, we invite you to join us. Proactively identify and drive systemic improvements to agent development platforms, engineering and domain knowledge bases, build processes, and engineering standards, while mentoring coworkers to elevate the technical bar of the team. * Embody Microsoft culture and values. **Qualifications** **Required Qualifications:** Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4\+ We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer who builds AI capabilities hands\-on and sets the standard the rest of the team builds to. This is a builder’s role first. You will take AI/ML models and LLM\-powered agents from a fast “proof of life” prototype through to a production deployment that holds up in a regulated environment. Roughly a fifth of your time goes to the force\-multiplier work: reviewing and quality\-gating other engineers’ designs, and establishing the reusable patterns that keep the architecture and the hard\-won judgment in\-house. Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned. Prototype fast. Demonstrate “proof of life” for AI/ML models, agents, and tools against real MiniMed business problems, working from the business’s actual data and workflows rather than a sanitized sandbox. Take it to production and drive adoption. Build, evaluate, and deploy on the MIA stack (Databricks, LangGraph/LangSmith, enterprise agent platforms), applying evaluation\-driven development, guardrails, and deployment patterns so what ships is reliable, auditable, and maintainable. You own the capability from prototype through initial production release and its first monitoring cycle — measured by real adoption and business value, not just a stable deployment — then hand off to Model Operations for steady\-state run. Integrate into the enterprise environment. Wire agents and models into the surrounding systems — APIs, identity and access (SSO/SAML/OAuth), systems of record such as Salesforce and SAP, and enterprise data pipelines — so capabilities work against real, messy production systems rather than in isolation. Set the technical standard. Establish reusable patterns for agent design, tool\-calling, retrieval, and evaluation harnesses; review and quality\-gate the work of other engineers on the team so the bar holds without a manager in the loop. Feed learnings back to the platform. Turn what you learn in the field into improvements to the MIA platform, shared tooling, and reusable\-pattern roadmap, so each deployment makes the next one faster. Self\-direct against outcomes. Partner with the Product Manager, AI \& Data Science to choose what to build and when to stop, without needing the problem pre\-decomposed for you. Build for a regulated environment. jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.description: At Moody's, we unite the brightest minds to turn today’s risks into tomorrow’s opportunities. We do this by striving to create an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcome to be who they are—with the freedom to exchange ideas, think innovatively, and listen to each other and customers in meaningful ways. Moody’s is transforming how the world sees risk. As a global leader in ratings and integrated risk assessment, we’re advancing AI to move from insight to action—enabling intelligence that not only understands complexity but responds to it. We decode risk to unlock opportunity, helping our clients navigate uncertainty with clarity, speed, and confidence. If you are excited about this opportunity but do not meet every single requirement, please apply! You still may be a great fit for this role or other open roles. We are seeking candidates who model our values: invest in every relationship, lead with curiosity, champion diverse perspectives, turn inputs into actions, and uphold trust through integrity. **Skills and Competencies*** 3–6 years of experience in technology risk, IT controls, technical audit support, software engineering, infrastructure engineering, cybersecurity governance, or a closely related discipline * Experience drafting risk assessments, evaluating inherent and residual risk, documenting control design and operating effectiveness, and presenting evidence\-based assessments for second\-line review and challenge * Strong working knowledge of ICT Risk Management standards and the ability to translate requirements into practical controls, documented procedures, and evidence expectations across lines of business * Ability to understand application architecture, cloud and infrastructure services, identity and access management, software development lifecycles, change management, logging and monitoring, vulnerability management, and technology resilience * Practical experience using a scripting language such as Python or PowerShell, SQL, APIs, and version control to analyze evidence, validate control execution, or automate repeatable documentation and monitoring activities * Demonstrated ability to produce clear, accurate standard operating procedures, control narratives, process flows, technical assessments, and audit\-ready evidence packages * Ability to explain technical risks to both technical and nontechnical audiences, constructively defend assessments, resolve review comments, and escalate unresolved issues through established governance channels * Demonstrated proficiency in artificial intelligence concepts, with hands\-on experience using AI tools to streamline workflows and enhance operational efficiency. Proven ability to implement AI\-powered solutions to solve business challenges. Demonstrates a growing awareness of AI risk management and a commitment to responsible and ethical AI use * Preferred: Experience with governance, risk, and compliance platforms, workflow tools, and document repositories; relevant technology, cloud, cybersecurity, or risk certifications are beneficial **Education*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience **Responsibilities** The Associate Software Engineer supports IT risk management, technical controls, and operational governance across Moody's lines of business by combining hands\-on technical analysis with strong risk assessment and documentation capabilities.* Draft, update, and maintain Risk and Control Self\-Assessments for technology processes and services, including risk statements, inherent and residual risk assessments, control mappings, supporting rationale, and identified gaps * Present and defend assessments during second\-line risk review and challenge using traceable technical evidence; document challenge outcomes, resolve comments, and escalate material disagreements through established governance channels * Write, update, and maintain technical standard operating procedures and a governed inventory, including ownership, version history, approval status, review dates, and links to applicable risks and controls * Translate technical workflows into clear, executable procedures with defined responsibilities, evidence requirements, exception handling, and escalation paths * Assess lines of business processes and technical practices against the ICT Risk Management Standard, identifying gaps, inconsistencies, and opportunities to strengthen control implementation * Support internal and external technology audits by preparing technical documentation, coordinating evidence requests, and participating in system and control walkthroughs * Use approved AI tools extensively to draft and revise assessments, standard operating procedures, control narratives, technical summaries, and audit responses, while retaining accountability for accuracy and completeness * Build or maintain lightweight scripts and automated workflows that improve inventory accuracy, evidence collection, documentation quality, and control monitoring * Validate AI\-generated outputs, protect sensitive information, and ensure risk decisions, control approvals, exceptions, and enforcement actions remain subject to authorized human review **About the Team** Our team works across technology groups, lines of business, control owners, second\-line risk management, and audit functions to strengthen technology risk management across Moody's. By joining the team, you will have the opportunity to contribute to meaningful work that directly supports Moody's operational resilience and governance objectives in a collaborative, innovation\-forward environment. jobs.title: Senior Manager, Security Engineering
jobs.description: **About the Team:** Security Operations \& Engineering protects Morningstar’s corporate environment, products, and the cloud platforms behind them. The group includes two distinct teams: the 24x7 Security Operations Center, and Security Engineering, which this role leads. Security Engineering owns the tooling that makes detection, response, and prevention possible, including NGAV/EDR, email security, SOAR, detection engineering, and CSPM. Because Morningstar builds its software in house, we also provide the security foundations product development teams build on, such as security scanning in pipelines, hardened container images, and library integrations. We work closely with product engineering and product security teams to make the secure path the easy one, and we focus on the platforms, tooling, and guardrails that let security scale. **The Role:** Lead the Security Engineering team that owns the tooling behind Morningstar’s security program, including endpoint protection, email security, SOAR, detection engineering, and cloud security posture management. You’ll set the team’s priorities, grow its engineers, and make sure the platforms they run give the SOC and the business the visibility, automation, and protection they need. You’ll also guide the shared security foundations that product teams build on, like pipeline scanning, hardened container images, and library integrations. Reporting to the Director of Security Operations \& Engineering, you’ll coach your team and stay close enough to the work to help solve difficult technical problems. You’ll have room to shape how engineering and incident response work together, with direct access to security leadership and product development teams. This on\-site role is based in Chicago, IL. It may be filled at the Manager or Senior Manager level, depending on your experience and prior leadership scope. You’ll participate in an infrequent, emergency\-only escalation rotation outside normal business hours. **What you’ll be doing:** * Lead and develop security engineers and the incident response lead. Set clear expectations, plan workloads, and support hiring, performance management, and career growth. * Own the engineering roadmap for detection and security platforms, balancing operational needs with architecture, platform health, and technical debt. The stack includes Splunk, CrowdStrike, Wiz and Wiz Defend, and Zscaler. * Work with the 24x7 SOC to improve detections and playbooks, automate manual work with XSOAR or Tines, and apply AI where it can improve detection, triage, and response. Track detection quality, automation coverage, and response performance; explain progress and risk to senior leaders. * Help the incident response lead handle complex investigations and containment. Make sure responders have the tools and support they need, turn lessons learned into engineering improvements, and troubleshoot alongside engineers when they are blocked. * Partner with product development, cloud platform, and infrastructure teams to strengthen security across AWS, GCP, and Azure while supporting product delivery. Integrate automated security checks into product teams’ CI/CD pipelines, including Harness. Help secure agentic and AI\-assisted development pipelines, where autonomous tools write, test, and deploy code. * **What we’re looking for:** * 4\+ years of people management experience, or equivalent technical leadership experience, in security engineering or security operations, with examples of developing people and delivering engineering work. * Hands\-on security engineering knowledge and the ability to troubleshoot complex problems with your team. Experience with SIEM, endpoint detection and response, cloud security posture management, and security automation or orchestration is required; comparable tools are welcome. * Cloud security experience in a large, multi\-cloud environment, ideally including AWS at scale, plus knowledge of incident investigation, containment, and post\-incident improvement. * Sound technical judgment and clear communication with engineers, analysts, and senior leaders, including colleagues in globally distributed teams. CI/CD security experience is a plus, including static application security testing (SAST), software composition analysis (SCA), secrets scanning, and infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC) scanning. CISSP, CISM, or GIAC certifications are welcome, not required * **Compensation and Benefits** At Morningstar we believe people are at their best when they are at their healthiest. That’s why we champion your wellness through a wide range of programs that support all stages of your personal and professional life. Here are some examples of the offerings we provide: * Financial Health + 100% 401k match up to 6% of salary + Stock Ownership Potential + Company provided life insurance \- 1x salary \+ commission * Physical Health + Comprehensive health benefits (medical/dental/vision) including potential premium discounts and company\-provided HSA contributions (up to $500\-$2,000 annually) for specific plans and coverages + Additional medical Wellness Incentives \- up to $300\-$600 annual + Company\-provided long\- and short\-term disability insurance * Emotional Health + Trust\-Based Time Off + 6\-week Paid Sabbatical Program + 6\-Week Paid Family Caregiving Leave + Competitive 8\-24 Week Paid Parental Leave + Adoption Assistance + Leadership Coaching \& Formal Mentorship Opportunities + Annual Flex Stipend \- $1000 annually to cover personal education \& well\-being expenses + Tuition Reimbursement * Social Health + Charitable Matching Gifts program + Dollars for Doers volunteer program + Paid volunteering days + 15\+ Employee Resource \& Affinity Groups **Total Cash Compensation Range** $151,975\.00\-233,025\.00 **Inclusive of annual base salary and target incentive** Morningstar's hybrid work environment gives you the opportunity to collaborate in\-person each week as we've found that we're at our best when we're purposely together on a regular basis. In most of our locations, our hybrid work model is four days in\-office each week. A range of other benefits are also available to enhance flexibility as needs change. No matter where you are, you'll have tools and resources to engage meaningfully with your global colleagues. 001\_MstarInc Morningstar Inc. Legal Entity

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Internal Platforms
jobs.description: Mosaic Pediatric Therapy provides clinic\-based and home\-based ABA therapy for children with autism across North Carolina and Virginia. We are growing quickly, and we build and run a growing portfolio of internal software: custom web applications, AI\-assisted operational tools, agentic workflows, and integrations with a modern Azure\-based Lakehouse. These systems support clinical operations, billing, credentialing, and analytics. Our software handles protected health information (PHI) and sits in workflows where accuracy and compliance are non\-negotiable. We need a senior software engineer to turn that energy into well\-designed, secure, maintainable applications. ### **About the Role** This is a senior, hands\-on software engineering role. You will design, build, ship, and maintain the internal applications and services that Mosaic runs on, and set the engineering standards for how software gets built here. About 70% of the role is software development such as application architecture, building features end to end, APIs and integrations, testing, code review, and production support. The other 30% covers the data and platform work those applications depend on, such as data pipelines into our Azure Fabric Lakehouse, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and monitoring. We are a Microsoft shop (Azure, Fabric, SQL Server, Microsoft 365\). We care more about strong engineering fundamentals than any specific language or framework, and we want to put your expertise to work. The role is highly cross\-functional. You will work directly with the VP of Data Science, the Director of IT, and operational leaders across the business. You will also mentor internal builders who use AI\-assisted development tools, helping them produce software that is safe, tested, and maintainable. ### **What You'll Do** **Design and build internal applications.** Own internal software end to end, from requirements and architecture through implementation, deployment, and ongoing maintenance. Build web applications, services, APIs, and integrations with third\-party systems such as our EHR, billing, and HR platforms. **Set and raise the engineering bar.** Establish standards for source control, branching, code review, testing, modular design, documentation, and secure coding. Lead by example through high\-quality code and thoughtful pull request reviews. **Ship AI\-enabled software.** Build and maintain applications and agentic workflows that use LLMs and AI services. Help internal builders using Claude Code and similar tools turn prototypes into production\-grade software. **Own production reliability.** Put deployment pipelines, environment management, monitoring, alerting, and incident response in place across internal systems. Debug production issues and run blameless post\-incident reviews. **Support the data and platform layer.** Build and maintain the pipelines that move application data into and out of our Azure Fabric Lakehouse. Contribute to cloud infrastructure, infrastructure\-as\-code, and data models that serve both applications and reporting. **Partner with the business.** Work directly with clinical, billing, credentialing, and operations leaders to turn workflow problems into well\-scoped software solutions. ### **What We're Looking For** ### **Required** * 4\+ years of professional software development, building and shipping production applications * High proficiency in at least one modern programming language, and comfort picking up others * Strong software engineering fundamentals: object\-oriented or functional design, modular architecture, testing (unit, integration, end to end), debugging, and Git\-based workflows * Experience designing and building APIs, services, and web applications * Track record of owning software end to end, from design through production support * Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows * Experience building on a major cloud platform (Azure preferred; AWS or GCP considered) * Solid SQL and relational database design skills * Hands\-on experience with AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, or similar * Understanding of secure coding practices and of handling sensitive or regulated data * Strong communication skills and the ability to work directly with non\-technical stakeholders * Experience mentoring other developers or leading code review ### **Nice to Have** * Experience in the Microsoft ecosystem: Azure, .NET, SQL Server, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, or Power Platform * Experience building ETL/ELT pipelines or working in Lakehouse or data warehouse environments * Infrastructure\-as\-code experience (Bicep, Terraform, or ARM) * Experience building applications on top of LLMs or agentic frameworks * Experience in healthcare, ABA, EHR/EMR, claims, or other regulated environments * Exposure to HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, SOC 2, or related compliance frameworks ### **Why This Role Matters** This role is foundational to how Mosaic builds software over the next several years. You will shape the architecture, standards, and engineering culture behind the next generation of internal applications and AI\-enabled systems. Instead of owning one narrow slice, you will set the direction for how software gets built and maintained across the company. **Compensation \& Benefits** ---------------------------- * Competitive salary based on experience * Health, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) * PTO and paid holidays * Remote\-first flexibility * Equipment and tooling support We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: **OVERVIEW** *A thriving, mission\-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award\-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.* *Across our organization, we're building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR**.* *This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.* ### **Intro to Position** NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player\-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid\-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build\-versus\-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work\-life balance. ### **Responsibilities** * **People Leadership:** Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid\-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth. * **Delivery:** Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI\-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders. * **Engineering Standards:** Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team. * **Code Quality and Architecture:** Review designs and code, and contribute hands\-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards. * **Testing and Evaluation:** Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team. * **Production Support:** Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow\-up reviews to prevent repeat problems. * **Vendor Evaluation:** Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner. * **NPR\-wide AI Tool Review:** Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve. * **Vendor Relationships:** Take over day\-to\-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. * **Responsible Scaling:** Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost\-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections. **The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.** ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands\-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them. * 2\+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers. * Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards. * Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews. * Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Hands\-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Experience working across technical and non\-technical teams, including expla working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution. * Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team. * Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews. ### **Required Skills/Competencies** * Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search. * Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation * Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake. * Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama. * Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat\-based and usage\-based pricing. * Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias. ### **Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Work Location \& Requirements** * Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR\-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose. ### **Job Type** * This is a full\-time, exempt position. ### **Compensation** **Salary Range**: The U.S.\-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 \- 206,000 plus benefits. jobs.title: Manager, AI Engineering and Vendor Operations
jobs.description: **OVERVIEW** *A thriving, mission\-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award\-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.* *Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR**.* *This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.* ### **Intro to Position** NPR's AI Labs team is looking for a Manager of AI Engineering and Vendor Operations. This person will serve on the AI Labs leadership team and help inform NPR's AI technical strategy. We are seeking a player\-coach style who understands the complexities of building adaptive and conscientious AI coding teams, and can help us apply rigor and standards to our infrastructure decisions and rollouts. In this role, you will supervise the mid\-level engineering staff, provide mentorship and support to NPR's larger engineering teams and own the evaluation and deployment of the team's AI tools and vendors. This role suits someone who can weigh build\-versus\-buy decisions honestly, explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical colleagues, and hold both vendors and our own work to NPR's standards for privacy, security, and accuracy. This is a chance to shape a new team and have a tangible effect on how NPR uses AI responsibly in service of its mission, on a team built on respect, trust, and work\-life balance. ### **Responsibilities** * **People Leadership:** Manage and mentor a team of entry and mid\-level AI engineers, including hiring, onboarding, and supporting each person's professional growth. * **Delivery:** Lead technical planning, scoping, and sprint execution for AI Labs engineering work, such as NPR's AI\-powered metadata service, in partnership with AI Labs leadership and editorial and business stakeholders. * **Engineering Standards:** Work with AI Labs leadership to develop AI coding frameworks, practices, and expectations for the team. * **Code Quality and Architecture:** Review designs and code, and contribute hands\-on where it helps the team, keeping systems maintainable, secure, and consistent with NPR's technical standards. * **Testing and Evaluation:** Build and maintain automated testing and model evaluation practices, including regression tests and evaluation checks before release, aligned with quality bars set by the product team. * **Production Support:** Coordinate the team's response to production bugs and infrastructure incidents, and lead follow\-up reviews to prevent repeat problems. * **Vendor Evaluation:** Lead technical evaluations of AI vendors, models, and tools, covering architecture, data handling, security, and cost, and recommend whether NPR should build, buy, or partner. * **NPR\-wide AI Tool Review:** Participate in AI Labs' review of AI tools requested by teams across NPR, working with IT Security through the vendor risk and security intake processes. AI Labs assesses, and IT and the Office of General Counsel approve. * **Vendor Relationships:** Take over day\-to\-day management of selected AI vendors and tools, from onboarding and seat provisioning through renewal and offboarding. * **Responsible Scaling:** Track vendor usage, spend, and renewal dates against budget, and ensure AI systems scale securely and cost\-effectively while maintaining strong data privacy protections. **The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.** ### **Minimum Qualifications** * 5\+ years of experience building and shipping production AI or machine learning systems, with deep hands\-on knowledge of large language models and the systems built around them. * 2\+ years of experience managing or mentoring engineers. * Experience setting engineering practices for a team, such as code review, testing, or deployment standards. * Experience working with technology vendors and managing software tools, including security and data privacy reviews. * Experience building automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Hands\-on experience building in a major cloud environment (Azure, AWS, or GCP). * Experience setting up automated testing, including methods for evaluating the quality of AI model outputs. * Experience working across technical and non\-technical teams, including explaining technical and cost trade\-offs to people without a technical background and working with product managers to gather requirements from stakeholders. ### **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience in a media organization, newsroom, or public service institution. * Experience onboarding staff into a new or growing team. * Experience working with procurement, legal, or vendor risk teams on technology reviews. ### **Required Skills/Competencies** * Strong Python skills and working knowledge of retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) and semantic search. * Proficiency in design and architecture of AI systems and systems of AI evaluation * Proficiency in SQL and cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery or Snowflake. * Familiarity with model evaluation methods, prompt engineering, and API integration, including NPR's approved model families such as Claude, Gemini, Gemma, and Llama. * Ability to assess vendor security documentation, data processing terms, and seat\-based and usage\-based pricing. * Commitment to data privacy, AI ethics, and identifying and reducing bias. ### **Education Requirements** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. ### **Work Location \& Requirements** * Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. Some aspects of this role include duties that are better performed at an NPR facility. The employee will be required to be in the office, preferably at the Washington, DC location, at least 2 days a week. The employee must also reside in an NPR\-supported location based on the number of onsite days they choose. ### **Job Type** * This is a full\-time, exempt position. ### **Compensation** **Salary Range**: The U.S.\-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $180,000 \- 206,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations. **NPR Benefits**: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full\-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well\-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long\-term disability, short\-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees. **Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.** \#LI\-HYBRID The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations. NPR Pay Range $180,000 \- $206,000 USD NPR is an Equal Opportunity Employer. NPR is committed to being an inclusive workplace that welcomes diverse and unique perspectives, all working toward the same goal – to create a more informed public. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Niantic Spatial** AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99\.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI\-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. **About the Role** You’ll join a small infrastructure team with broad, shared ownership — the engineers who keep Niantic Spatial running. The team covers the cloud platform, the developer tooling every engineer depends on, and the edge services our customers’ requests pass through. You’ll work across SRE, infrastructure, and developer platform alongside teammates who know the stack well, and you’ll grow into owning parts of it yourself. Because every engineer here builds on what this team provides, your work will also shape how the whole engineering org builds, ships, and operates. **What You'll Do** * **Cloud and SRE:** Build and maintain cloud infrastructure as code, and help improve reliability through monitoring, alerting, and service\-level objectives. * **Developer Platform:** Help run our source control, CI/CD pipelines, and build infrastructure so engineers can ship quickly and safely. * **Production Operations:** Share on\-call, take part in incident response and follow\-up, and automate away repetitive operational work. * **Edge and Delivery:** Help run the edge API gateway, CDN, and authentication and authorization systems with the rest of the team. * **Compute and GPU Management:** Help provision and monitor compute and GPU capacity across teams. * **AI\-Assisted Operations:** Use AI tools to help build, automate, and maintain our infrastructure, and help shape how the team uses them. **What You'll Bring** * **Years of Experience:** 3\+ years in infrastructure, SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering. * **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * **Infrastructure as Code:** Experience managing infrastructure as code with tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, or similar. * **Cloud:** Hands\-on experience with GCP, AWS, or another major cloud provider in production. * **CI/CD:** Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitLab, GitHub Actions, or similar. * **Containers:** Production experience with containers and container orchestration, such as Kubernetes. * **Core Technical Skills:** Proficiency in at least one programming language such as Python, Go, TypeScript, or C\+\+, plus shell scripting and Linux systems. * **AI in Your Workflow:** Comfort using AI\-assisted tools in your engineering work, or a strong interest in building that habit. We’ll help you ramp up on how we use AI here. **Nice to Have** * Familiarity with API gateways, load balancers, or CDNs. * Familiarity with modern authentication and authorization, such as OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, or cloud IAM. * Experience with GPU workloads or ML infrastructure. * Experience with message queuing systems. **Location \& Work Model** This role is based in our San Francisco or Sunnyvale, CA office, or in Bellevue, WA. We work in a high\-collaboration environment and ask team members to be on\-site a minimum of 3 days per week. **Compensation \& Benefits** The base salary range for this position is $171,000 \- $230,000 for Bay Area candidates and $162,500 \- $218,500 for Seattle/Bellevue candidates. Actual salary is based on assessed skills, experience, and location. This role is also eligible for equity, bonus, and benefits. Your recruiter can answer questions about total compensation during the hiring process. **Inclusive Application** We know the strongest candidates don't always tick every box. If you're excited about this role and believe you could do it well, we encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't match every qualification listed — you may be exactly who we're looking for. **Equal Opportunity** Niantic Spatial is an equal opportunity employer. Individuals seeking employment at Niantic Spatial are considered without regard to race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, creed, age, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding or related medical conditions), marital status, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected category under applicable laws. Niantic Spatial will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with applicable laws. Please contact your recruiter if you want to request an accommodation for the job application or interview process. **Candidate Privacy** I understand that by submitting my job application, the information I provide as part of that application will be used in accordance with Niantic Spatial's Privacy Notice for Job Applicants and Candidates https://www.nianticspatial.com/applicant\-privacy\-notice.
