jobs.title: Platform Engineer, Cloud AI Infrastructure, Sr
jobs.description: Summary The Senior Platform Engineer, Cloud \& AI Infrastructure designs, builds, automates, and operates the secure cloud platforms that enable OnPoint’s AI, data, analytics, and automation capabilities in Azure and M365\. This is a senior, hands\-on engineering role responsible for translating complex requirements into reliable, reusable, and production\-ready platform services. The position provides technical leadership for assigned Azure and AI infrastructure capabilities, including architecture, infrastructure automation, identity and networking integration, observability, resiliency, and cost optimization. It establishes engineering patterns that help teams move from experimentation to production without compromising security, supportability, or enterprise standards. Working with Technology Operations, Architecture, Information Security, Data, Solution Engineering, and the Innovation Center of Excellence, this role resolves complex platform challenges, mentors engineers, and enables approved self\-service capabilities. The position leads through technical expertise and cross\-team influence rather than people management. Primary outcomes, first 12 months * Establish reusable, automated deployment patterns for priority cloud, AI, and data workloads. * Reduce provisioning lead time and manual configuration through infrastructure as code and standardized platform services. * Act as the Microsoft ecosystem (365, Azure, etc.) evangelist of new and existing capabilities – the first to be informed, the first to use, the first to teach others to use, and always with energy and commitment to ensuring this platform’s return on investment. * Implement production\-readiness standards covering security, monitoring, support ownership, recovery, and cost. * Improve reliability and operational visibility through service health measures, actionable alerts, and tested recovery procedures. * Establish platform cost and capacity baselines and deliver prioritized optimization improvements. * Enable safe experimentation and repeatable promotion into production through approved environments and controls. Key responsibilities Cloud architecture and platform engineering * Independently lead the design and implementation of complex Azure infrastructure spanning compute, storage, networking, identity, security, and shared platform services. * Develop and maintain reference architectures, reusable deployment patterns, and documented technical decisions aligned with enterprise architecture standards. * Translate business and workload requirements into designs that balance reliability, security, performance, cost, and operational complexity. * Identify platform dependencies and constraints, recommend improvements, and contribute to platform roadmaps and lifecycle planning. Infrastructure automation and delivery * Engineer version\-controlled infrastructure using Terraform and/or Bicep, supported by PowerShell, Azure CLI, or Python. * Utilize Microsoft 365 and other platforms to automate corporate functions for IT Operations and advise on how other teams can do the same. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with automated validation, controlled promotion, secure configuration, and recovery or rollback procedures. * Establish reusable modules and approved self\-service provisioning patterns that reduce manual work and configuration drift. * Apply code review, testing, documentation, and change\-management practices to infrastructure engineering. AI and data platform enablement * Engineer the infrastructure foundations for AI services, agent workloads, Databricks, and related enterprise data and automation platforms. * Implement secure connectivity, workload identities, secrets management, environment separation, capacity controls, and platform telemetry. * Partner with application, AI, and data engineers to establish scalable deployment and operational patterns for inference, retrieval, and agent workloads. * Support infrastructure dependencies and integrations for Microsoft 365, Copilot, and Power Platform in partnership with their platform owners. * Clearly define infrastructure ownership, application responsibilities, and support boundaries before production release. Security, governance, and operational resilience * Implement approved identity, access, networking, encryption, policy, and monitoring controls in partnership with Information Security. * Define and monitor service\-level indicators and objectives for assigned platform services. * Maintain operational runbooks, configuration evidence, recovery\-test results, and technical documentation supporting audit and operational readiness. Technical leadership and collaboration * Lead technical delivery for complex platform initiatives and coordinate dependencies across teams. * Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, troubleshooting, and knowledge sharing. * Explain technical options, risks, and trade\-offs clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. * Evaluate emerging capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, security, maintainability, and total cost – particularly but not limited to the Microsoft ecosystem. Required qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * Seven or more years of progressively responsible infrastructure, systems, cloud, or platform engineering experience, including substantial hands\-on Azure engineering experience. * Demonstrated ability to independently design, implement, and operate complex production cloud solutions. * Advanced knowledge of Azure networking, private connectivity, DNS, identity, role\-based access, managed identities, secrets management, and cloud governance. * Demonstrated experience building reusable infrastructure as code and automated deployment pipelines using Git\-based engineering practices. * Strong scripting and automation capability using PowerShell, Python, and/or Azure CLI. * Experience implementing observability, performance tuning, capacity management, high availability, and tested disaster recovery. * Hands\-on experience supporting production AI or data platform infrastructure, with the ability to explain its security, connectivity, scaling, and operational requirements. * Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex, cross\-platform issues and lead corrective action. * Experience leading technical implementations, mentoring engineers, and communicating architectural trade\-offs. Certifications Required * An active Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert certification, or the ability to obtain it within 12 months of hire, supported by demonstrated equivalent architecture and engineering experience. Preferred * Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, particularly for candidates with strong infrastructure automation and delivery\-pipeline responsibilities. Preferred qualifications * Experience with Azure\-hosted AI services, agent infrastructure, retrieval architectures, and secure model\-service connectivity. * Experience with Databricks infrastructure, workspace deployment, private networking, identity integration, and platform monitoring. * Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure Policy, Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Key Vault, and Microsoft Defender for Cloud. * Experience supporting Microsoft 365, Copilot, or Power Platform integrations and environment governance. * Experience in financial services or another regulated enterprise environment. * Experience developing shared platform services, self\-service engineering capabilities, and cloud cost\-management practices. If you need any accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know. We're dedicated to providing what's necessary to ensure a fair and inclusive experience.

jobs.title: AI Ops Engineer (GTM)
jobs.description: Orbital is the AI platform for real estate legal work. Real estate shapes the world around us: our homes, our workplaces and our cultural landmarks. It’s the infrastructure that powers everyday life and is the world's largest asset class. Yet behind every single deal, real estate and legal teams work hard to navigate decades\-old complexity; manually connecting documents, hidden obligations, geo\-spatial context, and multiple parties into a path forward. We connect the legal and physical record, so that path is clearer than ever before. Our mission is to make real estate transactions faster, clearer, and less manual. Here, you'll be part of changing how the deals behind the largest asset class get transacted, and will help shape the future of real estate. **A bit about us:** We’re building at the forefront of AI technology, without losing the deeply human expertise our clients depend on. Orbital is built with former practising real estate lawyers and 250\+ years of combined legal expertise. We're purpose\-built for the complexity of real estate: accelerating due diligence, drafting and negotiation, and deal coordination with legal\-grade precision. We've just raised a $60m Series B, led by Brighton Park Capital, to accelerate our global expansion – $75m raised to date. We're trusted by 5,000\+ real estate professionals, spanning UK Magic Circle and US Am Law 100 firms, to household names like M\&S. Leading firms like BCLP, Orrick, Goodwin, Womble Bond Dickinson and Clifford Chance rely on Orbital to remove the busywork, freeing legal and real estate teams to focus on sharp judgment, standout client service, and closing deals faster. Working at Orbital means joining a bold, ambitious team, with the trust to take ownership and make a real impact from day one. **The Role** We're rebuilding Orbital's go\-to\-market around AI. Not by adding another tool to the stack, but by rethinking how we find, win and grow customers from first principles. As an AI Ops Engineer (GTM) on our Revenue team, you'll sit with the people doing the work across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Product and Finance. You'll question how we work today, reimagine it from first principles with AI, and build what replaces it. You're essentially an internal forward deployed engineer. Over time, you'll help join up the whole business so every team works off the same data and foundations. The technology is changing every month. We want someone who finds new and unusual ways of doing things, and builds them so they keep working as the tools change. You'll report to the VP of RevOps. This role is for someone early in their career with exceptional raw ability: we care far more about how fast you learn and what you've built than about years of experience or job titles. **What you'll do** * Embed with revenue teams to understand how they work, and spot where AI and automation could change the outcome * Build AI agents, workflows and integrations that remove manual work and help teams make better decisions * Connect our systems (CRM, marketing, CS, product and finance data) so teams work from one trusted picture of the customer * Try new approaches, test them quickly with real users, and keep what works * Ship in short cycles and prove impact. Build the measures that show pipeline created, conversion lift and time saved * Build things to last: documented, maintainable and easy to adapt as models and tools change * Share what you learn and help colleagues get more out of AI **What you'll bring** * A strong academic background in a quantitative or technical subject (for example computer science, engineering, maths, physics or economics), or equivalent evidence of exceptional ability * Clear evidence that you build: side projects, tools, automations, a GitHub, a startup, hackathons, or things you've shipped at work * Hands\-on experience building with AI, such as LLM APIs, agents or AI coding tools * Some coding ability (for example Python, JavaScript or SQL) and comfort working with APIs * Exceptional problem\-solving: you break messy problems down, learn new things quickly and explain your thinking simply * Commercial instincts. You understand how pipeline is created, speak the language of AEs and marketers, and prioritise what moves revenue * Comfort with ambiguity and a strong sense of ownership in a lean, fast\-moving team **Nice to have** * Time in a customer\-facing, sales or consulting role * Experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or automation tools such as n8n, Zapier or Make * Experience at an early\-stage or fast\-growing startup **Salary:** $100,000 – $120,000 \+ equity \+ benefits (New York) **Security is everyone’s responsibility at Orbital.** We ask all team members to follow our security policies, complete regular awareness training, and handle sensitive data with care in line with ISO 27001 standards. Spot something unusual? Reporting risks or incidents quickly helps us maintain the strong culture of security and compliance we all depend on. **At Orbital, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive team.** We especially welcome applications from people who are traditionally underrepresented in tech. Even if you don’t meet every single requirement, or if the right role isn’t listed yet, we’d still love to hear from you. **This hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting**. Pay is based on several factors, which may include job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and business requirements. *Everyone who works with Orbital goes through background screening before they start. It's part of how we keep Orbital secure, for the people who work here and for the client information we're trusted with.*

jobs.title: FPGA Engineer
jobs.description: Are you an engineer with deep experience in FPGA development who likes to build systems from first principles? FPGAs play an integral role in Oxide’s Cloud Computer: our approach to hardware/software co\-design has them at the center of our board management, monitoring, and overall product functionality. We are looking for FPGA engineers to join our team to work on our next\-generation products. **As an engineer focused on soft logic platform enablement, you will:** ----------------------------------------------------------------------- * Develop VHDL code that enables core board functionality ranging from power sequencing and monitoring to flash content hash offload * Work with hardware engineers developing boards and signal paths around FPGAs * Collaborate with software engineers to develop interfaces and protocols * Develop tooling to accelerate FPGA workflows and integrate FPGA\-based systems at the hardware/software interface * Directly participate in the design and evolution of the Oxide hardware platform **You will thrive in this role if you:** ---------------------------------------- * Have experience achieving timing closure on FPGA designs of varying size and performance, including I/O timing analysis * Have experience implementing soft cores as well as working with hard IP, particularly with AMD/Xilinx devices and tools * Have experience with a variety of protocols such as I2C/I3C, SPI/QSPI, eSPI, and low\-speed serial communication protocols * Have experience with high\-speed SERDES based protocols and encodings (e.g. 8b10b) * Are energized by the thought of working with a diverse group of hardware and software engineers to codesign hardware platforms * Produce good documentation and/or written descriptions of your ideas * Have experience building, shipping, and maintaining digital systems in the field * Prefer continuous integration, testing, and automation over vendor GUIs **Before applying for this role, you should:** ---------------------------------------------- * Browse our public Requests for Discussion to get a flavor for how we work. * Listen to Hiring Processes with Gergely Orosz to familiarize yourself with the Oxide hiring process. * Check out our blog post on how we do remote hardware development * Listen to some of our hardware\-centric episodes of *Oxide and Friends*. A few recommendations: + Bringing up Cosmo on bringing up our AMD Turin\-based compute sled + Tales from the Bringup Lab on bringing up our first compute sled + The Sidecar Switch on bringing up our switch + Oxide and the Chamber of Mysteries on our escapades achieving EMI compliance + The Power of Proto Boards! on how we quickly iterate on board design + The Network Behind the Network on the specific challenges of our service processor network + Rack\-scale Networking to understand our approach to networking and some of the details of our implementation **Life at Oxide** ----------------- We are very explicit about our values, and they can be seen in daily life at Oxide, for example: * Our rigor means we enjoy and take pride in the craft of engineering. * Our urgency means that we are not above the judicious short\-cut. * Our versatility is reflected in our greatest strength: the breadth of our team. * Our transparency can be seen in our consensus\-driven RFD process. * Our responsibility means that we both lead and follow: we have our own domains, but we also help others on their parts. * Our curiosity shows in our insatiable desire to learn – and our empathy in our love of teaching others. * Our humor is a big part of our daily lives: we are inveterate wise\-crackers whose video meetings spill into simultaneous text chat. **Working at Oxide** -------------------- ### **Remote first** Most of our team are based outside of the Bay Area. We do ask that your workday overlaps with Pacific Time for at least four hours. ### **Flexible working hours** Our families and lives outside of our jobs are very important to us; our schedules are flexible to reflect and support that. ### **Premium healthcare** We offer the best medical PPO, dental, and vision plans we can find and cover 100% of premiums for employees and dependents. ### **Compensation** Everyone at Oxide makes $275,000 USD, regardless of location. (Some sales positions have a lower base salary and contain a commission component.)

jobs.title: Artificial Intelligence Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Profile****Position Overview** ===================== At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a(n) Artificial Intelligence Engineer within PNC's technology organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA, Dallas, TX, Strongsville, OH, Birmingham, AL, Denver, CO. Why This Job Matters As a Software Engineer, you will be responsible for supporting PNC's Data \& Analytics (DnA) organization by designing, developing, and deploying AI\-powered applications and agentic systems that leverage large language models (LLMs), orchestration frameworks, and enterprise data platforms. You will work closely with data scientists, data engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business needs into scalable AI solutions. In addition to development responsibilities, you will monitor production AI solutions, analyze performance and telemetry metrics, identify optimization opportunities, and implement enhancements to improve reliability, efficiency, and business outcomes. What You'll Do * Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and GenAI\-driven applications. * Develop agentic workflows utilizing modern orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph and LangChain. * Build integrations with internal and external systems through REST APIs and other service interfaces. * Implement and support Model Context Protocol (MCP) based solutions and integrations. * Develop AI\-powered automation solutions for data and analytics use cases. * Collaborate with data scientists to operationalize AI models and measure business impact. * Monitor deployed AI agents using observability and telemetry tools to evaluate performance, reliability, and usage patterns. * Troubleshoot, optimize, and maintain AI applications in production environments. * Partner with data engineers and analytics teams to automate and enhance data workflows. * Contribute to best practices for AI engineering, model governance, scalability, and software development. Preferred Experience * Experience building or integrating AI, machine learning, Generative AI, or LLM\-based solutions. * Experience deploying and supporting production software solutions. * Experience building autonomous or agentic AI systems. * Experience with PySpark and/or data engineering pipelines. * Familiarity with cloud\-native development and AI services. * Experience with observability, monitoring, telemetry, and operational analytics. * Experience working in large\-scale enterprise environments. jobs.title: Data Scientist II - Machine Learning for GEOINT and Remote Sensing
jobs.description: Overview: At PNNL, our core capabilities are divided among major departments that we refer to as Directorates within the Lab, focused on a specific area of scientific research or other function, with its own leadership team and dedicated budget. Our Science \& Technology directorates include National Security, Earth and Biological Sciences, Physical and Computational Sciences, and Energy and Environment. In addition, we have an Environmental Molecular Sciences Laboratory, a Department of Energy, Office of Science user facility housed on the PNNL campus. The National Security Directorate (NSD) drives science\-based, mission\-focused solutions to take on complex, real\-world threats to our nation and the world. The AI and Data Analytics Division, part of the National Security Directorate, combines profound domain expertise and creative integration of advanced hardware and software to deliver computational solutions that address complex data and analytic challenges. Working in multidisciplinary teams, we connect foundational research to engineering to operations, providing the tools to innovate quickly and field results faster. Our strengths are integrated across the data analytics lifecycle, from data acquisition and management to analysis and decision support. Rockstar Rewards: Employees and their families are offered medical insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, robust telehealth care options, several mental health benefits, free wellness coaching, health savings account, flexible spending accounts, basic life insurance, disability insurance\*, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, tuition assistance, relocation, backup childcare, legal benefits, supplemental parental bonding leave, surrogacy and adoption assistance, and fertility support. Employees are automatically enrolled in our company\-funded pension plan\* and may enroll in our 401 (k) savings plan with company match\*. Employees may accrue up to 120 vacation hours per year and may receive ten paid holidays per year. * Research Associates excluded. \*\*All benefits are dependent upon eligibility. Click Here For Rockstar Rewards Responsibilities: PNNL is seeking a Data Scientist II with experience applying deep learning to develop methods for detecting and classifying targets in electro\-optical (EO) imagery or identifying targets and materials in hyperspectral imagery (HSI). This research supports geospatial intelligence (GEOINT) and national missions. In the AI and Data Analytics Division, you will independently carry out defined research tasks as part of a team developing methods and tools that support intelligence analysis and national missions. Current priorities include automatic target recognition (ATR), long\-wave infrared (LWIR) HSI target detection and material classification, and detection and classification with limited labeled training examples, particularly in EO imagery. The role also offers opportunities to explore related problems in remote sensing and intelligence analysis. Candidates with deep learning experience in EO, HSI, or related sensing applications are encouraged to apply. You will work alongside researchers and domain specialists on difficult national science and technology challenges. Collaboration with software and machine learning (ML) engineers will reflect each project's needs and stage of development. Opportunities to advance existing research and pursue new ideas may come through ongoing projects, internal research investments, or new proposals. **Key Responsibilities:*** Apply and adapt deep learning methods to detection and classification problems. * Investigate research questions through algorithm development, mathematical analysis, experiments, or implementation. * Design reproducible experiments and compare methods, examining detection performance, classification errors, false alarms, and limitations. * Document methods and results and work with software and ML engineers to integrate tested research code and algorithms into usable tools. * Plan and carry out research tasks, discuss progress and challenges with project leads, and contribute ideas to research plans and proposals. * Share technical knowledge across the team and mentor junior colleagues or students as appropriate. * Follow applicable quality, safety, and security requirements. **This position is based in either Richland, WA or Seattle, WA and requires an onsite presence.** Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications:* BS/BA and 2 years of data science experience \-OR\- * MS/MA \-OR\- * PhD * Experience applying deep learning to EO detection and classification or HSI target detection and material classification. * Experience developing deep learning methods using PyTorch or another deep learning framework. Preferred Qualifications:* Experience with the EO or HSI imaging chain, including sensor response, image formation, calibration, and data processing. LWIR HSI experience is particularly valued. * Experience in addressing limit gram. About PNNL: Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is a world\-class research institution powered by a highly educated, diverse workforce committed to the values of Integrity, Creativity, Collaboration, Impact, and Courage. Every year, scores of dynamic, driven people come to PNNL to work with renowned researchers on meaningful science, innovations and outcomes for the U.S. Department of Energy and other sponsors; here is your chance to be one of them! At PNNL, you will find an exciting research environment and excellent benefits including health insurance, and flexible work schedules. PNNL is located in eastern Washington State—the dry side of Washington known for its stellar outdoor recreation and affordable cost of living. The Lab’s campus is only a 45\-minute flight (or \~3 hour drive) from Seattle or Portland, and is serviced by the convenient PSC airport, connected to 8 major hubs. Commitment to Excellence and Equal Employment Opportunity: Our laboratory is committed to fostering a work environment where all individuals are treated with fairness and respect while solving critical challenges in fundamental sciences, national security, and energy resiliency. We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. Pacific Northwest National Laboratory (PNNL) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. PNNL considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information (including family medical history), protected veteran status, and any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local laws. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures and in employment. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, contact us at careers@pnnl.gov. Drug Free Workplace: PNNL is committed to a drug\-free workplace supported by Workplace Substance Abuse Program (WSAP) and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. If you are offered employment at PNNL, you must pass a drug test prior to commencing employment. PNNL complies with federal law regarding illegal drug use. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug. If you test positive for any illegal controlled substance, including marijuana, your offer of employment will be withdrawn. HSPD\-12 PIV Credential Requirement: As a national laboratory, PNNL is responsible for adhering to the Homeland Security Presidential Directive 12 (HSPD\-12\) and Department of Energy (DOE) Order 473\.1A, which require new employees to obtain and maintain a HSPD\-12 Personal Identify Verification (PIV) Credential. To obtain this credential, new employees must successfully complete the applicable tier of federal background investigation post hire and receive a favorable federal adjudication. The tier of federal background investigation will be determined by job duties and national security or public trust responsibilities associated with the job. All tiers of investigation include a declaration of illegal drug activities, including use, supply, possession, or manufacture within the last 1 to 7 years (depending on the applicable tier of investigation). Illegal drug activities include marijuana and cannabis derivatives, which are still considered illegal under federal law, regardless of state laws. For foreign national candidates: If you have not resided in the U.S. for three consecutive years, you are not eligible for the PIV credential and instead will need to obtain a favorable Local Site Specific Only (LSSO) Federal risk determination to maintain employment. Once you meet the three\-year residency requirement thereafter, you will be required to obtain a PIV credential to maintain employment. The tier of federal background investigation required to obtain the PIV credential will be determined by job duties at the time you become eligible for the PIV credential.

In every line of service, in every position and area of expertise, PANTHERx associates are driven to provide the highest quality outcomes for our patients.* *We are seeking team members who:* *Are inspired and compassionate problem solvers;* *Produce high quality work;* *Thrive in the excitement of the ever\-challenging environment of modern medicine; and* *Are committed to achieving superior health outcomes for people living with rare and devastating diseases.* *At PANTHERx, we know our employees are the driving force in what we do. We cultivate talent and encourage growth within PANTHERx so that our associates can continue to explore their interests and expand their careers. Guided by our mission to provide uncompromising quality every day, we continue our strategic growth to further reach those affected by rare diseases.* **Join the PANTHERx team, and define your own RxARE future in healthcare!** **Location:** Pittsburgh, PA\-Hybrid **Classification:** Exempt **Status:** Full\-Time **Reports To:** Manager, Software Development **Purpose:** The Software Engineer expands the suite of applications. The position manages systems analysis, development, testing, debugging, documenting, and installing portions of new systems and modifying existing systems. This role independently develops complete coding and develops projects and tasks by meeting established quality measures. **Responsibilities:** * Assists in the development and maintenance of software applications, following established coding standards and best practices. * Collaborates with senior developers and cross\-functional teams to understand project requirements and objectives. * Writes clean, efficient, and well\-documented code for software components and features. * Participates in code reviews to learn from feedback and improve coding skills. * Debugs and troubleshoots software defects and issues. * Works on software enhancements and new features as directed by senior team members. * Follows version control and software configuration management best practices. * Assists with the integration and testing of software components. * Keeps up to date with emerging technologies and programming languages to enhance your skills. **Required Qualifications:** * Minimum of one year of related work experience in SQL, TSQL, MS .NET, Azure. * At least one of the following: ASP.NET MVC or Web API, WinForms. HTML 5\.0, CSS, and a modern JavaScript Frameworks (e.g. Angular or React.) * Data access technology such as: Microsoft Entity Framework, ADO.NET and/or other object\-relational mapping (ORM) framework. * Relational database (RDBMS) technology such as: Microsoft SQL Server, MySQL or PostgreSQL with a solid understanding of SQL. * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience. **Work Environment:** This job operates in a professional office or home office environment. This role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, and copiers. **Physical** **Demands:** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to see, talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit; stand; walk; use hands and fingers to handle or feel; and reach with hands and arms. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job **Benefits:** Hybrid, remote and flexible on\-site work schedules are available, based on the position. PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy also affords an excellent benefit package, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, health savings and flexible spending accounts, 401K with employer matching, employer\-paid life insurance and short/long term disability coverage, and an Employee Assistance Program! Generous paid time off is also available to all full\-time employees, as well as limited paid time off for part\-time employees. Of course we offer paid holidays too! **Equal Opportunity:** PANTHERx Rare Pharmacy is an equal opportunity employer, and does not discriminate in recruiting, hiring, promotions or any term or condition of employment based on race, age, religion, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, protected veteran's status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

jobs.title: Sr Software Engineer
jobs.description: **The Company** PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy. We operate a global, two\-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third\-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers. We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end\-to\-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross\-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross\-border trade. Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities. **Job Summary:** The Payments Risk Engineering team owns fraud detection and risk management at PayPal. We build and support the services called on every money movement transaction between PayPal and its users and partners, scaling across millions of interactions, integrating with APIs in real time, and delivering high availability and configurability to the business. We're looking for strong technologists who love solving large\-scale, complex engineering problems in a repeatable, maintainable way. You'll build deep skills in software design, API design, data structures, and algorithms, along with a solid grasp of business processes. You'll work directly with Product Owners and Domain Technical Leads to protect customers while keeping payments seamless, alongside some of the strongest engineering talent in the industry. **Job Description:** **Essential Responsibilities:** * Delivers complete solutions spanning all phases of the Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) (design, implementation, testing, delivery and operations), based on definitions from more senior roles. * Advises immediate management on project\-level issues * Guides junior engineers * Operates with little day\-to\-day supervision, making technical decisions based on knowledge of internal conventions and industry best practices * Applies knowledge of technical best practices in making decisions **Minimum Qualifications:** * 3\+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience. **Additional Responsibilities \& Preferred Qualifications****:** * Bachelor’s degree in computer science or related technical discipline (or equivalent experience of 4\-6 years). * Strong applied experience. You’ve built, broken, and rebuilt software applications. We’re looking for creative thinkers who also know how to create real\-world products. * Proficient in back\-end development using Java EE technologies (e.g. Java language, application servers, servlet containers, JMS, JPA, etc.). * Strong Object\-Oriented Programming skills, with ability to analyze requirements and transform into scalable software designs. * Experience with HTTP, REST API's and competent designing and building web services/microservices in a commercial setting. * Experience with Design Patterns, MVC and frameworks (e.g. Spring). * Experience with Service Oriented Architectures. * Experience with development of scalable and distributed Java services. * Competent in design/implementation for reliability, availability, scalability and performance. * Competent in software engineering tools (e.g. Java build tools) and best practices (e.g. unit testing, test automation, continuous integration, etc.). **Subsidiary:** PayPal **Travel Percent:** 0 * The base pay for this role will depend on where you work and the relevant experience and expertise you bring. The expected range of pay for this role by location is: **Primary Location \| Pay Range:** San Jose, California: ($143,500\.00 \- $212,850\.00 Annually) **Additional Location(s) \| Pay Range:** No other locations are assigned to this requisition currently. Additional compensation for this role may include an annual performance bonus, equity, or other incentive compensation, as applicable. PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. When making an application directly, we will never ask you to share passwords, one\-time passcodes (OTP), or verification codes. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. All communication regarding your application will come from official PayPal email domains. If you suspect fraudulent activity, please report it immediately. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact\-us. For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in\-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations. **Our Benefits:** At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset\-you. That’s why we offer comprehensive, choice\-based programs, to support all aspects of personal wellbeing—physical, emotional, and financial—delivering meaningful value where it matters most. We strive to create a flexible, balanced work culture with a holistic approach to benefits, including generous paid time off, healthcare coverage for you and your family, and resources to create financial security and support your mental health. **Who We Are:** **Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion** PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com. **Belonging at PayPal:** Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal. Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community. We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: About the Company Pendo is a software company headquartered in Raleigh, North Carolina, specializing in product experience, product analytics, and digital adoption solutions. Its platform helps organizations understand user behavior, improve digital experiences, and build better software products. Job Description Pendo is seeking a motivated Software Developer to support the design, development, testing, and maintenance of modern software applications. The successful candidate will work with engineering and product teams to develop reliable features, improve application performance, and deliver effective technology solutions. This position is suited to a developer with strong programming knowledge, analytical thinking, and an interest in building scalable software products. Key Responsibilities * Develop, test, and maintain software applications. * Write clean, reusable, and efficient code. * Build and maintain application features and APIs. * Collaborate with engineering and product development teams. * Identify and resolve software bugs and technical issues. * Participate in code reviews and software testing. * Improve application performance, scalability, and reliability. * Maintain technical documentation and development standards. Required Skills * Knowledge of JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar languages. * Understanding of software engineering principles. * Familiarity with databases, APIs, and web technologies. * Experience with Git and modern development tools. * Knowledge of application testing and debugging. * Strong communication and problem\-solving abilities. Benefits * Competitive compensation * Health, dental, and vision coverage * Retirement savings options * Paid time off and holidays * Professional development opportunities * Collaborative work environment **Work Environment:** Collaborative software engineering and product development environment. Pay: $95,000\.00 \- $135,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Project Engineer of Foods Operations
jobs.description: Perdue Foods has a goal of becoming the most trusted name in premium proteins by creating products for consumers and for retail and foodservice customers around the globe while changing the way animals are raised for food. It is part of Perdue Farms, a fourth\-generation, family\-owned food and agricultural business deeply rooted in tradition yet with a forward\-thinking mindset. We believe that success starts with our people, and our culture is built on a foundation of teamwork, integrity, and respect, where every voice matters and everyone is encouraged to contribute to our shared goals. We are dedicated to creating a supportive, inclusive environment where associates feel valued and inspired to make an impact, both within the company and in the communities we serve. From promoting growth and development to prioritizing work\-life balance, we’re committed to helping our team members thrive. **That's Perdue.** **Summary** Drive operational excellence and capital project success across foods operations as a Project Engineer. In this role, you lead capital planning and execution for harvest plants, ensuring projects support safety, compliance, quality, and profitable growth. You partner closely with operations, engineering, and cross\-functional teams to deliver projects on time, within budget, and aligned to business objectives. Leveraging strong technical expertise and project management skills, you build plans, manage risks, and coordinate resources to keep projects on track. This role is ideal for a collaborative, hands\-on engineer who thrives in dynamic environments and is passionate about delivering impactful, high\-quality results. This position is located onsite at our facility in Washington, IN. **Principal Essential Duties \& Responsibilities** * Develop and lead technical strategies and tactics focused on safety, compliance, quality, environmental performance, profitable growth, and cost. * Partner collaboratively with operations and engineering leadership to execute capital projects aligned with company values and project deliverables. * Manage capital projects, including facility infrastructure, equipment, production systems, technical maintenance support, environmental initiatives, and energy utilization. * Conduct project meetings with cross\-functional teams to ensure scope and business objectives are delivered on time and within budget. * Utilize engineering work processes to support successful project execution. * Build project timelines, clearly define objectives, and identify risks. * Develop 5\-year capital plans and forecast spending for assigned areas. * Train project managers and team members on project management methodologies and best practices. * Serve as a technical resource for project teams. * Escalate issues to leadership to maintain project timelines and performance. * Report key project management metrics. * Build and maintain accurate floor plans and equipment layouts. * Ensure infrastructure meets or exceeds operational needs, including safety, code compliance, and mechanical, electrical, boiler, and HVAC systems. * Collaborate with safety, quality, operations, maintenance, and environmental teams to support project success. **Minimum Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, electrical, agricultural, civil, structural engineering, or a related discipline. * 3\-5 years of related work experience. * Ability to travel 10% of the time to remote facilities and project sites. * Demonstrate proficiency with Microsoft Office and AutoCAD. **Preferred Education and Experience** * Experience in construction, grain material handling, milling equipment, project management, and equipment layout. * Demonstrate experience in problem solving, negotiating, managing resources, and establishing and meeting schedules. **Physical Requirements and Environmental Factors** * Work is performed on project and plant sites, including active production environments. * Perform floor\-level activities such as troubleshooting and redesign of existing systems. * Move equipment and access files, supplies, and tools as needed. * Work in environments including offices, construction sites, harvest plants, live receiving, and wastewater facilities. * Exposure to wet and moist floors, including metal and plastic grating surfaces. * Exposure to temperatures ranging from 28°F to 100°F and high humidity levels. * Exposure to noise levels ranging from 50 dB to 110 db. * Exposure to chemicals used in processing and wastewater facilities. * Wear required personal protective and safety equipment. * Work at heights and around operating equipment. * Follow Lockout/Tagout procedures. *Perdue Farms Inc. is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status.*

jobs.title: Senior AI Research Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Help Build a New AI\-Native Operating Model** At Pfizer, we're investing in the future of AI\-enabled drug discovery. This role is about more than using AI to improve existing ways of working. We are building a new operating model in which small, highly capable teams combine human expertise with AI to achieve outcomes and move at a pace that previously required much larger organizations. We are looking for people who want to help invent and champion that model: individuals willing to rethink how work is organized, how problems are decomposed, what can be delegated to intelligent systems, and how humans and AI work together most effectively. Successful candidates will use AI not simply as a productivity tool, but as a means to fundamentally transform how scientific and technical work gets done—and will help others across R\&D adopt these new ways of working. **Why This Role Is Different** **Own Meaningful Problems** You'll own critical AI capabilities from architecture through production deployment. Rather than contributing to isolated components, you'll lead the design and delivery of end\-to\-end systems that directly enable scientific discovery. **Work Where AI Meets Real\-World Impact** The systems you build will support researchers tackling some of the toughest challenges in medicine, helping accelerate insights across discovery, development, and translational science. **Operate at the Frontier of AI** You will work across technologies and domains including: * Large Language Models (LLMs) * Agentic AI Systems * Multimodal Learning * Scientific Machine Learning * Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) * Knowledge Graphs * Distributed Training and Inference * AI Platforms and MLOps * AI Evaluation and Benchmarking **Accelerate Your Growth** You'll work alongside experts in AI, engineering, computational biology, and drug discovery while taking on increasing technical ownership and influence. **Build, Ship, Learn, Repeat** We value engineers who can move from ambiguity to execution, convert ideas into working systems, measure outcomes, and continuously improve based on real\-world feedback. **The Opportunity** As a Senior AI Research Engineer, you will build the machine learning systems that transform innovative models into secure, reliable, and scalable capabilities for scientists across Pfizer. You will: * Own an end\-to\-end subsystem, platform capability, or workflow * Make sound architecture and design tradeoff decisions * Deliver production\-quality software and AI solutions * Drive technical execution for complex projects * Influence engineering standards and best practices * Help less\-experienced engineers grow through collaboration, code reviews, and technical coaching Success in this role requires strong engineering fundamentals, demonstrated experience delivering production systems, and the ability to operate effectively in an environment where science, technology, and business impact intersect. **What You'll Do** **Build the AI Systems Behind Tomorrow's Scientific Breakthroughs** * Design, develop, and deploy production\-grade AI systems supporting multimodal biomedical models and intelligent agents * Engineer data pipelines, retrieval systems, evaluation frameworks, knowledge systems, inference services, and human\-in\-the\-loop workflows * Create scalable software that enables AI capabilities to move beyond experimentation and into everyday scientific use **Own End\-to\-End Technical Delivery** * Translate scientific and business needs into technical solutions * Lead architecture, implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement for your area of ownership * Drive projects from concept through production and operational support **Turn Research Into Impact** * Partner closely with AI scientists, computational biologists, data engineers, and platform teams * Transform promising prototypes into reusable, reliable, and maintainable systems * Develop solutions with clear interfaces, measurable performance, and long\-term sustainability **Make Thoughtful Engineering Tradeoffs** * Balance performance, scalability, cost, reliability, security, privacy, maintainability, and speed of delivery * Apply sound engineering judgment when evaluating technical approaches and system architecture decisions **Build Trusted and Responsible AI** * Strengthen model evaluation, observability, reproducibility, lineage, security, and operational resilience * Implement practices that support responsible and trustworthy AI deployment within scientific environments **Raise the Engineering Bar** * Contribute to architecture reviews, code reviews, engineering standards, and reusable technical patterns * Troubleshoot complex problems and improve engineering quality across the organization * Provide guidance and support to less\-experienced engineers through collaboration and mentorship **Deliver Measurable Outcomes** * Define success metrics and operational indicators * Continuously improve pe fizer location and work on\-site an average of 2\.5 days per week. The annual base salary for this position ranges from $106,000\.00 to $176,600\.00\. In addition, this position is eligible for participation in Pfizer’s Global Performance Plan with a bonus target of 15\.0% of the base salary and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program. We offer comprehensive and generous benefits and programs to help our colleagues lead healthy lives and to support each of life’s moments. Benefits offered include a 401(k) plan with Pfizer Matching Contributions and an additional Pfizer Retirement Savings Contribution, paid vacation, holiday and personal days, paid caregiver/parental and medical leave, and health benefits to include medical, prescription drug, dental and vision coverage. Learn more at Pfizer Candidate Site – U.S. Benefits \| (uscandidates.mypfizerbenefits.com). Pfizer compensation structures and benefit packages are aligned based on the location of hire. The United States salary range provided does not apply to Tampa, FL or any location outside of the United States. This role is posted in multiple locations. If you are applying for the role in an secondary job posting location where pay transparency regulations apply, your Talent Advisor will share the local pay information with you during the first interview. Relocation assistance may be available based on business needs and/or eligibility. Candidates must be authorized to be employed in the U.S. by any employer. U.S. work visa sponsorship (such as TN, O\-1, H\-1B, etc.) is not available for this role now or in the future. **Sunshine Act** Pfizer reports payments and other transfers of value to health care providers as required by federal and state transparency laws and implementing regulations. These laws and regulations require Pfizer to provide government agencies with information such as a health care provider’s name, address and the type of payments or other value received, generally for public disclosure. Subject to further legal review and statutory or regulatory clarification, which Pfizer intends to pursue, reimbursement of recruiting expenses for licensed physicians may constitute a reportable transfer of value under the federal transparency law commonly known as the Sunshine Act. Therefore, if you are a licensed physician who incurs recruiting expenses as a result of interviewing with Pfizer that we pay or reimburse, your name, address and the amount of payments made currently will be reported to the government. If you have questions regarding this matter, please do not hesitate to contact your Talent Acquisition representative. **EEO \& Employment Eligibility** Pfizer is committed to equal opportunity in the terms and conditions of employment for all employees and job applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, gender identity or gender expression, national origin, disability or veteran status. Pfizer also complies with all applicable national, state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements of the Immigration and Nationality Act and IRCA. jobs.title: ITSD - Software Engineer II
jobs.description: **Job Description Summary** =========================== Performs advanced level application development activities which include reviewing and understanding business requirements documentation, completing system and application design, working with existing code libraries, writing application code in various languages, using AI tools to assist in coding and testing, and performing advanced troubleshooting analysis to identify code defects. Assignments include new application development projects and base operations support for both in\-house developed and vendor systems and integrations that range from basic to moderately complex. This is a classified position that reports to the Manager, Application Development. The incumbent performs duties under general supervision, has no supervisory responsibilities, and is expected to provide mentoring and higher\-level technical assistance to other software engineers or ITSD co\-workers. **Job Description** =================== ***Please Note: The Court does not sponsor work visas, student visas, or any other type of immigration visas.*** ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of application and for the duration of employment.*** --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ***The successful candidate will be required to pass a background check following a conditional offer of employment.*** **Salary Range:** **$79,185\.60\- $87,110\.40** **Minimum Qualifications:** A bachelor's degree with a major in computer science, management information systems, or a related field, and five (5\) years of experience in application development; jobs.description: **Location: San Antonio, Texas (on\-site)** **About Ranchflow** Ranchflow builds AI\-powered livestock monitoring and virtual fencing for ranchers. management. * Design reliable data flows between collars, gateways, cloud services, and user applications. * Work with the firmware team to define device communication interfaces, boundary updates, acknowledgements, and synchronization when connectivity is intermittent. * Develop map\-based tools for drawing and editing paddocks, viewing animal locations, and reviewing historical activity. * Improve onboarding, farm setup, collar pairing, and the overall farmer experience. * Own database design, cloud deployment, monitoring, security, and platform performance. * Establish practical standards for code reviews, automated testing, documentation, and release management. * Break product requirements into technical tasks and help coordinate delivery as the team grows. **Requirements** **What you’ll bring** * Two or more years of professional software development experience delivering production software used by real customers. * Strong full\-stack skills, including backend services, APIs, databases, and modern web or mobile applications. * Experience taking ownership of software architecture decisions. * Experience deploying and operating applications on a major cloud platform. * A strong understanding of authentication, access control, data security, and reliable system design. * Experience with automated testing, CI/CD, Git, and collaborative code reviews. * The ability to troubleshoot problems across applications, backend services, and connected systems. * Strong communication skills and comfort working in a small team where priorities evolve through field testing and customer feedback. **Nice to have** * Experience with IoT platforms, connected devices, or hardware\-integrated products. * Experience with mapping, geospatial databases, GPS data, or location\-based applications. * Experience with offline functionality, intermittent connectivity, and data synchronization. * Familiarity with device messaging protocols such as MQTT. * Experience with mobile app releases, device onboarding, Bluetooth, or NFC. * Exposure to agriculture, livestock management, or other field\-deployed technology. **Benefits** * Premier Health Insurance plan with $0 deductible and $0 co\-pay * Dental and vision insurance plans * Flexible spending account options * Open Paid Time Off Policy plus nine paid public holidays * Participation in our 401(k) savings plan * Company\-paid Life and AD\&D coverage * Educational materials and expenses to support related development **About Soilworks Natural Capital:** Ranchflow AI is proud to be a portfolio company of Soilworks Natural Capital, a private equity fund that invests in, incubates, and acquires companies to help accelerate the Regenerative Agriculture movement. Based in San Antonio, TX, Soilworks portfolio companies include Range Ward, Powerflex Supply, Cream Co., Grazing Lands, and Grassroots Carbon. *\*No visa sponsorship is available for this position\**

jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: The code you write here helps protect thousands of businesses across the country from the cyber threats that keep their leadership up at night. That’s the work happening at SBS CyberSecurity every day \-and we’re looking for a Team Lead to help guide the developers building it. This isn’t a role where you disappear into a ticket queue. We want your technical chops – but just as much, we want your judgement, your mentorship, and your ideas about how a team should work. If leading people matters to you as much as writing good code, keep reading **Why SBS** We're a premier cybersecurity firm headquartered in Madison, SD, with a people\-first, collaborative culture that is present every day, even when you’re fully remote. You'll be part of a small, tight\-knit development team working on projects that have a real, visible impact for the organizations that trust us. **What You'll Do**As Team Lead, you'll be a technical leader others look to \- someone accountable for getting large projects, primarily for GRC web applications, across the finish line, on time and on budget, without losing sight of the people doing the work. * Lead and mentor a team of developers through the full project lifecycle, from a rough idea to something live and working. * Help design and build new features in an Agile environment \- you'll stay hands\-on both working on the code yourself as well as guiding team members to build better solutions. * Own code quality: set the bar on coding standards and quality assurance and hold the team to it with care. * Partner closely with other teams, stakeholders, and clients to make sure what gets built solves the right problem. * Keep the team sharp \- run and participate in training, share what you're learning, and stay current on industry trends. * Dig into hard technical problems and bring the team creative, workable solutions. * Manage team resources and workload so people are set up to do their best work. * Take part in hiring \- help us find the next people who'll make this team better. * Lead the team in utilizing AI solutions for efficient and effective coding practices. * Set clear short\- and long\-term goals for the team, and make sure everyone understands not just what we're building, but why. * Give real feedback through performance reviews and invest in your team's growth \- their development is part of your job. **Compensation**The anticipated salary range for this position is listed above. Actual base salary will be determined based on relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic location, and other job\-related factors. This range represents SBS CyberSecurity's good\-faith estimate of the compensation reasonably expected for this position at the time of posting.**What You Bring**These are the things we need to see \- the foundation this role is built on: * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field \- or equivalent experience that got you to the same place. * 5\+ years in software development, including at least 2 years leading or mentoring others. * Strong problem\-solving, organizational, and analytical instincts. * Effective communication and interpersonal skills. * A solid understanding of software development methodologies and the project lifecycle. * Strong experience with .NET Core and its frameworks, front\-end tech like Razor, Vue.js, or React, and tools like Azure DevOps, Jira, or GitHub. * Familiarity with QA, unit, integration, and UI testing strategies. **What Would Excite Us**Nobody checks every box \- and we don't expect you to. If you bring experience or curiosity in any of the following, we want to hear about it: * A track record of leading teams and a working knowledge of back\-end, front\-end, and database development. * An eye for application security \- comfort with code analysis tools and actually fixing what they find. * Experience with ETL processes, data lakes, or data warehousing. * Familiarity with authentication protocols (OAuth2, SAML) or directory services (LDAP). * Curiosity about where AI is heading in software development, and ideas about how it fits into our work. **The Details*** This is a full\-time, fully remote position with occasional travel. * Standard hours are Monday–Friday, 8:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m. CT, with flexibility built in \- occasional evenings or weekends may come up as the work demands. * This role carries supervisory responsibility. * Physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully pefrom the essential functions of this job. This position would be specifically related to Brownfields consulting, with experience in other areas such as community development and environmental due diligence. As a Senior Project Manager or Project Director, you will also be responsible for identifying new business opportunities from current and new clients, as well as managing projects, developing proposals, leading teams, developing strategic approaches to deliver business value, and performing tasks related to growing our presence in the Midwest, and other related markets. You will maintain client relationships and ensure that projects are completed and delivered with the purpose of meeting Clients' business objectives. The position will be fully remote while based out of our Central ES office in Kansas City. You will report to the SCS Central Environmental Services Leader. How you can make an impact: The ideal professional will provide leadership and support, project financial responsibility, help grow the ES Practice, and serve as a Seller\-Doer that will contribute to our growth by:* Acting as a lead in our Brownfields practice area, work to grow/ expand this practice area, with a background in services such as community development, due diligence, site investigation and characterization, remediation, grant management, and redevelopment. * Lead or have an active role in client prospecting, and developing and executing Client plans, business development/marketing plans, and key opportunity plans. * Manage existing/future relationships with Clients and establish and maintain relationships with third parties/vendors. * Managing and being financially and technically responsible for projects. * Project Management, including, but not limited to developing proposals, contracting, leading project teams, forecasting, invoicing, and accounts receivable management. * Writing and reviewing technical reports and related work products. * Delivering professional services on time and without error in accordance with local and state regulations and within the planned level of project profitability. * Evaluate and estimate future business and strategic plans to forecast assigned staff workloads and utilization. * Communicating with clients, third party, and regulatory agents regarding project status, schedules, and compliance issues. * Oversee, manage, mentor, and develop lower to mid\-level staff to grow their knowledge and establish a career path. * Assist other Project Managers or staff when additional support or technical expertise is needed. jobs.description: Overview: Sprout (www.Sproutup.com) is a rapidly growing IT Asset Disposition (ITAD) provider and electronics recycler. jobs.description: **Requisition ID:** 278761 **Salary Range:** \- *Please note that the Salary Range shown is a guideline only. Salary offered may vary based on factors, including, but not limited to, the successful candidate’s relevant knowledge, skills, and experience.* Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high\-performing culture. **Purpose:** We are seeking a Senior AI Engineer to design, build, and operate AI and agentic solutions supporting Canadian Banking, International Banking, Global Banking and Markets (GBM), Global Wealth Management (GWM), Fraud, and Anti\-Money Laundering (AML). This is a hands\-on engineering role spanning AI applications, data pipelines, software services, and MLOps. You will work with business stakeholders, product owners, data scientists, and platform teams to translate business workflows into secure, reliable production solutions using Databricks, MLflow, Kubernetes, and the Azure\-native stack. You will own the design and delivery of assigned components and workflows, contribute to technical decisions with Principal Engineers and architects, and support solutions throughout their production lifecycle. The role requires sound judgment in choosing between deterministic automation, machine learning, generative AI, and agentic approaches. **What You'll Do** Business Discovery and Solution Design * Participate in discovery sessions with business stakeholders to understand workflows, data sources, pain points, and opportunities for AI\-enabled improvement. * Translate requirements into technical designs, implementation tasks, estimates, and testable acceptance criteria in partnership with product owners and technical leads. * Assess data readiness, integration dependencies, and technical feasibility; build focused prototypes to validate assumptions before production implementation. * Identify appropriate boundaries for agent autonomy, human review, approvals, and deterministic business rules. AI and Agentic Application Engineering * Build LLM\-powered applications and agentic workflows using tool calling, enterprise APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation, structured outputs, and state management. * Implement document ingestion, parsing, chunking, embeddings, indexing, retrieval, and reranking to provide relevant, permission\-aware context. * Integrate predictive models and business rules with AI workflows in collaboration with data scientists and domain experts. * Implement validation, timeouts, retries, idempotency, and fallback paths to make workflows dependable and prevent unintended repeated actions. * Compare model and orchestration options against task quality, latency, cost, and operational requirements. Data and Software Engineering * Develop and maintain batch and streaming data pipelines using Azure Databricks, Apache Spark, Delta Lake, Python, and SQL. * Implement data quality checks, schema validation, lineage, and access controls using enterprise standards and Unity Catalog where applicable. * Build tested APIs and services that connect AI applications to enterprise data, business systems, and approved tools. * Write maintainable code with clear interfaces, unit and integration tests, documentation, and peer review; troubleshoot complex issues across application and data layers. Evaluation MLOps and Production Delivery * Use MLflow and supporting tools to track experiments, register models, version prompts and configurations, and retain evaluation results and deployment evidence. * Build representative evaluation datasets and automated checks for model performance, retrieval relevance, grounded responses, tool execution, and end\-to\-end task completion. * Implement CI/CD pipelines, automated regression testing, environment configuration, and controlled releases with rollback support. * Containerize services with Docker and deploy to Kubernetes, including Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), using approved infrastructure\-as\-code patterns. * Instrument applications for tracing, logs, and metrics; monitor AI quality, data and model drift where applicable, latency, availability, and consumption costs. * Investigate production incidents, perform root\-cause analysis, maintain runbooks, and contribute to operational support under the team’s agreed support model. Security and responsible AI * Implement least\-privilege access, secure secrets management, data protection, and audit logging using enterprise security and Azure identity standards. * Apply safeguards for prompt injection, sensitive data disclosure, unsafe tool execution, and unauthorized agent actions. * Implement human approval and escalation steps for sensitive decisions or actions, preserving traceability of inputs, outputs, and tool activity. * Work with cybersecurity, model risk, compliance, and data governance partners to address required controls and remediation items. Collaboration and Engineering Contribution * Work with Principal Engineers and architects to align component designs  iment tracking, model registration, versioning, deployment, and monitoring. * Practical experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud application security, identity, networking, and observability. * Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and infrastructure as code, with the ability to deploy and troubleshoot services. * Ability to independently deliver well\-defined engineering work, investigate ambiguous problems, and collaborate across business and technical teams. * Understanding of AI evaluation, data privacy, secure tool use, human oversight, and the limitations of probabilistic model outputs. Preferred Qualifications * Experience in financial services, particularly banking, capital markets, wealth management, fraud detection, or AML. * Experience implementing retrieval and vector search, document processing, semantic models, or knowledge graph integrations. * Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), event\-driven architectures, and agent orchestration frameworks. * Experience working in regulated environments with model risk, audit, and data governance requirements. * Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
