jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About Seamless** Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered revenue generation. Sales professionals use our platform to identify prospective buyers, improve contact and company data, and create pipeline more efficiently. By combining proprietary data, artificial intelligence, and modern go\-to\-market technology, Seamless helps organizations connect with the right people and accelerate revenue growth. We are continuing to invest in our platform, our AI capabilities, and the team required to define the next generation of sales technology. **Equal Employment Opportunity** Seamless is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Visa sponsorship is not included in our hiring package. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. **Why Seamless** ---------------- Seamless is building the future of AI\-powered sales and revenue technology. Our platform brings together real\-time B2B data, artificial intelligence, sales engagement, enrichment, automation, buyer signals, AI agents, APIs, integrations, and workflow capabilities to help revenue teams find the right buyers, improve contact and company data, personalize outreach, create pipeline, and convert more opportunities into revenue. As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer at Seamless, you will have the opportunity to: * Own meaningful features from concept through production, with a direct impact on the experience of our users. * Build scalable, high\-performing applications and services that support our data search engine and social profiling platform. * Work across our web application, Chrome extension, and connected services rather than being limited to one part of the stack. * Shape technical solutions with autonomy, collaborating closely with product managers and a lean remote engineering team. * Ship quality code iteratively, solve customer problems, and help evolve a platform that handles large volumes of data and concurrent requests. At Seamless, you’ll work with a team that values simple solutions, thoughtful engineering, strong ownership, and the ability to deliver meaningful results. **The Opportunity** You’ll join Seamless’s Technology organization as part of a lean, full stack engineering team. Your work will help advance our data search engine and social profiling platform, supporting the tools customers use to find and connect with the right buyers. You’ll take ownership of features from early requirements through deployment and post\-launch improvement. Our architecture includes a customer\-facing web application, a Chrome extension, and connected services, giving you the opportunity to contribute across the product and its underlying systems. You’ll build responsive interfaces with React and modern JavaScript while designing scalable backend services that handle large datasets and concurrent requests. You’ll collaborate with product and engineering partners, make sound technical decisions, and ship practical solutions without unnecessary complexity. **What You’ll Own** * Own full stack projects and deliverables from concept through production. * Build scalable, performant user interfaces using React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, CSS, and related modern tools. * Design, develop, and implement microservices that handle large volumes of concurrent requests and data. * Create JSON schemas and user experience workflows that support business processes involving hundreds of millions of records. * Translate customer requirements into practical technical solutions that address user needs. * Ship high\-quality, finished code frequently through iterative development and MVP delivery. * Develop complete features with substantial autonomy while communicating clearly with remote teammates. * Drive end\-to\-end development from initial brief through post\-launch analysis in partnership with product managers and technical stakeholders. * Support and improve experiences across web applications, browser extensions, and mobile platforms. **What You’ll Bring** Required Qualifications: * Ideally 5\+ years of experience building high\-quality, cloud\-based web applications. * 5\+ years of expertise in modern frontend technologies, including React, ES6/7 JavaScript, Webpack, HTML, and CSS. * 2\+ years of experience with backend technologies including Node.js, Express, Postgres, and AWS. * Experience working with large datasets using S3, Athena, OpenSearch, or similar services. * Strong SQL skills and an analytical approach to problem\-solving. * Experience working with internal APIs and integrating third\-party APIs. * Experience with React Hooks and other modern React features. * Ability to create clear documentation for new and existing features and functionality. * Experience developing software using AI\-assisted tools such as Claude and Cursor. Preferred Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree. * UI/UX design specialization. * Experience developing Chrome extensions. * Experience with web scraping. **Benefits** At Seamless, we invest in our employees by offering a comprehensive benefits package designed to support health, financial well\-being, work\-life balance, and professional growth. Eligible employees have access to benefits that currently include: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Account options * 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions * Company\-paid life insurance, accidental death and dismemberment, and short\-term disability coverage * Voluntary supplemental insurance options * Employee Assistance Program * Annual wellness reimbursement * Paid time off, company holidays, and paid parental leave for birthing and non\-birthing parents * Remote\-first work environment * Employee discount and perks program * Professional development, ongoing learning, coaching, and career\-growth opportunities Benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and applicable plan documents and may be modified by Seamless at any time.

rock mechanics; rock and soil slope stability; shallow and deep foundations; tunneling; microtunneling; seismic design; earthquake engineering; and retaining structures. * Some knowledge or experience of field/construction observation in one or more of the following areas: logging geotechnical explorations, observation of pile driving operations, observations of earthwork activities, installation and recording of geotechnical instrumentation, field reconnaissance, and/or underground work. * Excellent writing, organizational, and communication skills. * Personable, flexible, and professional demeanor. * The ability to work independently with the appropriate level of OR minimal supervision. * The willingness and ability to travel to support the needs of other Shannon \& Wilson offices. * A valid driver license and insurable driving record. * Basic computer skills: MS Word, Excel (required); This is a great opportunity to start a career with a company that builds things that matter and values its team. We are proud to share our culture of diversity and inclusion. Our work makes a clear contribution to society and the environment around us. We build in many different verticals. Whether we are building schools to provide inspiring spaces for learning, roads to connect communities or hospitals to care for patients, it all contributes to our purpose – we build for a better society. Skanska's values —Be Better Together, Act Ethically and Transparently, Commit to Customer and Care for Life—are deeply engrained in how we work, which is why our values support and drive our D\&I efforts. The Field Service Engineer will provide technical support to assist group computer system users. Answer questions or resolve computer problems for clients in person, via telephone or from remote location. May provide assistance concerning the use of computer hardware and software, including printing, installation, office productivity, electronic mail, and operating systems. They will be responsible for assigned jobsite mobilization and demobilization as assigned by the Regional Manager in their region. All of these responsibilities will need to be performed in a highly professional manner. **Field Service Engineer Required Qualifications:** * 2\+ years technical support experience troubleshooting, diagnosing, and repairing PCs, Printers and Peripherals * Experience troubleshooting Microsoft Windows 11 and Microsoft O365 Products. * Proven ability to understand technology processes and tools and utilize them to improve on all our technology efforts * Proven ability to manage several tasks simultaneously. Valid driver's license and access to a personal vehicle for frequent business travel within assigned geographic market. Selected candidate is responsible for all vehicle registration, insurance, and maintenance requirements; the Company will provide mileage reimbursement. **Currently, the company is not considering applicants for this position who now or in the future require employment sponsorship by the company.** **Our** **Investment** **in you:** * + - We believe that Benefits should connect you to the support you need when it matters most, and should help you care for those who matter most. That’s why we provide an array of options (including medical, dental, and vision insurance plans), expert guidance, and always\-on tools, that are personalized to meet the needs of your reality – to help support you physically, financially, and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. Please visit the compensation and Benefits summary on our careers site for more details. - As a Skanska community, our values ground us, and our diversity of experience propels us forward. No matter what your career stage, there’s a place for you to thrive here and partner with us in shaping how our world lives, moves, and connects. - At Skanska, we Care for Life. And we’re committed to supporting your whole health and peace of mind through inclusive and personalized total rewards. - We’re committed to your success by developing you in your role and supporting your career growth - Compensation and financial well\-being – Competitive base salary, excellent bonus program, 401k, \& Employee ownership program. **Come work with us and join a winning team!** Apply Today for Immediate Consideration!: **Background Check Required** Skanska is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, citizenship, protected veteran status, or any other categories protected under applicable federal, state, and local laws. Skanska Equal Employment Opportunity Skanska uses knowledge \& foresight to shape the way people live, work, and connect. More than 135 years in the making, we’re one of the world’s largest construction and project development companies. With operations in select markets throughout the Nordics, Europe, and the United States, global revenue totaled $15\.9 billion in 2024\. Skanska in the U.S. operates 28 offices across the country, with its headquarters in New York City. In 2024, the U.S. construction sector generated $8\.2 billion in revenue, and the U.S. development sector’s net investments in commercial projects totaled $224 million. Together with our customers and the collective expertise of our 6,300 teammates in the U.S. and 26,300 globally, we create innovative and sustainable solutions that support healthy living beyond our lifetime. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Observability
jobs.description: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. **Senior Product Manager: Extensible Compute** ============================================== **Location:** MPK or Bellevue \| **Workplace:** Hybrid At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don't just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset, rapidly testing emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential, and people too. With a culture that's all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology and careers to the next level. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager for our Extensible Compute team, which builds Snowpark Container Services (SPCS). SPCS is the compute platform that runs customer container workloads and Snowflake's own first\-party products, including Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, and AI agents. You will own the product for that platform: which compute we offer, how reliably and cheaply it runs, and how partner teams and customers get what they need without a one\-off every time. **AS A SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:** * Own the SPCS product roadmap and ship it. That includes the compute instance portfolio across AWS, Azure, and GCP (general\-purpose CPU, ARM, and GPU, including new Nvidia generations), and the storage and file system capabilities workloads depend on. * Turn requests from first\-party product partners into platform capabilities. When Openflow, Notebooks, Streamlit, or an agent team needs a new instance, a networking change, or multi\-cluster support, you decide what becomes a standard SPCS feature and what stays a one\-off. * Take features from early preview to general availability. You set the launch bar, hold a release when security, reliability, or unit economics are not ready, and work the path through PrPr and PuPr with engineering. Work credibly with senior engineers on architecture, performance, reliability, and cost. * Own platform health that customers feel: startup time, isolation, storage reliability, and the unit economics of running a workload on SPCS. You partner with Finance on pricing ($/GiB, instance pricing) when the model has to change. * Be the product point of contact for our infrastructure partners (AWS, Azure, GCP, Nvidia) on the SPCS compute roadmap, and for account teams qualifying strategic customers onto SPCS. * Use AI as part of how you work: customer and partner synthesis, specs, launch reviews, and the analysis behind a prioritization call. **OUR IDEAL SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER WILL HAVE:** * 5\+ years of product management experience, including several years on a platform, infrastructure, or developer\-facing product, or equivalent experience owning a technical product end to end. * Hands\-on depth in at least one of: cloud infrastructure, container or serverless platforms, developer runtimes, or distributed systems. You can hold a design review with senior engineers and leave with a decision. * A track record of taking a platform capability from 0 to 1 or from early adoption to scale, across engineering and at least one partner team (product, GTM, or a cloud/hardware partner). * Evidence you can say no. You have turned a pile of bespoke asks into a smaller set of reusable capabilities, and you can show what you cut and why. * Clear writing and crisp communication with engineering leads, partner PMs, finance, and account teams. You do not need a slide to make the point. * A Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience. **BONUS POINTS** * Direct experience with a container platform, Kubernetes\-based service, or serverless compute product that customers run production workloads on. * Experience qualifying or launching GPU or accelerated compute instances, or working a hardware/CSP roadmap (Nvidia, AWS, Azure, GCP). * Experience supporting data, AI, or developer workloads on a shared platform (orchestration, notebooks, apps, agents). * Familiarity with unit economics for compute or storage: instance pricing, $/GiB, or cost\-to\-serve for a multi\-tenant platform. **WHY JOIN OUR EXTENSIBLE COMPUTE TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?** SPCS is the compute layer under a large and growing set of Snowflake workloads. A good call on an instance type, a filesystem, or a launch gate shows up in more than one product. You will work directly with the engineers who build it, the product partners who depend on it, and the customers bringing container workloads onto Snowflake. Customers want to run their own services, pipelines, and models inside Snowflake's governance boundary, and Snowflake's own products need the same platform to get faster, cheaper, and more capable. You will have a concrete surface to own, a roadmap you can ship against, and visibility into how this platform is used across the company. Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake. How do you want to make your impact? For jobs located in the United States, please visit the job posting on the Snowflake Careers Site for salary and benefits information: careers.snowflake.com The following represents the expected range of compensation for this role: * The estimated base salary range for this role is $200,000 \- $287,500\. * Additionally, this role is eligible to participate in Snowflake’s bonus and equity plan. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non\-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location. This role is also eligible for a competitive benefits package that includes: medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; 401(k) retirement plan; flexible spending \& health savings account; at least 12 paid holidays; paid time off; parental leave; employee assistance program; and other company benefits. To comply with pay transparency requirements and other statutes, you can notify us if you believe that a job posting is not compliant by completing this form.

jobs.description: About the Company SoftPro is a software technology company known for developing solutions that support business operations and workflow management. Its software products focus on helping organizations improve productivity, streamline processes, and manage digital information efficiently. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Visa sponsorship Work Location: In person

Potential benefits may include health insurance, retirement savings options, paid time off, and professional development opportunities, subject to employer confirmation and eligibility. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer AI (Contractor)
jobs.description: **Why Sony Interactive Entertainment?** Sony Interactive Entertainment isn't just the Best Place to Play — it's also the Best Place to Work. Sony Interactive Entertainment (SIE) is the company behind the PlayStation brand. As a subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation, we're part of a proud legacy of innovation and excellence. SIE is a dynamic technology company, delivering cutting\-edge hardware and network services to more than 100 million people and an entertainment leader, home to some of the most beloved and recognizable intellectual properties (IP) in the world. Our role at SIE is to create and nurture the experiences under the PlayStation brand, a name synonymous with entertainment excellence and creativity. *Agentic \& AI Engineering* * + Design, build, and operate production\-quality agentic applications using agentic SDKs/harnesses — including multi\-agent orchestration, subagent delegation, tool integration, and lifecycle hooks. + Design Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool and resource interfaces that give coding agents/harnesses safe, reliable access to backend systems and enterprise data. + Engineer prompts for reliable structured output (JSON schemas, few\-shot examples, validation/retry loops) and build evaluation frameworks to measure and improve output quality. + Manage context effectively across long documents, multi\-turn conversations, and multi\-agent handoffs; design escalation and human\-in\-the\-loop patterns for production reliability. *Developer Productivity* * + Configure and extend Codex/Claude Code for team\-wide use: AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md hierarchies, custom slash commands, Agent Skills, path\-specific rules, and plan mode. + Integrate agentic development into CI/CD pipelines for automated code review, test generation, and PR feedback, tuned to minimize false positives and duplicate findings. + Build and maintain MCP server integrations (project\- and user\-scoped) that extend agent\-native development capabilities across engineering workflows. + Identify high\-value opportunities for AI\-assisted development and design reusable capabilities that multiple teams can adopt, not just one\-off solutions. *Discovery, Prototyping \& Production Delivery* * + Partner directly with engineering teams to understand workflows, pain points, and opportunities through hands\-on discovery. + Rapidly prototype and validate new AI capabilities with real users, then take successful prototypes into secure, observable, maintainable production systems. + Own the full lifecycle: implementation, testing, deployment, monitoring, and iteration. *Technical Leadership* * + Provide hands\-on technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, and troubleshooting of agentic systems. + Mentor engineers on agentic design patterns, prompt engineering, and agent\-native development practices. + Communicate tradeoffs, risks, and results clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders. + Contribute to engineering standards, reusable patterns, and documentation that help other teams build effectively with agentic development tools. Requirements * + 6\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant hands\-on work building and operating AI/LLM\-powered or agentic applications. + Strong programming skills (Java, Python, Go, Rust, or C\+\+) and solid engineering fundamentals — API design, testing, debugging, code review, maintainable code. + Practical, production\-grade experience with agentic SDKs/harnesses, MCP, and LLMs — tool use, orchestration, RAG, context management, structured output, and evaluation. + Experience designing MCP tool/resource interfaces and reasoning about tool selection, error handling, and reliability in multi\-agent systems. + Demonstrated experience integrating AI into CI/CD and developer workflows. + Ability to work in ambiguous problem spaces, evaluate tradeoffs, and make pragmatic engineering decisions. + Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience mentoring and leading through influence. + Build and maintain an engineering knowledge base for agentic workflows, including content ingestion, organization, updates, and retrieval. Connect it to agents through RAG and MCP so they can use trusted, current information with source citations. Preferred Qualifications * + Demonstrated expertise across agentic architecture, MCP integration, Codex/Claude Code configuration, prompt engineering, and context management. + Experience building multi\-agent research or customer support systems, or structured data extraction pipelines. + Experience with AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and GitOps in support of AI/agentic infrastructure. + Familiarity with vector databases, embeddings, and AI evaluation frameworks. + Contributions to open\-source projects involving AI, agentic systems, or developer tooling. + Strong systems thinking — understands how models, agents, tools, context, APIs, data, and infrastructure fit together as production systems, and can reason about dependencies and tradeoffs across the stack. + A track record of adapting quickly to new AI tools, models, and frameworks as the space evolves. Please note, Sony Interactive Entertainment conducts background checks at the offer stage for all new employees (which may include criminal background checks for some roles) and will need to process personal information to support these checks. Please refer to our Candidate Privacy Notice (where applicable) for more information about what personal information we collect, how we use it, who we share it with, and your data protection rights. **Equal Opportunity Statement:** *Sony is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All persons will receive consideration for employment without regard to gender (including gender identity, gender expression and gender reassignment), race (including colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin), religion or belief, marital or civil partnership status, disability, age, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, trade union membership or membership in any other legally protected category.* *We strive to create an inclusive environment, empower employees and embrace diversity. We encourage everyone to respond.* *Sony Interactive Entertainment is a Fair Chance employer and qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records will be considered for employment.*

jobs.title: Lead Engineer, AI Infrastructure (C++, C)
jobs.description: SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next. #### **LEAD ENGINEER, AI INFRASTRUCTURE (C\+\+, C)** The Grok training program is looking for a lead software engineer on the AI infrastructure team. You will lead the team that architects, implements, and maintains the software infrastructure responsible for training grok models on hundreds of thousands or millions of GPUs. The success of Grok depends on the quality of the software that you and your team produce, including reliability, fault tolerance, throughput, security, and developer experience. You are the engineer that other engineers count on; you are technical, you tackle every problem with enthusiasm; you remove hurdles. You are a self\-starter and a team player. We are seeking a talented lead software engineer to join us in making our vision a reality. #### **RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Develop reliable, performant, and maintainable software responsible for training Grok models in our world\-class compute clusters * Provide technical direction for future training architectures and hardware designs * Work closely with other model engineers, kernel engineers, network engineers, hardware design engineers, platform engineers, and site ops engineers * Develop prototypes to prove out key design concepts and quantify technical constraints * Lead planning efforts for the team, working with key stakeholders in other teams and management to develop milestones and execute to them #### **BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:** * Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or technical discipline * Hands\-on systems programming experience in C or C\+\+ #### **PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:** * Developed, debugged, and and deployed software that has been used in real world applications/projects * 3\+ years of software engineering experience OR 1\+ years of C/C\+\+ experience at SpaceX * Solid fundamental knowledge of NVL72 GB300 racks, computer architecture, networking, math, and physics * Strong skills in modelling, debugging, performance optimization, and unit testing * Creative approach to problem solving, exceptional analytical skills and engineering fundamentals #### **COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:** $220,000 \- $357,000 USD Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short \& long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks. *SpaceXSI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our* *Recruitment Privacy Notice**.*

jobs.title: AI Implementation Engineer & Project Coordinator
jobs.description: **Allocation:** 50% project coordination and client delivery; 50% on\-premises Document AI solution implementation **Reporting:** Project/Account Lead for client delivery; AI Architect/Technical Lead for solution implementation **Location:** Albuquerque, NM , with periodic client site visits (10% Travel) **Role purpose** This role has two parts. The first is coordinating client document\-processing projects: workload scheduling, client communication, production reporting and delivery reconciliation. The second is turning business and document\-processing requirements into clear specifications, then validating the on\-premises Document AI solution and supporting its integration, deployment and operational readiness. The role works closely with the AI Architect, who owns technology selection and architecture, and with the offshore development team, which owns Python application development. **Project coordination and client delivery (50%)** 1\. Planning and workload management * Work with client managers to schedule work based on delivery priorities, available capacity and agreed deadlines. * Keep a delivery tracker covering intake, owners, due dates, dependencies, risks and open issues. * Coordinate internal resources and production teams so delivery commitments are met. * Find schedule risks early and propose ways to reduce them. 2\. Client communication and governance * Report project status, delivery progress, delays and any decisions the client needs to make. * Prepare and send weekly production and delivery reports. * Hold status meetings and keep meeting notes, action items and decision logs. * Visit client sites periodically to review each department’s scope, document types, extraction requirements, naming conventions, folder structures and acceptance criteria. 3\. Delivery reconciliation and quality * Reconcile opening backlog and new intake against work that is completed, delivered, rejected, on hold or outstanding. * Check delivery counts and identifiers, look into missing, duplicate or inconsistent records, and report any discrepancies. * Keep audit\-ready records of what was delivered, when it was accepted and how issues were resolved. 4\. Scope and change management * Keep a register of requirements and change requests. * Get written agreement from the designated owners before scope or delivery changes take effect. * Turn approved client requirements into implementation tasks with testable acceptance criteria. **Document AI solution implementation (50%)** 1\. Requirements and functional specifications * Gather and document requirements for document intake, classification, extraction, validation, reconciliation, search and reporting. * Define document types, metadata fields, extraction rules, naming conventions, folder structures and expected outputs. * Prepare source\-to\-target mappings, sample input and output datasets, workflow descriptions and acceptance criteria. * Turn approved requirements into development tasks, answer the development team’s questions, and keep requirements traceable to what gets built. 2\. SQL, data validation and reconciliation * Write SQL queries and approved database routines for validation, reconciliation, exception analysis and reporting. * Define validation rules for completeness, format, lookups, duplicates and consistency across documents. * Check processing results against source documents and expected outputs. * Prepare exception reports with supporting evidence and track each issue until it is resolved. 3\. Integration testing and solution quality * Test the document\-processing workflows, APIs, database outputs and integrations the development team delivers. * Build representative test datasets that cover document variations, poor OCR quality, missing information, duplicates and conflicting values. * Score extraction and retrieval results against agreed reference answers, and confirm that outputs keep source\-document and page references. * Test retries, reprocessing, interrupted jobs and human\-review workflows. * Log defects so they can be reproduced, coordinate the fixes, and confirm the corrected behavior. 4\. On\-premises deployment and operational support * Support environment setup and deployment, following the architecture and procedures the AI Architect has approved. * Coordinate installation prerequisites, configuration, database connectivity, internal endpoints and access requirements. * Run deployment checklists, check service health and confirm processing works end to end, including offline operation where required. * Monitor processing, review logs, investigate failures and escalate issues as needed. * Maintain configuration records, operating procedures, troubleshooting guides and release checklists. 5\. Development coordination and user acceptance * Manage the implementation backlog, priorities and dependencies with the offshore development team, and report progress against milestones. * Run solution demonstrations and user acceptance testing (UAT). * Record user feedback and separate defects from new requirements. * Prepare release\-readiness evidence for sign\-off, and provide user training and operational handover. Qualifications (suggested) * Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering or a related field. * 4\+ years of combined experience in project coordination and technical implementation, preferably in document management, ECM or data processing. * Strong SQL skills and experience with data validation and reconciliation. * Familiarity with OCR, document classification, data extraction and AI/ML\-based document processing. * Experience working with offshore development teams and running UAT. * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience in client\-facing roles. * PMP, CAPM or Agile certification is a plus. Pay: $20\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 30\.0 – 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

propose the next iteration from the data * Work with outside partners and agencies so web and app experiences stay consistent * Write clear tickets, PRs and design notes; review teammates' work the same day ### **Requirements:** * Daily, hands\-on use of agentic coding tools: you can run agents in loops, write the evals that keep them honest, coordinate multi\-agent workflows, and know when to take the keyboard back * 5\+ years of professional web development, owning both frontend and backend in production * Strong Python, plus JavaScript or TypeScript, React, and modern CSS and HTML * Hands\-on with Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Redis * CI/CD and monitoring tooling, and AWS or a comparable cloud platform; jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer
jobs.description: Overview: At TDS Telecom, connecting people is at the heart of everything we do. We are forward thinkers who leverage cutting\-edge fiber internet technology to strengthen communities. We are dedicated to excellence, which drives us to succeed together, creating a better world through meaningful connections. Ready to make an impact? The **Lead Software Engineer** works independently or leads teams of 5 or more people responsible for application design, development, testing, and problem resolution work teams with significant autonomy and independence. The scope of work typically includes major system projects that support company\-wide business operations. As an experienced developer and an experienced technical leader, the position receives periodic mentoring, feedback, and supervision by management. Applications may include custom developed software, commercial packaged software, or open\-source software. Software may consist of on\-premise applications, cloud\-based software and services, hybrid configurations, integration tools, or business workflow tools. The Lead Software Engineer leads the team's use of AI coding tools. They will set the standard for reviewing and accepting AI\-generated code, define where the tools should not be used, and share reusable prompts and automation. *This position has the ability to work remotely in any of the 40\+ States in which TDS Telecom operates. Final candidates may be invited onsite for final interviews in Madison, WI.* Responsibilities: * Leads teams of 5 or more people that develop, test, and fix defects in application software. * Leads the preparation and review of application software designs at the system level. The scope of design will frequently include multiple systems supporting company\-wide business processes. * Leads cross\-functional work teams in preparing work estimates and project schedules for all technical work on projects. Mentors team members in the development of work plans. * Leads work teams in resolving complex problems which are frequently unique, require creative problem solving and advanced technical skills, and frequently span multiple systems and may cross team boundaries. * Maintains authoritative knowledge of all systems within the scope of the team's responsibility. Provides a consultative role to business process owners in the use and modification of system software. Maintains expert\-level knowledge of software development best practices, tools, and methodologies that are recognized within the company. * Leads teams focused on quality and continuous improvement initiatives across business units within the company. * Maintains expert knowledge of the technologies and practices of the company's chosen markets. Maintains awareness of trends in technologies and vendor product offerings. * Actively participates in preparing and conducting technical interviews of job candidates on behalf of the group manager. Qualifications: **Required Qualifications*** Bachelors degree (or higher) \-OR\- 4\+ years professional work experience. * 5\+ years experience in software development or testing. **Other Qualifications*** Knowledge of AI\-assisted software engineering * Knowledge of software development methodologies, practices, and tools. * Knowledge of project management methodologies, practices, and tools. * Knowledge of one more programming language used by the team. * Knowledge of software testing practices and tools. * Knowledge of problem\-solving techniques and tools. * Ability to travel as needed for company business and professional development. * Ability to work nights and weekends as needed for system implementations and resolving system problems. * Knowledge of business analysis practices and business process modeling. * Knowledge of quality management and quality improvement practices. * Knowledge of team leadership skills, practices, and behaviors. * Knowledge of techniques, tools, and applicable laws to conduct effective and legal interviews. * Knowledge of techniques for writing and presenting business proposals to management. * Knowledge of effective writing and public speaking skills. Ability to convey complex information to general audiences. * Knowledge of C\# / .NET or a comparable primary stack. * Knowledge of relational databases (Oracle or SQL Server) \- data modeling and query performance. * Knowledge of event\-driven or streaming integration (e.g. Kafka), including ordering, duplicate delivery, and replay. Do you meet the Required Qualifications but are unsure if your experience aligns with the Other Qualifications? We encourage you to apply! Research shows that many candidates hesitate to apply unless they meet 100% of the qualifications, even when they possess the skills and experience needed to succeed in the role. Experience and skills come in many forms, and they may not always match exactly what’s listed on paper, but they can still lead to success. If you meet the Required Qualifications and believe you have the potential to thrive in this role, we encourage you to apply today! **Benefits** Associates scheduled to work 20 or more hours per week have access to medical, dental, vision, life insurance, a 401(k) plan, education assistance, and paid time off benefits such as vacation (15 days accrued per year for full\-time; pro\-rated for associates working between 20\-39 hours), sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full\-time and pro\-rated for all other associates), seven paid national holidays and one floating holiday, paid parental leave (6 weeks after 12 months of employment), among others. Short Term Disability and Long Term Disability coverage is also available for associates working 30 or more hours per week. Associates scheduled to work under twenty hours per week or for a limited term (i.e. interns) are eligible for medical coverage, the 401(k) plan (if 18 or older), as well as sick leave (10 days accrued per year for full\-time and pro\-rated for all other associates). Click here for more specific information regarding our comprehensive well\-being program. **Who is TDS Telecom?** TDS Telecom provides high\-speed internet, TV entertainment, and phone services to a diverse range of communities, including small to mid\-sized urban, suburban, and rural areas across the U.S. With over 50 years of experience, TDS is committed to building and expanding fiber optic networks that bring cutting\-edge connectivity to neighborhoods nationwide. Serving over 1 million connections, our mission is to create a better world by delivering innovative communication solutions that enhance the way people live, work, and connect. Visit tdstelecom.com to learn more! At TDS, we are committed to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and value the difference of backgrounds, experiences and perspectives in our workforce. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other status protected by law. **Pay Transparency** The listed pay range reflects the minimum and maximum base salary. Actual offers will be based on factors such as skills, qualifications, experience, location, and role\-specific competencies. Some positions may also offer additional compensation, such as bonuses or equity awards. Pay Range (Hr./Yr.): $81,000\.00/Yr. \- $131,600\.00/Yr.

jobs.description: About Us: TRC, Member of WSP, is a global consulting environmental and engineering firm and one of the top design firms in the energy sector. Together, TRC and WSP’s 83,000 experts create positive, long\-lasting impacts for our communities and our clients in the power and energy, transportation and infrastructure, environmental, and property and buildings sectors. As part of our team, you’ll discover a world of opportunities to connect with innovative thinkers, forge your path, and have fun tackling the world’s most challenging projects. At TRC, Member of WSP, you can have a rewarding career on every level. TRC has long set the bar for clients who require more than just engineering, combining science with the latest technology to devise innovative solutions that stand the test of time. From pipelines to power plants, roadways to reservoirs, schoolyards to security solutions, clients look to TRC for breakthrough thinking backed by the innovative follow\-through of an industry leader. We recognize that the expertise of our staff is our strongest asset, so we generously reward employees for successful performance and invest in their careers through training and the development of new skills and certifications. Overview: TRC is seeking a highly motivated temporary part\-time Civil/Structural Engineer for our growing transportation practice in Fresno, CA. The ideal candidate will be enthusiastic to work with other engineers, project managers, and other technical staff assisting with planning, designing, and overseeing civil engineering projects, such as the design of roadways, retaining walls/sound walls, culverts, and bridges, including hydraulic modeling. Responsibilities: * Assist Project Managers in the production of project plans, specifications, reports and cost estimates. * Assist Project Managers with construction management tasks such as material submittal reviews and coordination with Contractors. * Be involved in all project aspects including design/study development and site/field visits during design and construction. * Be able to run hydraulic modeling for small creeks and canals and develop bridge design hydraulic reports. * Efficiently produce quality outputs while meeting budget and schedules on multiple concurrent projects. * Establish and maintain effective working relationships with other employees, clients, and public agencies. Other Compensation: Employee may be eligible for participation in the Company’s annual Discretionary Bonus Program which is contingent on Company, Business Segment, and Individual performance against Key Performance Indicators which vary by year and employee. jobs.title: Data and AI Engineer - July 2027
jobs.description: The Brattle Group, a privately held, global economics consulting firm, is looking for a **Data and AI Engineer** to join our **San Francisco, CA** office to start in **July 2027**. The Data \& AI Engineer is an early\-career role within Brattle’s Data \& AI Engineering team, focused on hands\-on technical work across client delivery, applied R\&D, and internal capability\-building. This role is designed for candidates who are strong builders, fast learners, and clear communicators, and who want to develop technical judgment in a setting where problems are varied, ambiguous, and often time\-sensitive. This is not a narrowly defined pipeline role or a heads\-down engineering track. Data \& AI Engineers work across data engineering, applied analytics, machine learning, and AI\-enabled workflows, staying close to implementation while learning how technical choices affect real client work. Candidates are not expected to arrive as experts across data engineering, solution architecture, and applied AI research. They are expected to be hands\-on, curious, coachable, and comfortable learning quickly. **Where This Role Sits at Brattle:** The Data \& AI Engineering team is a specialized technical group embedded within Brattle’s consulting staff. The team supports client work while also serving as an applied R\&D function for the firm: researching emerging technologies, prototyping new analytical and AI\-enabled workflows, and translating useful methods into reusable capabilities. The team partners with economists, consultants, industry experts, and internal stakeholders to improve how the firm works with data, analytics, machine learning, and AI through project delivery, reusable tools, documentation, training, and knowledge\-sharing. Data \& AI Engineers work under the guidance of more experienced technical leads, including Senior Data \& AI Engineers, Solutions Architects, and Research Engineers. As experience grows, the role can develop toward deeper execution ownership, increased responsibility for solution design, more advanced AI and research work, or some combination of those paths. **Nature of the Work:** Data \& AI Engineers work on problems where the technical path is often unclear, the data is imperfect, and the constraints are real. Source materials may be incomplete, inconsistent, degraded through prior systems, or difficult to interpret. Some matters also involve restricted or confidential workflows that shape how data can be accessed, handled, or shared. The role requires practical judgment. There may be multiple valid approaches, each with trade\-offs, and limited ability to go back to the source for clarification. Data \& AI Engineers are expected to reason carefully from imperfect inputs, document assumptions, surface limitations, and help build solutions that are defensible, reproducible, timely, and fit for purpose. Project timelines may shift quickly based on external events, negotiations, litigation deadlines, or client needs. Some work is recurring and operational; some is one\-off or exploratory. Exhibit intentional communication style by prioritizing clarity, brevity, and structured formatting to ensure your key messages are easily understood and respected by peers throughout the credit union. * Provide friendly, professional and accurate service and support to all members and associates Ensure staff interactions are built upon trust, integrity, patience, and respect. **This Job Description is not a complete statement of all duties and responsibilities comprising the position.** Requirements: **Experience:** * Five years to eight years of similar or related experience. **Education:** * (1\) A two\-year college degree, or (2\) completion of a specialized certification or licensing, or (3\) completion of specialized training courses conducted by vendors, or (4\) job\-specific skills acquired through an apprenticeship program. **Interpersonal Skills:** * Work involves much personal contact with others inside and/or outside the organization for the purpose of first\-level conflict resolution, building relationships, and soliciting cooperation. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. **Work Environment:** * Maintain a professional, business\-appropriate appearance in accordance with the credit union’s dress code. * This position is eligible for remote or hybrid work. Must minimize home office distractions and comply with applicable organizational policies. * Tyndall Federal Credit Union is an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.description: About the team Ultimus is investing in AI to transform how fund administration work gets done, from generative AI assistants, intelligent document processing and machine learning to a growing set of agentic AI workflows. jobs.title: Manager, Data Engineering
jobs.description: Overview: United Community is seeking a Manager of Data Engineering to lead the team that builds and operates the pipelines and platforms every analytics product in the bank depends on. This is both a leadership and a hands\-on role: you will manage and mentor a team of data engineers and data platform engineers while staying close enough to the work to set technical direction, review builds, and unblock complex problems. Sitting within Enterprise Data, you will own our ingestion, transformation, and platform layer end to end, from source system connectivity and pipeline orchestration through modeled, historized data the analytics layer can consume without rework. You will partner with the analytics and data governance functions so that the data the bank relies on is accurate, timely, and traceable to its source. What You’ll Do: * Lead a team of data engineers and data platform engineers, providing coaching, guidance, performance management, and career development * Set technical direction for the data engineering and platform layer, staying hands\-on with development on highly visible, high\-impact solutions * Own the design, build, and operation of ingestion and transformation pipelines that deliver source data into the enterprise data platform on a reliable schedule * Advance the migration of workloads from the on\-premises environment to the cloud data platform while sustaining on\-premises operations and service levels through the transition * Own the raw and historized data layer, including Data Vault modeling standards, load patterns, and the conventions the team builds against * Own data platform administration, including environment and role structure, compute sizing, performance tuning, and consumption cost management * Establish and enforce engineering standards for version control, code review, testing, deployment, and environment promotion * Ensure production reliability through monitoring, alerting, documented recovery procedures, and clear ownership of pipeline failures * Partner with Information Security and Infrastructure on connectivity, access provisioning, and credential management for data platform components * Serve as the primary point of contact for third\-party vendors, managing those relationships and holding partners accountable to delivery and quality expectations * Ensure pipelines and components adhere to enterprise data governance and security standards, partnering with the data governance function * Maintain documentation for pipelines, data models, platform configuration, and operational runbooks * Identify and define process\-improvement and modernization opportunities across the data engineering stack * **Compliance Training**: Participate in all required compliance training, including Bank Secrecy Act/anti\-money laundering training, as well as internal and external training programs, online training, meetings, and seminars/conferences, etc. * **Other Duties:** This job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may change or be assigned at any time with or without notice. Requirements For Success: * **Education:** Bachelor's degree or above in a related field; master’s preferred * **Experience:** 7\-10 years in data engineering, data warehousing, or data platform engineering, including experience leading or mentoring others * **Required Skills:** + Hands\-on proficiency with cloud data platforms and enterprise data pipeline tooling, with depth in one or more of Snowflake, Coalesce, SQL Server, SSIS, or NiFi/Openflow and the ability to work fluently across a mixed on\-premises and cloud environment + Advanced SQL, including reading query profiles, diagnosing performance issues, and tuning queries against high\-volume tables + Working knowledge of data warehousing methodologies, including dimensional (Kimball) modeling and Data Vault + Experience designing and operating batch and incremental ingestion from relational, file, and API sources + Experience running production data operations, including scheduling, monitoring, incident response, and service level commitments + Excellent analytical and problem\-solving ability + Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate effectively at every jobs.title: Staff Embedded Software Engineer - 5G Devices & NTN Connectivity
jobs.description: About us: At Viasat, the work you do helps people stay connected in ways that matter, from everyday moments to critical missions across air, land, sea, and space. We’re a place for people who are curious, bold, and motivated by meaningful work. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact, explore new possibilities, and grow your career in ways that align with your interests and goals. When you're ready to take on something new, you'll find leaders who support your development and help you turn your ambition into action. What you'll do: At Viasat, we're building the next generation of global connectivity by seamlessly integrating terrestrial 5G networks with advanced satellite communications. Our Access Edge Terminal Software team develops the embedded software that powers innovative connectivity solutions across aviation, maritime, residential, automotive, and emerging mobility markets. We are seeking a **Staff Embedded Software Engineers \- 5G Devices \& NTN Connectivity** to architect and develop software platforms for 5G User Equipment (UE) and Customer Premises Equipment (CPE). In this role, you will combine industry\-leading 5G technologies with Viasat's satellite capabilities to create hybrid connectivity solutions that deliver reliable communications wherever customers operate. This is a highly impactful engineering position focused on device\-side software architecture, embedded Linux development, modem integration, and platform design. You will work closely with chipset vendors, hardware teams, and product stakeholders to define and deliver next\-generation connected devices. **Note:** This position focuses on device/UE software architecture and development and is distinct from RAN (gNodeB/base station) or 5G Core network roles. Candidates should have experience with device\-side, client\-side, or CPE software development rather than network infrastructure technologies. The day\-to\-day: **Software Architecture \& Platform Development*** Design and implement modular software architectures with reusable building blocks for devices operating on Viasat's satellite and NTN networks. * Develop hardware abstraction layers (HALs), middleware, and platform services that decouple application software from modem and hardware implementations. * Create scalable software frameworks that support multiple device variants, deployment models, and market\-specific requirements. * Define robust APIs and interfaces that enable independent development, testing, and lifecycle management of software components. * Balance architectural flexibility, maintainability, and performance in resource\-constrained embedded environments. **5G Modem Integration \& Embedded Development*** Integrate 5G modem solutions from industry\-leading vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, and other ecosystem partners. * Develop and maintain Linux kernel drivers supporting modem interfaces including PCIe, USB, SDIO, and UART. * Implement software responsible for modem initialization, configuration, power management, diagnostics, and runtime operation. * Customize vendor Board Support Packages (BSPs) to meet Viasat hardware and product requirements. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex hardware\-software integration challenges. * Optimize system performance for latency, throughput, power efficiency, reliability, and stability. **Reference Architectures \& Partner Enablement*** Design and maintain reference software architectures used by OEM and ODM partners. * Create SDKs that include software libraries, sample applications, documentation, and development tools. * Develop "golden reference" implementations demonstrating best practices for building 5G NTN\-enabled devices compatible with Viasat networks. * Provide technical guidance and support to external development partners. * Ensure reference platforms align with industry standards and evolving ecosystem requirements. * Balance platform standardization with flexibility to support diverse partner and market needs. **System Integration \& Validation*** Collaborate with hardware and systems engineering teams to define device architectures and software\-hardware interfaces. * Develop automated test frameworks and validation solutions for software platform verification. * Perform software profiling, performance analysis, and end\-to\-end optimization. * Support field trials, customer deployments, and production issue resolution activities. **Cross\-Functional Leadership*** Partner with chipset vendor field application engineers (FAEs) and technical specialists to resolve complex integration challenges. * Collaborate with product management to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions. * Work closely with application development teams to ensure platform capabilities support future product needs. * Mentor engineers on embedded systems, 5G device technologies, Linux development, and software engineering best practices. What you'll need: **Required Qualifications*** Ba , including RF, baseband, and application processor subsystems. * Hands\-on experience integrating 5G modem chipsets from vendors such as Qualcomm, MediaTek, Intel, or Samsung. * Knowledge of 3GPP UE protocol stacks including NAS, SDAP, RRC, PDCP, RLC, MAC, and PHY layers from a device perspective. * Familiarity with 5G NR procedures, MIMO technologies, carrier aggregation, and device performance optimization. * Familiarity with regulatory and certification requirements including FCC, CE, and carrier approvals. **Software \& Systems Expertise*** Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for embedded and system\-level programming. * Strong experience with Linux kernel development, device driver implementation, and kernel module debugging. * Solid understanding of PCIe, USB, SDIO, SPI, I2C, GPIO, and related hardware interfaces. * Experience with Android BSP development and/or embedded Linux distributions such as Yocto and Buildroot. * Proven expertise developing Linux kernel drivers. * Ability to debug kernel\-level issues using tools such as ftrace, perf, crash analysis tools, and JTAG debuggers. * Knowledge of device tree, ACPI, and platform initialization methodologies. **Leadership \& Technical Skills*** Demonstrated ability to design modular, maintainable, and scalable software architectures. * Experience building SDKs, reference platforms, or software frameworks used by external partners. * Strong technical documentation skills, including architecture specifications, API documentation, and design proposals. * Deep understanding of software design patterns, abstraction techniques, and interface design principles. * Excellent analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to diagnose complex hardware\-software interactions. * Strong communication and collaboration skills across engineering teams, chipset vendors, and external partners. * Experience working in Agile development environments. What will help you on the job: **Why You'll Love This Role*** Help pioneer the convergence of satellite and 5G communications technologies. * Build products that deliver connectivity in places where traditional terrestrial networks cannot. * Work directly with industry\-leading chipset vendors and next\-generation wireless technologies. * Influence software architecture decisions across a growing portfolio of connected devices. * See your work deployed globally across aviation, maritime, automotive, residential, and emerging mobility applications. * Join a team that values technical excellence, innovation, collaboration, and engineering ownership. Salary range: $165,000\.00 \- $260,500\.00 / annually. For specific work locations within San Jose, the San Francisco Bay area and New York City metropolitan area, the base pay range for this role is $205,000\.00\- $307,000\.00/ annually : At Viasat, we consider many factors when it comes to compensation, including the scope of the position as well as your background and experience. Base pay may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Additional cash or stock incentives may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the position offered. Learn more about Viasat’s comprehensive benefit offerings that are focused on your holistic health and wellness at https://careers.viasat.com/benefits. EEO statement: Viasat is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, seeking to create a welcoming and diverse environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, genetics, age, or veteran status or any other applicable legally protected status or characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence
jobs.description: Role Overview: Walton Enterprises is seeking a skilled, highly motivated and entrepreneurial individual to join the team as a Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence. The ideal teammate will have the demonstrated ability to transform complex enterprise data into actionable insights through advanced SQL, data modeling, and business intelligence solutions while collaborating with stakeholders to support informed decision\-making. **About the Position** The Senior Engineer, Business Intelligence builds and maintains the analytics and visualization layer used by Walton Enterprises teams to support data\-informed decisions. This position transforms raw enterprise data into governed metrics, curated data models, production dashboards, and reusable self\-service reporting tools. The role partners with business stakeholders, software engineering, and infrastructure teams to ensure analytics are accurate, secure, actionable, and aligned with business needs. **What you will do** In this role, you will develop and maintain business intelligence solutions that make enterprise data accessible, reliable, and actionable. You will partner with stakeholders to understand business needs, design reporting solutions, establish consistent data definitions, and support self\-service analytics across the organization. *Responsibilities* * Write, optimize, and maintain advanced SQL queries against the enterprise data warehouse to source, join, and validate data for analysis. * Design and maintain curated data models, views, and a governed semantic layer that makes enterprise data reusable and ready for self\-service reporting. * Build and maintain production dashboards and data visualizations, from requirements gathering through implementation and user adoption. * Establish and document shared metric definitions, data dictionaries, and reporting standards to promote consistency across teams. * Partner with stakeholders to frame business questions and translate analysis into clear recommendations and actions. * Develop data\-quality checks and monitoring within reporting solutions; investigate discrepancies and work with business and engineering partners to resolve root causes. * Use AI\-assisted tools to accelerate analysis and documentation while validating AI\-generated output before it is shared with stakeholders. * Train and support business users in self\-service reporting to increase adoption and reduce recurring ad hoc reporting requests. * Collaborate with software engineering and infrastructure teams regarding data availability, access controls, and upstream data\-pipeline requirements. * Perform other duties as needed to support the Data Strategy and Insights team. **Who we are looking for** *Skills needed* * Advanced SQL and hands\-on experience working with data warehouses * Data visualization, dashboard design, and data storytelling * Data modeling and semantic\-layer design for self\-service analytics * Business acumen and the ability to translate ambiguous business questions into structured, analyzable problems * Strong communication and collaboration skills with technical and nontechnical audiences * Data quality, documentation, and data\-stewardship discipline *Qualifications required for success* * Bachelor’s degree in analytics, statistics, computer science, information systems, business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * Five to seven years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, analytics engineering, or a related field * Demonstrated proficiency in SQL, including performance tuning of complex queries against large datasets * Experience with other programming languages, such as Python, or advanced statistical\-analysis software preferred * Hands\-on experience with Google BigQuery or a comparable cloud\-based data warehouse * Proven experience building and maintaining production dashboards using Looker, Looker Studio, Power BI, or comparable visualization tools * Demonstrated examples of data visualizations or analyses that influenced how a team operated or what a stakeholder decided * Experience defining and governing shared metrics across multiple stakeholder groups * Experience working with accounting, investment, philanthropic, or family\-office data preferred *Personal attributes that support success* * Demonstrates discretion, integrity, and expertise while serving as a trusted advisor to principals and colleagues. * Collaborates respectfully and effectively with others, contributing to a supportive, team\-oriented environment. * Approaches challenges with curiosity, bold thinking, and a commitment to continuous learning and innovation. * Maintains a strong focus on results while consistently exercising sound judgment and decision\-making. * Brings a visionary mindset, planning strategically for the future with imagination and insight. * Demonstrates a commitment to excellence and actively engages with others to accomplish shared goals. All offers of employment are contingent on your successful completion (where permitted by state law) of a confidentiality agreement and background check. In addition, you will need to provide proper identification verifying your eligibility to work in the United States on your first day of work. **Benefits Information** Benefits Information: We offer a comprehensive and generous benefits package which includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan and paid time off. **Work Environment and Physical Demands** The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those required to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Qualified individuals must be able to perform the essential functions of the position, with or without reasonable accommodation. Reasonable accommodations will be made, provided they do not pose an undue hardship to the company. Work is generally performed in a standard office or remote office environment. Duties typically require sitting for long periods; prolonged use of a computer, phone, and other standard office productivity equipment; participating in meetings, communicating by phone, video, and email; and occasional movement within the office or between meeting locations. Occasional lifting of boxes, files, or paperwork may be required. The role is not normally subject to extreme environmental conditions or unusual physical demands. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications associated with the role. Duties and responsibilities may change based on business needs. **About the Information Technology Department** The Information Technology Department provides a suite of services including hardware and software support, custom application development, cybersecurity, networking and tools for software integration. These services are provided to Walton Enterprises, the Walton Family Foundation and to Walton Family Entities. **About Walton Enterprises** Walton Enterprises supports the personal, philanthropic, and business activity for the Walton family. We are a family\-led organization, supporting multiple generations of Sam and Helen Walton’s family. We value trust, mutual respect, and a workplace where every associate belongs and can do their best work. We bring together talented people with different backgrounds and viewpoints, support their growth, and empower them to contribute meaningfully. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to a workplace that is free of discrimination and harassment of any kind. All applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, veteran status, genetic information, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.title: AI Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: We are seeking a motivated **AI Full Stack Engineer** to join our growing **AI \& Data Team**. This role offers an opportunity to work alongside experienced consultants, architects, data scientists, and AI engineers to design, develop, and deploy innovative AI solutions that help clients solve complex business challenges. As an AI Engineer, you will contribute to the delivery of **enterprise AI, Generative AI,** **Agentic AI,** and data\-driven solutions across a variety of industries. You will gain hands\-on experience with modern AI technologies, cloud platforms, automation tools, and large\-scale enterprise environments. This full\-time position is based in our **Pittsburgh office**. You must reside within commuting distance of our North Shore office. This role is expected to work flexibly based on client and business needs. This role may require periodic travel to client sites and/or attendance at a designated hub office to support project delivery, collaboration, and team engagement. **Responsibilities** * Support the **design, development, testing, and deployment** of AI and machine learning solutions. * Assist in **building Generative AI and Agentic AI applications** using modern AI frameworks and cloud services. * **Develop and maintain data pipelines**, integrations, APIs, and automation workflows. * Collaborate with Senior Leaders, solution architects, and client stakeholders to **understand business requirements** and translate them into technical solutions. * Configure, fine\-tune, and evaluate AI models to improve performance and business outcomes. * **Participate in data preparation**, model training, prompt engineering, and solution validation activities. * Contribute to technical documentation, implementation guides, and client deliverables. * **Support solution deployment,** monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance optimization. * **Stay current with emerging AI technologies**, industry trends, and best practices. * **Participate in workshops,** demonstrations, and knowledge\-sharing sessions with internal teams and clients. **Qualifications** ------------------ **Education** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field. * Masters preferred. **Required experience** * Looking forprofessionals with 1\+ years of experience in software development, data engineering, AI, or related technical fields gained through internships, or professional roles. * Understanding of **machine learning concepts** and AI fundamentals. * Experience with **Python** and common development frameworks. * **Familiarity with SQL** and working with structured and unstructured data. * Knowledge of REST APIs, Git, and software development best practices. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. * **Strong communication and interpersonal skills**, with the ability to present ideas clearly and build positive working relationships with team members and stakeholders. * Foundational **business acumen** with the ability to connect technology and data concepts to business needs and outcomes * **Ability to work effectively** in a fast\-paced, client\-focused consulting environment. * Ability to travel as required. **Preferred experience** * **Exposure to Generative AI technologies** such as Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, or similar platforms. * **Familiarity with cloud platforms** such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, or Google Cloud. * Knowledge of data visualization platforms such as **Power BI.** * Understanding of ML Ops, model deployment, and AI governance concepts. * **Relevant certifications in AI**, cloud, or data technologies are a plus. * Only candidates legally authorized to work for any employer in the U.S on a full\-time basis without the need for sponsorship will be considered. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. **Additional Information** -------------------------- **Travel Expectations** Consultants are expected to work flexibly based on client and business needs. This role may require periodic travel to client sites and/or attendance at a designated hub office to support project delivery, collaboration, and team engagement. **Working arrangement** Hybrid role working in the office 2\-3 days per week if not at a client site **Compensation and Benefits** * Placement within the salary range is based on the candidate’s experience, qualifications, demonstrated capabilities, and alignment with the requirements of the role. * Bonus eligible * 401K Savings Plan with Company Match * Medical / Dental / Vision coverage * Employee Stock Options Plan (ESOP) * 35 Paid Time Off Days (inclusive of your personal holidays) * 4 months parental leave to birthing parent / 2 months to supporting parent **Diversity and Inclusion** Wavestone is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity as a core component of our culture. Our collective success depends heavily on the recruitment and inclusion of qualified professionals, regardless of individual characteristics such as race, ancestry, religion, color, sex, age, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran’s status, or any characteristic protected by law. If you need flexibility, assistance, or an adjustment to our recruitment process due to a disability or impairment, you may reach out to us to discuss this.
