jobs.description: **Company Description** **Why Wellmark**: We are a mutual insurance company owned by our policy holders across Iowa and South Dakota, and we’ve built our reputation on over 80 years’ worth of trust. We are not motivated by profits. We are motivated by the well\-being of our friends, family, and neighbors–our members. If you’re passionate about joining an organization working hard to put its members first, to provide best\-in\-class service, and one that is committed to sustainability and innovation, consider applying today! **Why Wellmark Technology?** Wellmark is building innovative, modern solutions using cutting edge technology. We are driving organizational transformation and business strategy by empowering our technology team to innovate new and elegant solutions to enhance the customer experience. Together, we are leaning into the future, owning the outcome, and driving organizational change to transform how we work. **Job Description** As a Lead Software Engineer on Wellmark’s Enterprise AI Services \& Agents team, you will lead the design and delivery of reusable enterprise assistants, agents, AI services, skills, and agentic workflows. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role that combines solution design, software engineering, customer engagement, and end\-to\-end accountability for secure, scalable, and supportable AI solutions. You will partner with engineers, customers, product leaders, architecture, security, and governance stakeholders to translate business needs into production\-ready solutions. You will also help establish enterprise blueprints and engineering standards for assistants, agents, agentic workflows, and AI evaluation, while building reusable frameworks and components that reduce duplication and accelerate governed AI delivery across Wellmark. The team’s focus is to build business\-facing AI capabilities once, harden them for enterprise use, and make them reusable across products, channels, portfolios, and business areas. **Qualifications** **Preferred** * Demonstrated experience leading the design and delivery of complex software solutions while remaining hands\-on with coding, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and production support. * Hands\-on experience designing, building, deploying, and supporting generative AI applications, enterprise assistants, agents, agentic workflows, or reusable AI services in production at enterprise scale. * Experience with agent frameworks and orchestration technologies such as AWS Strands Agents, Amazon Bedrock Agents, LangGraph, or comparable frameworks. * Experience implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation, enterprise or semantic search, knowledge retrieval, structured\-data retrieval, document understanding, and tool\-using AI solutions. * Experience designing multi\-agent or supervisor\-agent patterns, including delegation, tool selection, orchestration, context and state management, exception handling, and human escalation. * Experience integrating models, enterprise tools, data, and services through APIs or standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). * Experience developing AI evaluation frameworks using approaches such as golden datasets, scenario\-based testing, LLM\-as\-judge, and automated regression testing to measure groundedness, citation correctness, response quality, safety, latency, and cost. * Experience with AI observability and operations, including OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, prompt and response telemetry, quality monitoring, regression detection, audit evidence, usage measurement, and cost tracking. * Strong experience building backend services, enterprise APIs, microservices, and distributed systems using RESTful, event\-driven, or asynchronous patterns. * Experience designing cloud\-native solutions using AWS services and infrastructure\-as\-code tools such as AWS CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation. * Experience designing secure enterprise solutions that incorporate authentication, authorization, workload identity, data protection, audit logging, policy enforcement, guardrails, and appropriate human oversight. * Experience building reusable frameworks, SDKs, libraries, templates, service contracts, test harnesses, or infrastructure components that accelerate delivery across multiple teams. * Experience implementing automated testing at the unit, integration, contract, and end\-to\-end levels, along with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Enterprise Actions or similar tools. * Demonstrated ability to engage customers, translate ambiguous business needs into technical designs, communicate trade\-offs, and influence decisions across product, architecture, security, governance, and engineering teams. * Experience providing technical direction, conducting design and code reviews, mentoring engineers, and improving team engineering practices. * Experience delivering solutions in healthcare, health insurance, financial services, or another regulated industry, including familiarity with HIPAA, SOC 2, privacy, co r audience with the ability to adjust communication style that will best suit the audience. * Ability to thrive in fast\-paced environment with changing priorities. Excellent organizational skills. Strong time management skills with the ability to set and meet established timeframes with little direction, while assuring data and information integrity. * Eagerness to learn and stay current on industry trends and have a continuous learning mindset. * Ability to collaborate and work as a team to accomplish goals and/or solve problems. Ability to earn trust and respect from peers, leadership, and stakeholders. Ability to learn by actively listening and applying coaching feedback. * Ability to lead, support and work within a diverse development team model including global staffing, crowd sourcing, etc. **Additional Information** a. Lead system development and engineering for highly complex programs. Coordinate the preparation, coding, testing, and debugging of complex programs; including the analysis and development of workflows that utilize emerging technology and meet and exceed Wellmark’s evolving business needs. b. Serve as subject matter expert in the implementation of innovative and cost\-effective business solutions for multiple applications and systems utilizing information technology, business, and industry trends. c. Provide leadership, training, and guidance to others on the team in the gathering of information, necessary research needed for root cause analysis, problem definition and formulation, solution implementation, verification, and ongoing optimization. Ensure analysis of defects to find root cause and guide others in the identification of potential improvement opportunities. d. Mentor, guide and problem\-solve with other technology areas in the development and implementation of solutions, including how to use new or enhanced software/applications. e. Coordinate with company resources to accomplish integration of products and processes and complex solutions. Provide timely and accurate results, and exceptional customer service. f. Utilize established relationships with Wellmark leaders and acts as a primary consultant on business status, issues, process improvements and technology enhancements or capabilities. g. Participate in project proposals, estimates and proof\-of\-concept activities as needed. h. Maintain awareness of industry’s best practices and standards and proactively participates in industry/knowledge reference groups relative to role. Provide direction for enterprise standards. Conduct code reviews and monitor standard adherence. i. Other duties as assigned. ***An Equal Opportunity Employer*** *The policy of Wellmark Blue Cross Blue Shield is to recruit, hire, train and promote individuals in all job classifications without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or any other characteristic protected by law.* *Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation due to a disability at any stage of the employment application process should contact us at* *careers@wellmark.com* *Please inform us if you meet the definition of a "**Covered DoD official**".* At this time, Wellmark is not considering applicants for this position that require any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. jobs.title: Principal Engineer I - AI Engineering
jobs.description: **Job Title:** Principal Engineer I \- AI Engineering**Location:** Block 23**What you'll do:** As a Principal Engineer I, you'll provide SME expertise in GitHub Copilot, agentic engineering, and adjacent technology domains to ensure enterprise solutions are secure, compliant, reliable, and supportable. You'll serve as a technical owner and strategic engineering lead for enterprise GitHub Copilot and the organization's agentic software engineering capabilities, providing technical direction for their architecture, configuration, integration, governance, lifecycle, and evolution. This role is responsible for defining and evolving the technical vision, architecture, engineering patterns, governance, and capabilities of the enterprise Agentic SDLC Harness, including reusable agents, skills, instructions, rules, plugins, MCP integrations and other AI\-assisted engineering capabilities. As a Principal Engineer I, you will partner with Development, Architecture, DevOps, Quality Engineering, Security, Cloud and Governance teams to establish a scalable and secure ecosystem that accelerates software delivery while maintaining engineering standards and controls. You'll partner with project sponsors, engineering teams, platform owners, and technology leaders to refine requirements, evaluate technical approaches, and drive solutions from concept through enterprise adoption. You'll provide technical leadership across organizational boundaries, influence engineering standards and architectural decisions, communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering and leadership audiences, and mentor engineers in GitHub Copilot, agentic engineering, DevOps, and related software engineering practices. This role requires deep technical expertise in GitHub Copilot, agentic software engineering, modern software development, GitHub Enterprise, Azure DevOps, DevOps and platform engineering, CI/CD, APIs and integrations, development frameworks, identity and access, and secure software delivery. Strong strategic and critical thinking, technical leadership, communication, and collaboration skills are required to influence engineering practices and establish trusted relationships across development teams, business partners, technology leadership, and governance functions.* Serve as an enterprise technical owner and SME for GitHub Copilot and AI\-assisted software engineering. * Define the technical strategy, architecture, standards, configuration model, and operating model for enterprise GitHub Copilot and agentic software engineering capabilities. * Engineer, configure, and evolve enterprise GitHub Copilot capabilities, including managed settings, enterprise and organizational policies, model availability, custom agents, skills, instructions, rules, plugins, approved MCP servers, and related extensibility capabilities. * Evaluate new and evolving GitHub Copilot and agentic engineering capabilities through controlled testing and experimentation, and determine enterprise readiness, security and governance requirements, adoption strategy, implementation approach, and business value. * Design and evolve the enterprise Agentic SDLC Harness that defines and governs how AI agents and capabilities interact with developers, source repositories, CI/CD platforms, development tools, and enterprise systems, including patterns for orchestration, tool access, context management, permissions, and human oversight. * Design and implement technical guardrails for AI\-assisted engineering, including access controls, approved tools and models, MCP server permissions, agent capabilities, repository interactions, data handling, and other controls required to balance developer productivity with enterprise security, regulatory, compliance, and risk requirements. * Establish and operate lifecycle management practices for Copilot and agentic engineering configurations, including source control, peer review, testing, approval, versioning, staged deployment, promotion of changes across test and enterprise environments, and rollback. * Serve as a technical escalation point for complex GitHub Copilot and agentic engineering issues, including configuration, authentication, IDE integration, policy enforcement, agent/plugin behavior, MCP integrations, and enterprise platform interoperability. * Establish monitoring and operational practices for platform availability, configuration health, integration reliability, usage, and emerging technical risks. * Develop reference implementations, technical standards, engineering patterns, playbooks, reusable examples, quick\-start guides, and enablement materials that accelerate safe adoption across development teams. * Define and monitor enterprise metrics for adoption, usage, developer experience, quality, reliability, engineering effectiveness, and value realization; use these insights to identify opportunities to improve GitHub Copilot, the Agentic SDLC ecosystem, and developer productivity. * Communicate platform roadmap, zure DevOps, including repository governance, identity and access, integrations, policies, CI/CD, and developer tooling. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience with GitHub Copilot and AI\-assisted software engineering, including enterprise configuration, agentic capabilities, customization, integration, governance, and developer enablement. * Experience architecting enterprise developer platforms and developer enablement ecosystems, including reusable frameworks, integrations, automation, engineering patterns, and shared platform capabilities. * Strong understanding of generative AI and agentic architectures, including AI agents, tool calling, agent orchestration, prompt engineering, context engineering, retrieval patterns, human\-in\-the\-loop controls, and secure integration with enterprise systems. * Experience designing security and governance controls for AI\-assisted engineering, including identity and access, least\-privilege tool access, secrets and sensitive\-data protection, repository permissions, third\-party integrations, MCP servers, and agent/tool execution boundaries. * Demonstrated software engineering experience and ability to design, build, test, and maintain automation, integrations, developer tooling, APIs, scripts, and reusable engineering components. * Ability to translate emerging technologies into secure, scalable, supportable enterprise solutions. * Ability to work effectively in a team environment. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise architecture, technology governance, security and risk frameworks, with demonstrated ability to integrate new capabilities into existing enterprise platforms and operating models. * Experience working within a regulated financial\-services environment and supporting technology risk assessments, audits, regulatory examinations, and control\-evidence requests is preferred. * Advanced speaking and writing communication skills. * Advanced knowledge of applicable regulatory and legal compliance obligations, rules and regulations, industry standards and practices. * Previous technical leadership experience preferred. **Benefits you’ll love:** We offer all the important things you'd want — like competitive salaries, an ownership stake in the company, medical and dental insurance, time off, a great 401k matching program, tuition assistance program, an employee volunteer program, and a wellness program. In addition, you’ll have the opportunity to bolster your business knowledge, learning the ins and outs of how successful companies operate and manage their finances, giving you invaluable hands\-on experience to help grow your career! **About the company:** Western Alliance Bank, Member FDIC, is a wholly owned subsidiary of Western Alliance Bancorporation. Serving clients nationwide, Western Alliance Bank includes six legacy bank brands — Alliance Association Bank, Alliance Bank of Arizona, Bank of Nevada, Bridge Bank, First Independent Bank and Torrey Pines Bank — that remain part of the company’s heritage, as well as AmeriHome Mortgage, a Western Alliance Bank Company. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process and/or need an alternative method of applying, please email HR@westernalliancebank.com or call 602\-386\-2488\. Leveraging our holistic portfolio of capabilities in consulting, design, engineering, and operations, we help clients realize their boldest ambitions and build future\-ready, sustainable businesses. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com. **Production Engineer, AI Storage for HPC Clusters** ==================================================== **Quantity:** 2–5 openings **Location:** United States Candidates Only! **Work Arrangement:** 100% REMOTE **About the Role** ------------------ The customer's Cloud Foundation AI Services team builds and operates the storage that lets AI researchers train models reliably and efficiently across cloud environments. We connect high\-performance filesystems, object storage, and data\-management services to AI compute, so training datasets and model checkpoints are fast and available wherever they are needed. We are looking for a hands\-on storage system engineer who can turn demanding AI workloads into reliable, scalable infrastructure. The work spans software development, performance analysis, automation, and production ownership. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Build and operate distributed file and object storage for AI training: shared researcher filesystems, training datasets, and model checkpoints. * Diagnose and improve end\-to\-end storage performance (metadata, throughput, latency, caching, network) so storage I/O stops stalling training. * Automate the storage lifecycle (provisioning, scaling, upgrades, recovery) using Kubernetes and infrastructure\-as\-code. * Move and migrate data across clusters, regions, and clouds without losing integrity or slowing researchers down. * Keep it reliable through observability, alerting, testing, safe rollouts, and incident response, partnering with research, security, and storage\-provider teams. **Must\-Haves** --------------- * Built or operated production distributed storage, high\-performance filesystems, or large scale data infrastructure. * Strong Linux skills, and can debug filesystem, network, and concurrency issues in production. * Writes maintainable software or automation in a language such as Python, Go, C\+\+, or Rust. * Has owned a reliability or performance improvement end to end, from spotting the problem through deployment and verification. **Nice to Have** ---------------- * Experience with **cloud infrastructure** and **Kubernetes,** or a comparable large\-scale orchestration environment. * Depth in NFS/POSIX and distributed\-filesystem internals: metadata, caching, consistency, availability, and recovery. * Hands\-on with one or more distributed or network storage systems such as Hammerspace, Lustre, ZFS/OpenZFS, VAST, or Pure Storage. Depth in comparable systems counts; you do not need every product named here. * AI or HPC storage patterns: high\-throughput data loading, checkpoint writes and restores, metadata\-heavy access, and staging data for accelerator clusters. * Infrastructure\-as\-code and observability tooling (Terraform, Helm, Kubernetes operators; metrics, tracing, benchmarking), and object/S3 storage with tiering and cross\-region movement. Experience: \>10 YEARS . The expected compensation for this role ranges from $100,000 to $200,000 . Final compensation will depend on various factors, including your geographical location, minimum wage obligations, skills, and relevant experience. Based on the position, the role is also eligible for Wipro's standard benefits including a full range of medical and dental benefits options, disability insurance, paid time off (inclusive of sick leave), other paid and unpaid leave options. Applicants are advised that employment in some roles may be conditioned on successful completion of a post\-offer drug screening, subject to applicable state law. Wipro provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. Applications from veterans and people with disabilities are explicitly welcome. Reinvent your world. We are building a modern Wipro. We are an end\-to\-end digital transformation partner with the boldest ambitions. To realize them, we need people inspired by reinvention. Of yourself, your career, and your skills. We want to see the constant evolution of our business and our industry. It has always been in our DNA \- as the world around us changes, so do we. Join a business powered by purpose and a place that empowers you to design your own reinvention.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Engineer, Enterprise AI
jobs.description: **About Wonder** Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise. Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. With Wonder, you can mix and match hundreds of dishes from 20\+ exclusive restaurants in a single order, so everyone gets exactly what they’re craving. Enjoy everything from tacos to Thai with $0 delivery fees, plus dine\-in or pick up at a Wonder location near you. Each dish is made to order on\-site by our culinary team and served hot. Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale. *Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.* **About The Opportunity** Wonder’s Enterprise Technology team is hiring an Infrastructure Engineer to establish and scale the hosting, deployment, and integration foundations that support builders of all technical levels as they launch and maintain the apps and agents they’ve built with AI. You’ll work across enterprise technology, platform engineering, security, data, and business teams to turn employee\-built prototypes into secure, reliable, supported applications. **The Impact You Will Make** * Build and operate the infrastructure for employee\-built applications, including deployment environments, hosting, databases, networking, and appropriate access controls. * Help assess and implement the right hosting and development platform for Wonder’s needs, working with platform engineering, security, data, and business teams. * Create repeatable deployment paths that help teams move applications from local prototypes into secure, reliable cloud environments. * Set up and maintain integrations with the tools employees use, which may include Slack, Gmail, Google Sheets, Salesforce, Looker, BigQuery, and other business systems. * Design and implement version control workflows, including Git and GitHub integration, so applications can be reviewed, tracked, maintained, and safely rolled back. * Build reusable infrastructure patterns and automation, using infrastructure as code where appropriate. * Establish secure foundations for application hosting, including identity, secrets management, environment separation, data access, backups, monitoring, and incident response. * Help teams understand how to deploy and operate their applications, and provide hands\-on guidance from initial setup through launch and ongoing support. * Learn how employees work and shape the platform around their needs: reduce unnecessary complexity, make common tasks self\-service, and explain technical steps in clear language. * Provide highly responsive, patient support to builders with different levels of technical experience. Follow through on issues and help users become confident operating their applications. * Gather feedback from users and use it to improve platform workflows, documentation, examples, and support. * Document architecture, deployment procedures, integration patterns, operational ownership, and maintenance expectations. **What You Bring to the Table** * Experience building or operating cloud infrastructure and application deployment environments, ideally on Google Cloud Platform or another major cloud provider. * Strong understanding of application hosting, networking, databases, identity and access management, and production operations. * Experience with version control systems, especially Git and GitHub, and workflows for code review, release, and rollback. * Experience automating infrastructure and deployments with tools such as Terraform and CI/CD systems. * Experience integrating applications with APIs and business systems, and a practical understanding of authentication, authorization, and secret storage. * A customer\-focused approach to infrastructure: you care whether people can successfully use the platform, not just whether it is technically sound. * Ability to make complex technical workflows approachable for users who may not be professional software engineers. * Strong troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. * Good judgment balancing speed, simplicity, security, reliability, and cost. **Got These? Even Better** * Experience building platforms or paved paths for internal developers, citizen developers, or low\-code/no\-code teams. * Experience with Vercel or comparable application hosting and development platforms. * Experience with platforms such as Superblocks, Lovable, or similar AI\-assisted app\-building tools. * Familiarity with AI\-enabled software development workflows and the infrastructure needed to take generated code into supported applications. * Experience with Okta, Google Workspace, Slack, or integrations across enterprise productivity systems. * Experience supporting applications that handle sensitive data or require strong access boundaries. **What Success Looks Like** * Existing employee\-built applications have a clear path to secure, supported cloud hosting. * Teams can deploy and update applications through documented, repeatable workflows with version history and rollback. * Integrations and permissions are reliable, appropriately scoped, and maintainable. * Employees can make progress without needing to understand every layer of cloud infrastructure. * Builders receive timely, highly supportive help and grow more confident using the platform. * The platform balances ease of use with security, reliability, and cost controls. As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role. CA: $208,500 \- $225,000 Wonder uses geographic\-specific salary structures, which means the salary offered may vary depending on where the job is located. The final salary offer will take into account various factors, such as the candidate's skills, education, training, credentials, and experience. **Benefits** The benefits applicable to this role include a competitive compensation package with equity and a 401(k). We also offer a choice of medical, dental, and vision plans, company paid short and long term disability coverage, paid time off including flexible time off for exempt employees, paid vacation for non\-exempt employees, and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable law in addition to paid parental leave, discounted meals and exclusive perks across the Wonder family of brands. Eligibility, effective dates, and available plan options vary by employment classification and location. To learn more about benefits for this role, visit our Careers page here. **A Final Note** At Wonder, we build the best teams by hiring with an objective lens — evaluating people for their potential while championing diversity, equity, and inclusion. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, marital status, disability, or any other protected class. As part of our commitment to fair and compliant hiring practices, Wonder participates in the federal government's E\-Verify program to confirm employment eligibility. If you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. **We look forward to hearing from you! We'll contact you via email or text to schedule interviews and share information about your candidacy**.

jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Model Platform
jobs.description: **About Wonder** Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise. Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. Behind the scenes, Wonder owns and operates every step of the dining experience, from recipe development to the technology that powers our experience, allowing us to deliver quality, variety, and consistency at scale. *Join us as we work to make great food more accessible.* **About The Opportunity** Wonder's Model Platform team builds the systems that take machine learning models from prototype to production and keeps them running well once they're there. Our models rank restaurants and dishes, predict delivery times, price orders, and dispatch couriers for millions of diners across Grubhub and Wonder. Most of those predictions are served to high\-traffic Java services. How well a model works with those services matters as much as how good the model is. We're hiring a Staff Machine Learning Engineer with deep Java backend experience to set the technical direction for how our models and services work together. You'll define how every team calls our models. You'll set the standards for load testing and performance across the services that use them. You'll also lead complex ML work that spans multiple teams and systems. This is a hands\-on technical leadership role. You'll write code, design models, and take on the hardest production problems yourself. You'll be the main technical link between Model Platform and our software engineering teams, and you'll partner with Applied Scientists, our data and infrastructure platform teams, and senior engineering leadership. Our interview process includes the same Java coding interview our software engineers take. **The Impact You Will Make** * Define the standard architecture for how Java services call ML models, including client libraries, API contracts, latency budgets, and fallbacks. * Set the standards for load testing, performance benchmarking, and capacity planning for every service that calls our models, and build them into the release process. * Drive performance work such as profiling, JVM tuning, caching, request batching, and concurrency for our highest\-traffic model integrations. * Lead the design and delivery of complex ML solutions that span multiple teams or systems, and make the architecture decisions that cross team boundaries. * Build reusable ML architectures, pipelines, and deployment patterns that get Applied Science work into production faster. * Set the standards for ML reliability, scalability, monitoring, and lifecycle management, including model scorecards, reproducible training, safe rollout, and SLOs for tier\-1 models. * Own model architecture and tuning for our most demanding deployments, balancing accuracy against latency, scalability, and cost. * Run design and code reviews across ML and software engineering teams, and push back on technical decisions when the evidence supports it. * Own the platform's technical roadmap with engineering leadership, sequence work across teams, and raise risks early. * Mentor senior and mid\-level engineers, take part in hiring, and build depth on the team so no critical system depends on one person. * Explain technical trade\-offs in business terms to product and executive stakeholders, and write down key decisions and the reasons behind them. **What You Bring to the Table** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related field, or equivalent experience * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with deep expertise building and running high\-traffic backend services in Java * 5\+ years building and running ML systems in production, including 3\+ years at senior scope setting technical direction across teams or systems * Expert Java and object\-oriented design skills, including service frameworks (Spring Boot or similar), REST or gRPC APIs, and JVM performance tuning * A track record of setting load testing and performance standards (Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and planning capacity for services as load changes * Experience designing highly available distributed systems (99\.99% uptime) with automated testing and monitoring built in from the start * Deep expertise in production ML architecture, including training pipelines, batch and real\-time serving, feature pipelines, model versioning, and rollback at scale * Strong Python and hands\-on model development experience with common frameworks (XGBoost/LightGBM, PyTorch, or TensorFlow), including choosing and tuning models under real latency and cost limits * Strong data engineering skills in Spark and SQL, including building and debugging streaming or batch pipelines * Deep experience with cloud infrastructure on AWS or GCP (SageMaker, Vertex AI, or equivalent), Docker, and Kubernetes * Experience with experimentation, including A/B test design, guardrail metrics, and knowing when an offline metric is misleading * Proven technical leadership across ML and software engineering teams, including leading architecture reviews beyond your own team, influencing decisions without direct authority, and mentoring senior engineers * Clear communication of model behavior and technical trade\-offs to technical and non\-technical audiences, including executives **Got These? Even Better** * Experience in marketplace, e\-commerce, or logistics, such as ranking, recommendations, ETA prediction, pricing, or dispatch * Serving models inside or alongside JVM services (ONNX Runtime, TensorFlow Java, XGBoost4J, or similar) * Building an internal ML platform used by multiple science teams * Cassandra or other distributed NoSQL databases * Streaming data systems (Kafka, Flink) * Leading an ML platform migration between cloud As a matter of company policy, Wonder does not sponsor applicants for employment visa status for this role. jobs.title: Senior Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **About the Role** A global lead company applies AI to its own operations first. You will set the technical direction for a model platform used across sales, support, finance and engineering, with direct, measurable cost and quality impact. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process. IT AI/ML Engineering team is hiring a Senior Staff AI Engineer to serve as technical lead for two engineering groups: one that runs our shared AI platform, and one that delivers AI solutions and support to teams across the company. You will set technical direction, keep delivery on track, and work day to day with engineers and contractors in the US and India. This is a hands\-on leadership role. You will own the architecture and roadmap for platform services such as model gateways and cost controls, AI observability and evaluation, and shared memory and context, along with the AI\-powered applications, enterprise AI tool administration and support processes built on top. Deep expertise in model inference or training is not required. **What You'll Do** * Lead the AI platform group. Own architecture, roadmap and delivery for shared services: LLM gateways and model routing, AI cost optimization, observability and evaluation, an internal catalog of agents and skills, and long\-term memory and context for AI applications. * Lead the AI solutions and support group. Own delivery and quality for AI\-powered help and search experiences, the rollout and administration of enterprise AI platforms, and the L2 support model, including triage, escalation, runbooks and training workshops. * Anchor a distributed team. Work with engineers and contractors across the US and India, bridge time zones, run planning and reviews, and make sure context and decisions flow in both directions. * Plan and prioritize. Turn business requests into a clear priority order, balance capacity across the team, flag risks early, and report status to engineering leadership and stakeholders. * Stay hands\-on. Design and review APIs, services, front\-end and back\-end code, and CI/CD pipelines; unblock engineers; set standards for code quality, testing and documentation. * Set the quality bar for AI solutions. Define release gates, regression checks and cost and latency targets using evaluation and observability tooling, and partner with the team that owns models and agents on model selection and tuning. * Run operations well. Reduce repeat support tickets through automation and better documentation, lead incident response and postmortems, and track platform cost, usage and reliability. * Partner across the company. Work with business owners in sales, support, finance andengineering, and with Security, Privacy and Legal on data handling, access controls and approvals. * Grow the team. Mentor engineers, help hire, manage contractor performance, and share best practices through documentation and workshops.What You Bring **Minimum Qualifications** 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including 3\+ years building production applications with LLMs or other ML services; Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience). 3\+ years as a technical lead or equivalent, leading engineers on shared deliverables, ideally across time zones and with contractors. Strong full\-stack skills: Python and TypeScript/Node.js (or Java/Go), a modern front\-end framework such as React, and solid API design. Practical experience with LLM applications: prompt and tool design, retrieval\-augmented generation, agents and function calling or MCP , and gateways or routing layers. Experience with evaluation and observability for AI systems: test sets, regression suites, LLM\-as\-judge, tracing, and cost and latency tracking. Cloud and DevOps skills: AWS (or GCP/Azure), Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD, with monitoring, canary and rollback practice. Experience running or supporting a production service, including on\-call, incident response, runbooks and L2 escalation. Clear written and verbal communication, with a record of managing priorities and expectations with leaders and business partners. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience administering enterprise AI platforms and vendor accounts (such as Claude, OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock or Vertex), including usage controls and cost governance. Experience with vector and graph databases, and with agent memory and context management. Experience building search or help experiences, Slack bots and web widgets integrated with AI services. Familiarity with model inference, fine\-tuning and open\-weight models; helpful but not required. Experience running enablement: workshops, documentation and internal training for AI tools. Experience in regulated environments such as FedRAMP. **Team, Location and Compensation** Team. You will join IT AI/ML Engineering team and lead two of its groups, working closely with the group that builds agents and models. Day to day you will use Python, TypeScript, AWS, Kubernetes, LLM gateways and evaluation tooling. Location. Hybrid, three days per week in San Jose, CA or Bellevue, WA; remote within the US considered for exceptional candidates. Pay: $107,000\.00 \- $130,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Retirement plan Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Jose, CA 95139

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: *We offer a flexible working policy that supports a healthy balance between personal and professional well\-being. This role requires in\-office presence on Tuesdays \& Thursdays to collaborate, connect, and learn from peers \- while also maintaining the flexibility for meaningful work\-life balance.* **Being a Senior Software Engineer at iManage Means…** You will play a key role on a team responsible for supporting iManage’s core platform. In this role, you will be at the center of the development team with responsibility and control over what you are building and will make a real impact on our customers and users. You will have the opportunity to work on modern technologies like Java, Docker, Kubernetes, MariaDB Clusters, and more. Our work culture allows us to build great relationships while having fun solving challenging problems, supported by leaders that care about you at a personal and professional level. **iM Responsible For…** * Designing and implementing new architectural patterns to help the iManage Work family of products scale to meet the demands of our existing traffic and future growth * Collaborating within cross\-functional engineering teams as well as peer teams to build an integrated solution * Keeping developer productivity and software quality high using innovative backend tooling * Communicating, documenting, and presenting in front of technical and business audiences * Striving to consistently learn and improve within the company as well as share knowledge with colleagues globally **iM Qualified Because I Have…** * The heart of a maker, with a passion for combining infrastructure and software to bring great ideas to life * The desire to work with cloud\-native services in Azure to scale a platform with a global footprint * A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or related field * 5\+ years of experience building software or applications with Java * Proficiency in other programming languages; full\-stack development as a plus * Proficiency with relational database and NoSQL systems * Thought leadership and design skills in one or more key technology areas: high\-transaction systems, micro\-services based distributed architectures, fault\-tolerant designs, data and system security * Experience with Linux platform as development and runtime environment * Knowledge of secure coding and design practices (including threat modelling) as a plus * Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and build management; use of Docker as a plus *Don't meet every qualification listed above? Studies show that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet all qualifications. At iManage, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive environment, and encourage everyone to show up as their full authentic selves. We welcome those that come with a growth mindset and a hunger for learning; so, if you are excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification we encourage you to apply anyways!* **iM Getting To…** * Join a supportive, experienced team with an inclusive, encouraging, and vibrant culture. * Have flexible work hours that allow me to balance my ‘me time’ with my work commitments. * Collaborate in a modern open plan workspace, with a gaming area, free snacks, drinks and regular social events. * Focus on impactful work, solving complex, real challenges utilizing the latest technologies and protocols. * Own my career path with our internal development framework. Ask us more about this! * Learn new skills and earn certifications with access to unlimited courses in LinkedIn Learning. * Join an innovative, industry leading SaaS company that is continuing to grow \& scale! **iManage Is Supporting Me By...** * Creating an inclusive environment where I can help shape the culture not just by fitting in, but by adding to it. * Providing a market competitive salary that is applied through a consistent process, equitable for all our employees, and regularly reviewed based on industry data. * Rewarding me with an annual performance\-based bonus. * Offering comprehensive Health/Vision/Dental/Life Insurance, and a 401k Retirement Savings Plan with a company match up to 4%. * Giving access to HealthJoy, a healthcare concierge service, to help me maximize my health benefits. * Granting enhanced leave for expecting parents; 20 weeks 100% paid for primary leave, and 10 weeks 100% paid for secondary leave. * Providing me with a flexible time off policy to take the time off that I need. Be it for vacation, volunteering, celebrating holidays, spending time with family, or simply taking time to recharge and reset. * Caring for my mental health and well\-being with multiple company wellness days and free access to the Healthy Minds app for mindfulness, meditation and more. *The overall US annual base salary range for this position is $110,000–$150,000\. Individual compensation for each candidate depends on factors such as qualifications, experience, and candidate location. This range does not include additional forms of compensation, such as bonuses, or benefits. Your recruiter will provide further details about the offer range, incentives, and overall compensation during the hiring process.***About iManage…** iManage is dedicated to Making Knowledge WorkTM. Over one million professionals across 65\+ countries rely on our intelligent, cloud\-enabled, secure knowledge work platform to uncover and activate the knowledge that exists inside their business content and communications. We are continuously innovating to solve the most complex professional challenges and enable better business outcomes; Our work is not always easy but it is ambitious and rewarding. So we’re looking for people who love a challenge. People who are happiest when they’re solving problems and collaborating with the industry’s best and brightest. That’s the iManage way. It’s how we do things that might appear impossible. How we develop our employees’ strengths and unlock their potential. How we find meaning in everything we do. ***Whoever you are, whatever you do, however you work. Make it mean something at iManage.*** iManage provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training. Learn more at: www.imanage.com Please see our privacy statement for more information on how we handle your personal data: https://imanage.com/privacy\-policy/ \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-RW1 F5eQMqRDD1

jobs.title: Member of Technical Staff, Cortex Lab (applied AI research)
jobs.description: Core team $300K \- $700K/yr compensation **Required Skills** ------------------- AI Agent Evaluation \& Benchmark Design Python \& Research Engineering Agent Failure Analysis \& Experimentation LLM \& Agentic Systems ### **About micro1** micro1 is a data lab that helps AI labs \& Enterprises train foundational models and agents. We provide frontier evaluations and reinforcement learning environments to improve LLM capabilities, as well as contextual evaluations to monitor and improve AI agents in enterprise settings. Our AI recruiting agent sources and vets domain experts for our data platform that enables rapid production of high\-quality training data. Our research spans high\-value, specialized domains (legal, medical, finance, coding, etc.), where expert\-level data is the hardest to produce and most valuable for advanced model performance. Our pipeline performance system ensures both quality and velocity. **Job Title:** Member of Technical Staff, Cortex Lab (applied AI research) **Job Type:** Full\-time **Location:** Remote **The Role** We're hiring a Member of Technical Staff (MTS) to develop, evaluate, and improve AI agents and LLM\-powered systems operating in real\-world enterprise workflows. This is a hands\-on applied research and engineering role focused on agent evaluations, failure analysis, and rapid experimentation. You'll work closely with researchers, engineers, domain experts, and enterprise customers to identify capability gaps, design rigorous evaluations, and drive measurable improvements in AI system performance. You'll also contribute to research tooling and infrastructure that accelerates experimentation and evaluation. **What You'll Do** * Design and implement evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, and datasets for LLM\-powered agents and complex AI workflows. * Identify, analyze, and prioritize model, agent, and workflow failures in real\-world production environments. * Run rapid experiments to validate hypotheses, measure performance, and improve agent reliability and effectiveness. * Partner with enterprise customers and researchers to evaluate, deploy, and optimize AI systems across production workflows. * Develop high\-quality training and evaluation data, task specifications, and feedback mechanisms to improve system performance. * Build Python\-based evaluation pipelines, experimentation tools, and lightweight research infrastructure. * Collaborate with researchers, domain experts, and customer stakeholders to define evaluation strategies and optimization roadmaps. * Contribute to technical reports, benchmarks, and research insights that inform future system improvements. **What We're Looking For** * Strong background in applied AI research, research engineering, machine learning, or LLM\-based systems. * Hands\-on experience designing and implementing evaluations for AI agents, including tool use, multi\-step workflows, and task completion. * Strong Python programming skills and experience building evaluation pipelines, experimental tooling, or ML infrastructure. * Experience developing benchmarks, datasets, evaluation metrics, and experimental methodologies for AI systems. * Ability to analyze agent failures, identify root causes, and translate findings into measurable performance improvements. * Understanding of LLM behavior, agentic architectures, and common challenges in reliability, robustness, and generalization. * Ability to translate ambiguous real\-world problems into structured experiments and actionable technical solutions. * Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across research, engineering, and customer teams. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience evaluating or optimizing AI agents in production or enterprise environments. * Familiarity with reinforcement learning, reward modeling, or post\-training techniques. * Experience building research infrastructure, evaluation tooling, or automated experimentation frameworks. * Prior experience at a frontier AI lab or in an applied AI research environment. * Contributions to research publications, open\-source benchmarks, or AI evaluation frameworks. * Experience collaborating directly with enterprise customers or technical stakeholders. **Compensation \& Benefits Notice** The national pay range for this full\-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$250,000 USD. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance\-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health\-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high\-performing, remote\-first workforce. micro1 is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, reach out to support@micro1\.ai. Our hiring process utilizes artificial intelligence tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision\-making. **Disclaimer** The information contained in this job posting, including but not limited to role responsibilities, qualifications, compensation, and benefits, is provided for informational purposes only and does not constitute a binding offer of employment. micro1 reserves the right to amend, modify, or withdraw any portion of this posting at its sole discretion and without prior notice. All employment decisions are made in accordance with applicable laws and regulations. **Apply now** -------------

jobs.title: Process Integration and Technology Development Engineer
jobs.description: The Process Integration and Technology Development Engineer defines, develops, and implements silicon process technology for the manufacture of integrated silicon devices. The successful candidate will be responsible for unit/process module development, process flow implementation, design rule definition, device architecture, electrical characterization, and technology qualification. These tasks support new silicon technology developments and transfers of existing technologies in and out of the resident fab. Experience related to semiconductor processing in BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies is desired. * Responsibilities **Process Integration and Technology Development** * Lead the development of unit processes and process modules for CMOS, BCD, Discretes, and hybrid Smart Power technologies. * Define and assess process module characterization to ensure robustness, manufacturability, and scalability. * Develop and maintain end\-to\-end technology process flows with detailed process specifications. * Define physical design rules and test structures for characterization. * Drive process and device optimization to meet performance, reliability, and cost targets. * Design and analyze statistical experiments using DOE, regression, and AI\-assisted methods to optimize device architecture and process modules. * Support intrinsic reliability studies, including gate oxide integrity, TDDB, HCI, EM, and stress migration, using both physics\-based and data\-driven approaches. **Manufacturing, Yield \& Technology Transfer** * Facilitate process improvements and corrective actions for yield, reliability, and manufacturability issues using root\-cause analysis and data mining and analysis. * Support Process Engineering and Yield Engineering teams to improve process quality and yield for technologies released to manufacturing. * Enable smooth technology transfers into and out of the fab by using data\-driven monitoring, excursion detection, and learning systems. * Qualifications **Required** * MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, or related technical field. * Knowledge of semiconductor device physics and construction , including CMOS, DMOS, Bipolar, and Trench FET devices. * Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to convey complex technical concepts clearly. * Demonstrated problem\-solving ability and strong collaboration skills in cross\-functional teams. **Preferred** * Understanding of semiconductor processes such as CVD, PVD, implant, diffusion, etch and plating. * Hands\-on experience with process and device TCAD simulations. * Experience designing and evaluating experiments using statistical methods . * Familiarity with AI/ML techniques, data mining, or statistical modeling. * Experience using scripting languages (e.g., Python, MATLAB, JMP, or equivalent) for data analysis, automation, or model development. About Us **onsemi** (Nasdaq: ON) is driving disruptive innovations to help build a better future. With a focus on automotive and industrial end\-markets, the company is accelerating change in megatrends such as vehicle electrification and safety, sustainable energy grids, industrial automation, and 5G and cloud infrastructure. With a highly differentiated and innovative product portfolio, onsemi creates intelligent power and sensing technologies that solve the world’s most complex challenges and leads the way in creating a safer, cleaner, and smarter world. More details about our company benefits can be found here: https://www.onsemi.com/careers/career\-benefits About the Team We are committed to sourcing, attracting, and hiring high\-performance innovators, while providing all candidates a positive recruitment experience that builds our brand as a great place to work. **onsemi** is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, marital status, pregnancy, sex, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected category under applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are limited in the ability or unable to access or use this online application process and need an alternative method for applying, you may contact Talent.acquisition@onsemi.com for assistance.
